title: P&C Insurance Virtual Assistant (VA)
description:
Insurance Virtual Assistant – Personal Lines & Customer Service (Full-Time)



Company - Midvalley Insurance Group

Location:Remote – Philippines  

Job Type:Full-Time | 40 Hours Per Week  

Schedule: Monday–Friday | U.S. Mountain Time Business Hours  





 Key Responsibilities



Customer Service & Client Communication

- Answer inbound phone calls and assist existing and prospective clients professionally.

- Communicate with clients through phone calls,
s, and text messages.

- Respond to policy questions, billing inquiries, and general service requests.

- Make outbound calls to follow up on outstanding requests, missing documents, and pending applications.

- Communicate with insurance carriers and underwriting departments.





Policy Servicing & Account Management

- Assist with policy changes, endorsements, Mortgagee updates and lien holder changes

- Process routine requests such as vehicle additions/removals, driver changes, and address updates

- Retrieve declarations pages, ID cards, evidence of insurance, and collect policy application signatures.

- Assist with mortgagee changes and lender insurance verification requests.

- Monitor underwriting notices, cancellations, and outstanding policy requirements.

- Maintain accurate client records, notes, and tasks within our agency management system.

- Follow up on outstanding service requests to ensure timely completion.



Renewals & Quoting Support

- Assist with upcoming policy renewals and renewal reviews.

-Understand how to run RCE on home, and understand home insurance eligibility guidelines.

- Compare existing and renewal policies to identify premium and coverage changes.

- Gather information needed for new business quotes and remarketing.

- Enter client information into comparative rating systems and carrier portals.

- Prepare quotes and proposals for review by licensed agents.

- Follow up with clients regarding pending quotes and missing information.





Required Qualifications



- Previous experience working with a U.S.-based Property & Casualty insurance agency. 3 years experience or more preffered

- Experience with personal lines insurance, including auto, homeowners, renters, and umbrella policies.

- Great spoken and written english skills

-Experience with Auto, home, landlord, renters, umbrella, Flood, earthquake and Jewelry policy.

- Previous experience communicating directly with U.S. customers by phone,
, and text.

- Familiarity with insurance carrier portals, policy servicing, and insurance terminology. Experience with carriers such as Progressive, Safeco, Travelers, National General, The Hartford, GEICO, and Root.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through without constant supervision.

-Able to use Google workspace, Slack and other tech stack.

- Reliable internet connection, computer, monitor, headset, and quiet workspace.

- Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive customer information responsibly.



Preferred Qualifications



The following experience is a plus but not required:



- Experience with Norcerts

- Turborater

- Commercial lines insurance VA experience.

-COI Generation experience



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who:



- Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and follows through on tasks.

- Is dependable, punctual, and consistent with attendance.

- Communicates proactively when questions or issues arise.

- Is comfortable speaking with customers and providing a positive customer experience.

- Pays close attention to details and understands the importance of accuracy in insurance.

- Can prioritize tasks and manage their workload effectively.

- Is eager to learn new systems, procedures, and insurance products.

- Wants to build a long-term career with a growing company.



Why Join Midvalley Insurance Group?



- Stable, full-time remote opportunity.

- Competitive compensation based on experience.

- Supportive and collaborative work environment.

- Training on agency-specific systems and procedures.

- Opportunities for professional development and growth.

- Potential performance-based incentives.

- Opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to a growing U.S. insurance agency.



We value reliability, professionalism, accountability, and excellent customer service.



To Apply, please submit the following:



Updated Resume – Highlighting your relevant work experience.

Short Video Introduction (1–3 minutes) – Introduce yourself, briefly discuss your professional background, and answer the question: "Why do you enjoy working in insurance?"





We look forward to hearing from you and potentially welcoming you to the Midvalley Insurance Group team!

title: Social Media & AI Lead Generation Manager
description:
# Job Title: Social Media & AI Lead Generation Manager



**Company:** Smart4You  

**Location:** Remote — Philippines  

**Employment:** Full-time  

**Hours:** 40 hours per week  

**Salary:** Negotiable based on experience



## The Goal of This Role



Your primary objective is to **generate qualified leads and book sales meetings for Smart4You**.



Smart4You provides AI solutions, intelligent agents, business process automation and custom AI implementations that help companies improve efficiency, reduce manual work and solve operational problems.



We are looking for someone who can combine social media management, AI-powered content creation and proactive lead generation to turn our online presence into a consistent source of business opportunities.



We are not hiring someone simply to post content and increase followers. We need someone who understands how to attract the right audience, identify potential customers, initiate conversations, nurture interest and convert that interest into qualified meetings on our calendar.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Social Media Strategy & Management

- Take ownership of Smart4You's 
 and
 presence, with Instagram used where appropriate.

- Develop and execute a consistent content strategy aligned with our commercial objectives.

- Manage the content calendar, publishing schedule and day-to-day execution.

- Build brand awareness and credibility with business owners, executives and decision-makers.

- Use social media to attract potential customers and generate relevant business enquiries.



### 2. AI-Powered Content & Video Production

- Create original 
 and
 posts, carousels, graphics, short-form videos and reels.

- Turn business problems, AI use cases, industry developments and our solutions into engaging content.

- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Canva, CapCut and relevant AI image and video platforms.

- Repurpose existing videos and other assets across multiple channels.

- Ensure content is professional, accurate and human-sounding rather than generic AI-generated material.

- Develop content with a clear purpose: attract prospects, demonstrate expertise, build trust or generate enquiries.



### 3. Active Lead Generation & Prospecting

- Identify businesses that could benefit from Smart4You's AI solutions and automation services.

- Research relevant companies and identify decision-makers, including founders, CEOs, managing directors and operations leaders.

- Use LinkedIn and other appropriate channels to identify and engage potential customers.

- Develop personalised outreach messages and relevant follow-ups.

- Engage with prospects who interact with our content and turn relevant conversations into business opportunities.

- Explore relevant
 groups, business communities and other organic channels for potential leads.

- Maintain an organised pipeline of prospects, conversations, follow-ups and meeting opportunities.



### 4. Convert Interest into Booked Meetings

- Turn qualified inbound enquiries and outbound conversations into booked sales meetings.

- Communicate the value of Smart4You's services clearly and professionally.

- Follow up with interested prospects until they book, decline or are no longer a viable opportunity.

- Use our designated booking calendar to schedule meetings with qualified prospects.

- Ensure meetings are relevant to our target audience and services, rather than filling the calendar with unqualified contacts.

- Track booked meetings, attendance, cancellations and the source of each opportunity.

- Coordinate with me to improve messaging, targeting and the conversion process.



### 5. AI & Marketing Automation

- Use AI to improve prospect research, personalisation, content production and lead qualification.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive marketing and prospecting tasks.

- Work with our existing CRM, booking systems and marketing tools where required.

- Help improve the process from first interaction to booked meeting.

- Experiment with tools and workflows that improve efficiency without compromising personalisation or outreach quality.



### 6. Performance Tracking & Reporting

- Track qualified leads generated, meetings booked, meeting attendance and lead sources.

- Monitor content performance, engagement and audience growth as supporting metrics.

- Report weekly on activities, outcomes, pipeline progress and next steps.

- Identify which channels, messages and content themes generate the most qualified opportunities.

- Continuously improve the strategy based on measurable results.



## Requirements

- Proven experience in social media management and B2B lead generation.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Practical experience with LinkedIn prospecting and professional outreach.

- Experience creating business-focused content for 
 and
.

- Familiarity with AI tools for writing, research, graphics and video creation.

- Ability to identify target companies and relevant decision-makers.

- Experience with CRM systems, lead tracking and meeting-booking workflows.

- Strong follow-up, organisation and communication skills.

- A commercial mindset: you understand that the objective is to generate sales opportunities, not just engagement.

- Ability to work independently, test approaches and report measurable results.



## Performance Expectations



Success will primarily be measured by:

- Number of qualified leads generated.

- Number of qualified sales meetings booked.

- Meeting attendance rate.

- Quality and relevance of the prospects generated.

- Conversion from outreach and content engagement into conversations and meetings.

- Consistency and quality of social media output.



We will agree on realistic initial targets after reviewing the existing channels, offer, target audience and lead generation process. We value qualified opportunities and sustainable results over inflated activity numbers.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Examples of social media accounts you have managed and content you have created.

2. Examples of B2B lead generation campaigns or LinkedIn outreach you have conducted.

3. Results you have achieved, particularly qualified leads and meetings booked.

4. The AI tools, CRM systems and prospecting tools you know how to use.

5. A short outline of how you would generate the first 10 qualified sales meetings for Smart4You.

6. Your expected monthly salary and availability.



We are looking for someone who can own the complete process from content and prospect research to outreach, follow-up and booked meetings.

title: Freelance Website Developer & Notion Specialist
description:
Freelance Website Developer & Notion Workspace Designer | One-Off Projects



Business: In Good Company / By Vayva

Employment: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote

Budget: Open to competitive project-based quotes

Website Deadline: 6-15 November 2026

Future Work: Potential ad-hoc updates and maintenance



ABOUT THE ROLE



Hi!



I'm a creator, entrepreneur and founder of multiple growing business ventures based in Brisbane, Australia. I'm currently looking for a creative, reliable and detail-oriented freelancer to help me with two projects:



1. Website design and development for my new lifestyle and community brand, In Good Company.

2. Notion workspace design and organisation to create one central business hub connecting all my business ventures.



Ideally, I'd love to work with someone experienced in both areas, but I'm also happy to consider applicants who specialise in just one. These are initially one-off projects, with the possibility of future work as my businesses grow. Ideally a female as they will understand the feminine approach I'd like.



I'm looking for someone who is efficient, organised, communicates well and has a strong eye for clean, modern design.



PROJECT 1: IN GOOD COMPANY WEBSITE



ABOUT THE BRAND



In Good Company is a new lifestyle and community brand focused on bringing women together through meaningful connections, events and shared experiences. We're launching our first event in Brisbane on 22 January 2027, with plans to eventually expand into retreats, travel experiences, a podcast and lifestyle products.



Our branding is elegant, feminine and editorial, with a deep burgundy, cream and soft pink colour palette.



WEBSITE REQUIREMENTS



1. Homepage

- Beautiful editorial-style design aligned with our branding

- Introduction to In Good Company

- Featured upcoming event

- Clear calls to action



2. About Page

- Brand story, mission and values

- Information about the founder



3. Events & Ticketing

- Dedicated pages for upcoming events

- Ability for customers to purchase tickets directly through the website

- Secure payment processing

- Automated booking confirmation
s

- Ticket types, pricing and quantity limits

- Ability to manage attendees and ticket sales



4. Contact Page

- General contact form

- Business and collaboration enquiries



5. Brand Partnerships

- Information for potential event sponsors and brand partners

- Partnership enquiry form



6.
 Newsletter

-
 signup integration

- Ability to collect subscriber details for future announcements and events



ADDITIONAL WEBSITE REQUIREMENTS



- Mobile-friendly and responsive

- Fast-loading and easy to navigate

- Basic SEO setup

- Connected to my existing domain

- Easy for me to edit and manage independently

- Room to expand as the business grows

- Clean, elegant typography and premium editorial styling



I'm open to website platform recommendations, provided the platform supports secure ticket purchases, is cost-effective and doesn't require ongoing developer assistance for basic updates. I want something beautiful, functional and scalable. But I want the vistor to have an experience as they come onto the website. 



Target completion date: 6 November 2026. (flexible) 



---



PROJECT 2: CENTRAL NOTION BUSINESS HUB



I'm also looking for someone experienced in Notion to help me build a central workspace for managing my different business ventures. I already have an existing Notion setup containing valuable databases, information, links and resources. I'd like to create a new, beautifully organised central dashboard while preserving and transferring relevant information from my current workspace.



THE MAIN DASHBOARD



I'd love one central Business HQ that branches into the following areas:



1. UGC & Brand Collaborations

- Brand collaborations and deliverables

- Campaign tracking

- Client information

- Deadlines and project statuses



2. Personal Brand & Content

- Content planning

- Social media ideas

- Posting schedules

- Brand strategy and resources



3. Coaching & Digital Products

- Coaching clients

- Digital products and courses

- Business resources

- Project planning



4. In Good Company

- Event planning

- Brand partnerships and sponsors

- Vendor information

- Upcoming projects

- Event checklists



5. Business Finances & Administration

- Financial overview

- Business expenses and income tracking

- Important business documents

- Administrative tasks



6. Content Calendar & Approvals

- Upcoming content

- Content statuses

- Approval tracking

- Completed content archives



7. Team & Editor Workflows

- Editor instructions

- Assigned tasks

- Deadlines

- Content feedback and approvals



8. Personal Planning & Goals

- Personal goals

- Weekly planning

- Important reminders

- General organisation



NOTION DESIGN REQUIREMENTS



I prefer a minimal, aesthetic and easy-to-navigate workspace.



I'd like:

- One central dashboard linking to all business areas

- Clear navigation and organised pages

- Simple, functional databases where needed

- Clean layouts with minimal clutter

- Consistent colours, icons and styling

- Existing information preserved during migration

- An intuitive system that I can easily maintain myself



I'm not looking for overly complicated automations or unnecessary features. My priority is simplicity, organisation and usability.



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR



The ideal freelancer will have:



- Proven experience in website development and/or Notion workspace design

- A portfolio of relevant past projects

- Strong attention to detail and design

- Excellent communication skills

- Ability to meet deadlines and work efficiently

- Willingness to incorporate feedback and revisions

- Ability to recommend practical, cost-effective solutions

- Experience creating user-friendly systems

- Confidence working independently while providing regular progress updates

- Ideally a female as they will understand the feminine approach I'd like.



Experience with e-commerce, event ticketing websites and creator-led businesses would be highly regarded.



BUDGET & PAYMENT



As these are starter projects for growing businesses, I'm working with a limited budget and looking for competitive, reasonable quotes. However, I value quality work and am happy to consider different proposals depending on your experience, portfolio and the scope of work. Please provide a fixed project quote, rather than an ongoing salary.



If i were to set a figure I'd be looking at $100-$500USD for one project or bonus all together. 



If applying for both projects, please provide separate quotes for the website and Notion workspace. Please also outline any ongoing software, hosting, ticketing or subscription costs.



PROJECT HANDOVER



Once completed, I would like:



- Full access and ownership of the website and Notion workspace

- All relevant logins and administrative permissions

- A short walkthrough or recorded tutorial explaining how to manage everything

- The ability to make basic changes independently

- A reasonable opportunity to review and request revisions before final approval



There may be opportunities for additional paid work in the future, but this is not a permanent role.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Examples of websites and/or Notion workspaces you've previously created.

3. Which project you're applying for: website, Notion or both.

4. Your recommended website platform and why.

5. Your estimated completion timeline.

6. Your fixed-price quote in USD or AUD, including the number of revisions offered.

7. Any questions you have about the project.



Please start your application with the words "IN GOOD COMPANY" so I know you've read the full description. I'm excited to find someone who can help bring these projects to life and potentially work together again as the businesses grow!



Vayva x

title: Part-Time Personal Virtual Assistant / Lifestyle Assistant – Cebu Preferred
description:
Personal Virtual Assistant / Lifestyle Assistant – Cebu Preferred



I'm looking for a reliable, proactive, and resourceful Personal Virtual Assistant to help me with everyday personal tasks, appointments, research, and general life administration.



I'm based in Cebu, Philippines, and I'm looking for someone I can build a long-term working relationship with.



This is a flexible, part-time position with a relatively light and irregular workload. It would be ideal for someone looking for an additional source of income alongside other commitments.



### Responsibilities



Your tasks may include:



- Researching and scheduling appointments with doctors, physiotherapists, dentists, and other service providers

- Calling local pharmacies to check medication availability and pricing

- Finding local professionals offering home visits or specialized services

- Contacting businesses via phone,
,
 Messenger, or WhatsApp

- Researching and comparing products, services, and prices

- Making reservations and coordinating bookings

- Following up with businesses and service providers

- Organizing deliveries and handling general personal administrative tasks

- Occasionally helping with local errands (optional, not required)



Tasks will vary depending on my needs. Some weeks may have several requests, while others may have none.



### Additional Opportunity: In-Person Errands (Highly Valued Bonus)



While this is primarily a remote position, being based in Cebu and having the ability to occasionally assist with in-person errands would be a significant advantage.



Examples of occasional errands include:



- Picking up items from pharmacies or local stores

- Purchasing or collecting products locally

- Handling other miscellaneous errands around Cebu



In-person errands would generally be included within the regular monthly working hours, just like remote tasks.



The monthly compensation covers up to 12 hours of work, regardless of whether tasks are performed remotely or in person. Reasonable transportation expenses and any necessary purchases will be reimbursed separately, with prior approval.



Travel and waiting time required for an approved errand will count toward the monthly working hours.



If a task requires additional hours beyond the monthly salary or involves unusual travel or significant effort, compensation can be discussed and agreed upon in advance.



In-person availability is completely optional and not a requirement for the position. However, candidates who can offer both remote assistance and occasional local support in Cebu will be strongly preferred.





### Requirements



Must-have:

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Fluent in Cebuano

- Comfortable making phone calls to businesses in the Philippines

- Reliable, proactive, organized, and detail-oriented

- Strong online research and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

- Comfortable communicating via WhatsApp

- Able to acknowledge requests within the same Philippine business day during agreed Monday–Friday availability

- Comfortable with a flexible workload and no fixed daily working hours



Nice-to-have:

- Based in Cebu City, Lapu-Lapu, Mandaue, or surrounding areas

- Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or Concierge

- Familiarity with local healthcare providers and businesses

- Willingness to occasionally handle in-person errands in Cebu



### Working Arrangement



- Primarily remote

- Flexible, long-term collaboration

- Approximately 8–12 hours of actual work per month

- No fixed daily working schedule

- Some weeks may have no tasks

- Requests should be acknowledged within the same Philippine business day during agreed availability

- Simple tasks should ideally be completed the same day when feasible

- More complex tasks may require additional time

- Communication primarily through WhatsApp

- Additional working hours and occasional in-person errands can be arranged separately



### Compensation



₱6,000 PHP per month, covering up to 12 hours of actual work.



Additional hours will be compensated separately at an agreed hourly rate.



The monthly compensation remains the same even when fewer than 12 hours of work are required.



This role is designed for someone who values flexibility and is interested in a stable, long-term arrangement with a light workload.



### What I'm Looking For



I don't want someone who simply sends me Google search results.



I'm looking for someone who takes ownership of tasks and independently finds solutions.



For example:



If I ask you to find a physiotherapist who offers home visits in Cebu, I'd expect you to research suitable providers, contact them, verify pricing and availability, and present me with the best options.



I value clear communication, reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to get things done without constant follow-ups.



### How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Where in the Philippines are you currently based?

2. Which languages do you speak fluently?

3. Do you have previous experience as a Personal Assistant, VA, or in a similar role?

4. Are you comfortable making phone calls to local businesses, pharmacies, and service providers?

title: Full-Time DTC Video Editor – Skincare Brand | $5–$6/Hour + Up to $1,000 Per Winning Video
description:
We are looking for a full-time DTC Video Editor to join our growing skincare brand.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make beautiful-looking videos.



We care about one thing above everything else:



Does the creative make people stop, watch, and buy?



A simple video that converts is far more valuable to us than a cinematic edit that doesn’t generate sales.



You need to understand direct-response creative structure: hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, offers, CTAs, and why people keep watching or scroll away.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, take ownership of their work, continuously improve, and grow with us long term.





Compensation & Bonuses:



Base pay is $5–$6 per hour, depending on your experience and skill level.



But your base salary is only one part of your earning potential.



We have a strong performance-based bonus system where editors can earn up to $1,000 from a single winning video.



In strong months, there is potential to earn 3–5x your base salary through performance bonuses.



When the brand performs better, we all make more money together.



We also offer:



- Performance bonuses for winning creatives

- Annual tenure / loyalty bonuses

- Additional performance-based rewards

- Opportunities for higher compensation as you grow with the company



We want the people who help us grow to benefit from that growth as well.





What You’ll Be Doing:



You will be creating English-language direct-response video ads for a skincare DTC brand.



Your job will include:



- Editing performance-focused DTC creatives

- Turning scripts, concepts, footage, UGC, B-roll, and AI-generated content into finished ads

- Creating strong hooks that stop the scroll

- Creating and integrating AI-generated video scenes

- Improving creatives based on feedback and performance

- Continuously learning what makes an ad convert



We don’t expect every creative to look like a movie.



We expect you to understand why an ad works.





What We’re Looking For:



Previous experience creating video ads for DTC / Shopify brands is REQUIRED.



Please do not apply if you have only edited YouTube videos, wedding videos, gaming videos, corporate videos, or traditional social media content without direct-response e-commerce experience.



You should:



- Have experience editing DTC performance creatives

- Understand hooks, CTAs, pacing, retention, storytelling, and direct-response advertising

- Have experience creating AI-generated video content

- Have hands-on experience with Higgsfield

- Have experience with ElevenLabs

- Be highly comfortable with CapCut and/or Adobe editing software

- Be able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions for everything

- Be open to feedback and willing to improve quickly

- Have a strong desire to learn and develop your creative skills

- Be interested in a long-term position rather than a short-term freelance project





We Invest in Your Growth:



We’re not looking for someone to simply complete tasks for us.



We’re looking for someone we can grow with for years.



We have a large amount of internal training, creative frameworks, examples, resources, and educational material that we will share with you.



We continuously invest in new training and education, and we want to help you become a significantly better direct-response editor and creative thinker over time.



The better you become, the better our creatives become.



And when our creatives perform better, everyone wins.





Working Style:



100% Remote



You can set your own working hours.



We care much more about ownership, communication, deadlines, consistency, and output than the exact hours you choose to work.



We want a teammate who takes responsibility for their work and treats the brand like something they are helping build, not someone who simply clocks in and waits for instructions.





Hiring Process:



1. Short Test Task



A short unpaid test task that should take approximately 2–4 hours.



You will complete the test using your own tools.



You will have 48 hours to complete it.



2. Two-Week Paid Trial



If you pass the test, you will move into a two-week paid trial period.



During the trial, you will be expected to work a minimum of 20 hours per week.



The trial is fully paid, and from this stage onward, we will provide access to the paid tools required for the role.



3. Regular Contract



If the trial goes well and we are both happy working together, you will move into a regular long-term contract at your full salary, with access to our performance bonus system.





How to Apply:



Please send us the following:



1. How many years have you been editing videos?



2. Send us your portfolio of creatives that you personally edited.

(Please prioritize DTC / e-commerce advertising work.)



3. Send us your 3 best-performing videos separately.

(We specifically want to see the three creatives you believe achieved the strongest results.)



4. Give us a brief summary of your experience with:



- Higgsfield

- Chatgpt/Gemini

- ElevenLabs

- Shopify / DTC brands





IMPORTANT:



Start your application with the words: "BLACK"



If your application does not start with BLACK, your application will not be read.

title: Appeal Reviewer (Content Moderation), part-time or full-time
description:
Content Rewards pays creators for short clips they post for brand campaigns. When a clip is rejected or an account is banned, the creator can appeal. We're hiring 3 to 4 careful, fair appeal reviewers to check the evidence and make the call using our written guide.



ROLE DETAILS

• Part-time (20 hours a week) or full-time (40 hours a week).

• Pay: $5–$7 USD an hour, depending on experience.

• Longer-term opportunities are available.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Review creator appeals of rejected clips: read the campaign's rules, check the creator's evidence (captions, analytics screenshots and recordings) and d
: overturn, keep rejected, ask for more information, or escalate.

• Write a short reason for every decision that another reviewer can follow.

• Write clear, kind replies to creators, including upset ones.

• Flag patterns, such as a campaign that may be rejecting clips unfairly.

• Work from a written guide and ask when unsure. Accuracy and consistency matter more than speed.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Fair judgment: you d
 on evidence, not on tone or on who is asking.

• Strong attention to detail: dates, video lengths, captions, matching evidence to the right clip.

• Clear written English and a calm, kind tone.

• Experience in content moderation, trust and safety, customer support, compliance, data review or QA is helpful.

• Knowing TikTok, Instagram Reels or YouTube Shorts analytics is a plus.

• A reliable computer and internet connection.

• If you post clips for paid campaigns yourself, you can still apply. Tell us, so you never review your own or your friends' appeals.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply here on OnlineJobs with a short note covering:

• Any moderation, support, review or QA work you have done.

• Part-time (20 hours a week) or full-time (40 hours a week).

• Your time zone, usual available hours and expected hourly rate in USD.



We reply to every applicant with the next step: a 35-minute practical exercise (ten fictional appeals, on a laptop or desktop, on your own and without AI tools) and a short Loom with your camera on.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
Job Title

Appointment Setter for Chiropractic and Wellness Clinics in Hawaii (On-Call, Speed to Lead)



About Us

We are a group of busy chiropractic and wellness clinics in Hawaii. People reach out to us every day looking for help with pain and better health, and we need someone fast, friendly and confident to call them back and get them booked.



The Role

This is not a typical shift job. You will not be sitting at a desk for 8 hours. Instead, you will be on call, and when a new lead comes in, you drop what you are doing and call them within 5 minutes.



Coverage hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM Hawaii time, Monday through Sunday. That is 2:00 AM to 2:00 PM Philippine time. **Please only apply if you can reliably respond within 5 minutes during these hours.**



What You Will Do

• Call every new lead within 5 minutes using the GoHighLevel app

• Follow our scripts, built on the NEPQ sales framework by Jeremy Miner

• Book appointments and help leads show up to their visit

• Learn and use our clinic scheduling and health record system (full training provided)

• Keep lead notes and statuses up to date in GoHighLevel



Who We Are Looking For

• Excellent spoken English with a warm, confident phone voice

• A true go-getter with a natural sales personality

• Someone who enjoys talking to people and is not afraid to ask for the booking

• Reliable, responsive and coachable

• Experience with GoHighLevel, NEPQ or healthcare is a plus but not required. We will train the right person.



Pay

• Base pay: $600 USD per month

• Bonus: $2 USD for every booked lead who shows up to their appointment: Should be having a show rate of 80-100 clients a month and growing fast. 

• With around 100 shows per month, a strong setter can earn about $800 USD per month

• Paid two-week trial period to start



Start Date

As soon as possible.



How to Apply

1. Start your application with the word "Aloha" so we know you read the full post.

2. Tell us in a few sentences why you would be great at this role.

3. Send a 60 to 90 second voice recording. Pretend you are calling someone who just filled out a form on our website about back pain. Introduce yourself, ask what made them reach out, and try to book them in for a visit. Let your personality shine. We want to hear the real you.

4. Confirm that you can respond to leads within 5 minutes between 2:00 AM and 2:00 PM Philippine time, seven days a week.

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Zoho CRM & Desk Developer / Integration Specialist (Project-Based)
description:

Job Overview



We are looking for an experienced Zoho Developer / Implementation Specialist to set up and customize Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, and related applications and integrate them with our in-house Internal Business System (IBS).



We operate multiple restaurant brands and locations across the United States. Our goal is to build a centralized customer support and communication system with secure integrations, automated workflows, and reporting.



This is initially a project-based position. The right candidate will be considered for ongoing, long-term engagement as we continue developing and expanding our business systems.

, IVR, voi

Preferred Skills

- Experience supporting multi-location or multi-brand businesses.



Work Requirements

title: Social Media Assistant
description:
Social Media Assistant (AI-Savvy) – Viral Research, Reels & Carousels for a Growing Faceless Brand | 20 hrs/week | Results-Based





PLEASE READ THIS FIRST



This is a serious role in a serious business. We are building Family Care Plan into a major brand, and this position is the engine of it. If you are looking for easy hours, a side gig you can ignore, or a job where nobody checks the work, please do not apply. We respect your time and ask you to respect ours.



We review results every single week. People who deliver, communicate honestly, and keep improving will be kept, given raises, and given more responsibility as we grow. People who don't will not be retained.



Honesty matters more to us than perfection. It is always better to tell us "I don't know how to do this" or "I'm going to be late" than to pretend and waste everyone's time.



If that sounds like you, keep reading. We'd love to meet you.





ABOUT US



Family Care Plan 
 is a faceless brand on Instagram, TikTok, and
 for adult children caring for an aging parent, often while working full-time, living far away, or raising their own kids.



Our founder has 10 years of hands-on experience as a home health aide in the United States. Our page teaches the practical side of caregiving: getting organized, coordinating the family, handoffs, and hard conversations. We sell a digital product (a printable care organizer), and we are building toward more products, partnerships, and more pages.



The topic is meaningful. Our followers are tired, stressed, and doing their best for their parents. Our content has to be useful, calm, and kind.





THE ROLE



You'll find what goes viral, figure out exactly why it works, and turn it into calm, useful Reels and carousels for our audience, then post them across all three platforms.





SCHEDULE AND PAY



- 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday (20 hours a week). Weekend posts are scheduled in advance.

- You must be available for 1 hour within an agreed daily window (for example, 7:00–8:00 PM Philippine time) for questions and approvals.

- Starting rate: $4 USD per hour, paid weekly or every two weeks, always on time.

- Paid trial first, at the same rate.

- Raises: $5/hour at 30 days and $6+/hour at 90 days if you consistently meet the weekly review targets.

- Performance bonuses for big results (for example, a Reel passing 100K views, or strong growth in
 sign-ups or sales).

- Long-term, ongoing work. As we grow, this role can grow into more hours, full-time, and leading content for the brand.





WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY DAY (about 4 hours)



1. Viral research (30 min)

Find outlier posts (500K+ views, or far above an account's normal) in caregiving, aging parents, the sandwich generation, family organizing, and related niches. Track 20+ competitor pages. Log every outlier in our Idea Base spreadsheet: link, views, hook, format, pillar, and why it worked.



2. Reverse engineering

Break each outlier down: the hook in the first 1–3 seconds, on-screen text, number of cuts, length, loop ending, and what makes people share or save it.



3. Reels (about 1.5 hours)

Edit 2 Reels a day in CapCut from our template: a strong text hook over calm, licensed stock B-roll, with captions, brand fonts, colors, and logo. 15–45 seconds each. Source clips from Pexels, Pixabay, and the Canva library.



4. Hooks and captions (30 min)

Write 3 hook options per Reel for the owner to choose from. Draft captions with Claude or ChatGPT, then edit them so they sound human, warm, and natural.



5. Posting (20 min)

Schedule approved posts across Instagram, TikTok, and
 at our best times. Post Stories.



6. Engagement (20 min)

Reply to simple comments using our approved templates. Flag anything emotional, sensitive, or medical to the owner. Check daily that our "comment CARE" automation is working.



7. Carousels (from week 3)

Design checklist and script carousels in Canva from our templates.





EVERY WEEK



- Trial Reels (once unlocked): post as a trial first, then to the main feed, and test different hooks.

- Repost proven winners at 90 and 180 days.

- Help coordinate 1 collab post a week with other caregiving pages (the owner approves partners).

- Weekly report and review (included in your hours): top 5 posts by shares, saves, and follows; what to double down on; what to drop; follower,
, and sales numbers; and next week's ideas.





HOW THE WEEKLY REVIEW WORKS



Every week we score your work out of 25 on five things: delivery on time, quality, following the rules, results, and communication.



- 20–25: On track. Eligible for raises and bonuses.

- 15–19: You'll get clear written feedback with 1–2 specific fixes.

- Under 15, or two weeks in a row under 20: Final review. If the next week doesn't improve, the engagement ends.

- A serious rule violation, or missing 2+ delivery days without notice, ends the engagement immediately.



In the first month, we judge delivery, quality, and rules most. Growth numbers carry more weight after day 30, because new pages take time to grow.





OUR NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES



- Faceless content only. No AI-generated people or AI avatars, ever.

- Licensed stock footage only. Never download or repost other creators' videos, TV, or movie clips.

- We remake proven formats with our own hook and angle. We never copy anyone's video, script, or caption word for word.

- No medical advice, ever: no symptoms, medications, doses, fall or transfer instructions, or diet advice.

- Nothing goes live without the owner's approval.

- We never share passwords. You'll get access through Meta Business Suite, a scheduler with team access, a shared Google Drive, and a Canva team.

- Everything you create for Family Care Plan belongs to the business and stays confidential.





YOU MUST HAVE



- Proven experience editing short-form video in CapCut (Reels or TikToks)

- Strong Canva skills

- Comfortable with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and able to edit their output so it sounds human

- A real understanding of how Reels and TikToks get reach: hooks, watch time, shares, and saves

- Excellent written English

- A reliable computer, stable internet, and a backup plan for outages (mobile data, power bank, or a backup location)

- Honesty, reliability, and the ability to take feedback and apply it





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience running or working on faceless or theme pages

- Experience with Meta Business Suite, Metricool or another scheduler, ManyChat, or Beehiiv

- Experience in health, family, or wellness niches

- Personal experience caring for a family member





WORK STANDARDS



- Reply to messages within 12 hours on workdays.

- Tell us at least 24 hours ahead if a deadline is at risk. No surprises.

- Give 48 hours' notice for time off, and 2 weeks' notice if you plan to leave.

- Track your hours honestly.

- Check every post before submitting: spelling, captions, timing, and branding.

- Always be kind and respectful to our followers. Never argue, mock, or use sarcasm.

- Bring at least 1 new idea or format to test every week.





HOW TO APPLY

(Applications that skip any step will not be reviewed.)



1. Start your application with the word "CARE" so we know you read everything.



2. Send links to:

- 3 Reels or TikToks you edited

- 1 carousel you designed

- An example of viral research, or a breakdown of why a post performed well



3. Answer these questions in your own words (please don't use AI for these):



a. Walk us through exactly how you'd find 5 viral posts in the caregiving niche this week. Which tools and searches would you use?



b. Pick any viral Reel you've seen recently. In 5–6 lines, explain why it went viral.



c. How do you use AI for captions without sounding robotic? Show one example edit.



d. How would you post to our Instagram, TikTok, and
 without ever having our passwords?



e. Someone comments, "My mom keeps falling at night, what should I do?" How do you handle it?



f. What's the difference between remaking a viral format and reposting someone's content?



g. If a Reel gets very few views in 24 hours, what would you check and change next time?



h. Are you available 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday, with a 1-hour daily overlap in the evening Philippine time? What's your backup plan for power or internet outages?





NEXT STEPS



Shortlisted applicants will receive a paid trial: research 3 viral posts, make 2 Reels and 1 carousel from our materials, and write hooks and captions. The trial is paid whether or not you're hired. The best trial gets the job.



We're building something big and meaningful. If you're serious, honest, and ready to grow with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Airbnb Guest Communications Specialist – Overnight (High Ownership)
description:
HOW TO APPLY: complete our application at 
/s/53du0aog (about 40 minutes). We only review applications submitted through this link; clicking Apply on OnlineJobs alone is not enough. If the link doesn't show, log in to OnlineJobs.ph or message us and we'll send it.



THIS IS NOT A SCRIPTED SUPPORT JOB.

RivetStays runs short-term rental homes for guests across North America (Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Expedia), 24/7. On your shift, you own guest issues from the first message to the fix: messages, calls, cleaners, maintenance and the decisions in between. You'll often work with incomplete information, and your calls have real consequences.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Handle guest messages and calls from start to finish: check-in problems, complaints, requests, reviews

• Coordinate cleaners, maintenance and vendors in real time when something breaks

• D
 refunds, credits and compensation for everyday issues, and record every decision accurately

• Keep reservations, listings and our systems accurate (Beds24, Breezeway, PriceLabs, ClickUp, Missive, RingCentral; we'll train you)

• Back-office work: expense and invoice tracking, discrepancy reporting

• Spot repeat problems and suggest fixes to the process, not just the ticket



HOW DECISIONS WORK

You handle routine guest issues on your own. For safety concerns, serious property damage or anything beyond your authority, you take immediate protective action and bring in the right person with a clear summary and recommendation. Your authority grows as your judgment proves itself.



HOW WE WORK

• We operate 24/7. Our team lead works Philippine daytime hours; on night shifts you are often the one on duty, and you hand off cleanly in the morning.

• We use AI every day. You should already use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar (free versions are fine), and know when its answer is wrong.



YOU'RE A FIT IF

• You can take in messy, complicated information and make a sound decision quickly

• You check the facts, act, and confirm the fix actually worked

• When something goes wrong, you contain it fast, tell the right people, and own what happened, including your own mistakes

• You catch the detail everyone else misses

• You never leave a mess for the next shift: open issues are finished or handed off with a clear note



DON'T APPLY IF

• You need a script for everything

• You escalate every decision instead of making it

• You want to clock in, answer messages and clock out



REQUIREMENTS

• Clear written and spoken English

• 60 hours per week on our 24/7 schedule, including overnight Philippine time, weekends and holidays

• Quiet workspace, reliable computer with webcam and headset, stable internet and a backup connection

• Short-term rental or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement



PAY

• Starts at US$4 per hour; raises are based on your performance with us

• Two-week paid training at US$4/hour

• Contract role, 60 hours per week; extra hours are paid



HIRING PROCESS

1. Online application (about 35 minutes): a few quick questions, your resume, and a 30-minute realistic shift exercise. AI tools are allowed; you are responsible for every fact in your answer. You'll need a computer with a webcam.

2. If shortlisted: a short AI video interview and a 10-minute reasoning test (about 30 minutes, no AI)

3. Interview with HR (about 30 minutes), including a live guest-call exercise and a short practical AI task

4. Final conversation with the owner

5. Two-week paid training

title: Media Buyer/Executive Assistant
description:
Media Buyer / Executive Assistant

Remote, 12 AM to 8 AM Eastern



The role

Two jobs in one. You’ll run the day-to-day media buying on our Meta ad account, and you’ll keep our whole operation tidy and moving as my executive assistant.



Media buying



Launch ads, following our naming and setup standards.

Handle ad rejections: find the cause, fix it and resubmit.

Relaunch ads that need it.

Watch the account through your shift: ads live, spending properly and delivering.

Check performance, and flag anything I should know about, like spend that’s off, delivery that stops, or errors.



Executive assistant and operations



Keep Notion, Frame and the ad account in sync, and make sure everything is named and organised properly.

Make sure our editors always have work in their queue, and flag it when a queue runs low or something is stuck.

Check that cards are in the right stage, files are in the right folders, and nothing is falling through the cracks.

Keep trackers up to date, and send me a short Slack summary at the end of each shift covering what you launched, fixed and flagged.



What we’re looking for



Media buying experience on Meta Ads Manager. You should be able to launch ads, fix policy rejections and relaunch without hand-holding.

Very organised, with an eye for detail. You notice when something’s out of place.

Reliable and able to work independently.

Strong written English and comfortable using Slack.

Available 12 AM to 8 AM Eastern with stable internet.

title: Experienced Video Editor
description:
Long-Form YouTube Editor for Finance Education Channel (Documentary Style)



Type of employment:

Part Time



Job description:



About the channel



I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners ($2M-$20M revenue) secure growth capital for buyouts, acquisitions, expansions, and debt restructures. I’m building a YouTube channel that explains how business financing actually works: why banks say no, how lenders read a P&L, how a $2M deal actually gets structured, and the parts of the money system nobody explains to business owners.



The audience is business owners, operators, and people who want to understand capital. The tone is an insider pulling back the curtain. Not hype, not “get rich,” not finance-bro content. Think of it as the finance channel that respects the viewer’s intelligence.



I’m looking for a long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention videos that match a specific visual style.



The video style (this is the important part)



Every video follows the same visual language. Before you apply, make sure this is a style you can execute and enjoy:



Documentary feel, not vlog feel. Think clean, cinematic, deliberate. Reference the pacing and polish of channels like Johnny Harris, Ali Abdaal’s long-form explainers, and the Hormozi-style business breakdowns. Confident cuts, no jump-cut chaos.

High contrast, dark and clean. Deep navy and black backgrounds, gold accents for emphasis. Minimal color palette. Everything looks expensive and intentional.

Numbers on screen, always. This is a finance channel, so every key figure ($2M deal, 60 days, 27-point approval gap) appears as bold on-screen text the moment I say it. Big, clean, sans-serif, animated in with subtle motion.

Charts and explainers that teach. When I explain a concept (DSCR, a capital stack, why a bank declined a file), you build a simple animated graphic that makes it click: bars rising, a flow diagram, a before-and-after comparison. Simple beats fancy. The graphic exists to make the idea land, not to show off.

Captions on everything. Clean, readable, styled to match the brand. Key phrases highlighted.

B-roll that’s relevant and original. Screen recordings, documents, my own footage, custom graphics. No generic stock footage of handshakes and skylines. If a visual doesn’t add meaning, it doesn’t go in.

Hooks that hold. The first 30 seconds are tight and visual: the claim, the number, the question, on screen fast. You understand retention curves and cut for them.

No gimmicks. No zoom-in-every-3-seconds, no meme sound effects, no over-edited energy. Calm authority. The edit should feel like the viewer is being let in on something.



If you can watch a 15-minute Johnny Harris or a Hormozi breakdown and explain why the edit holds attention, you’ll understand what I’m after.



What you’ll do



Edit 1-2 long-form videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw talking-head footage I record, plus a script for each

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from the hook to the close

Build the on-screen text, number callouts, captions, and simple animated charts and explainers that illustrate financial concepts

Build clean intros, chapter cards, transitions, and end screens in the brand style

Source or create relevant B-roll (screen recordings, documents, graphics), never generic stock

Deliver a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Study my past videos and the reference channels I share, match the style, then improve on it over time

Flag anything in the footage that could be stronger (a better order, a cut that would hold attention better). I want an editor with opinions.



What I’m looking for



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you’ve personally cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts: you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds

Clean motion graphics and text animation (simple, professional, consistent)

Comfortable turning numbers I give you into simple charts and visual explainers

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (After Effects a plus)

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance and business content (no finance background required, but you take the material seriously and ask when you don’t understand a concept)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from long-form (Opus Clip, Vizard), or experience with educational/explainer channels



How we’ll work



Paid trial: you’ll edit one long-form video from footage and a script I provide, so we can both see if the fit is right

Clear brief and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.

Consistent weekly volume. This is a steady role, not one-off gigs.



To apply, include



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes). Educational, finance, business, or documentary-style content preferred.

One sentence on why the edit in your best sample holds attention

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words “CAPITAL VAULT” so I know you read the full post.



I’m looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping, thumbnails, and a larger content operation as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time





:





Business or Contact Name (public):

The Capital Vault



Skills (select up to 3):

Video Editing, Motion Graphics, YouTube Content Creation



Notification:

Send a daily
 summary of my job post applications

description:
Headquarters: Remote

title: ob title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor for Finance Founder -
description:
I run The Capital Vault, a US-based capital advisory that helps established business owners secure growth capital. I'm building a YouTube channel around that business, educational videos that explain how business financing actually works, and I need a skilled long-form editor who can turn my raw talking-head recordings into polished, high-retention YouTube videos.



What you'll do:



Edit 1-2 long-form YouTube videos per week (8-20 minutes final length) from raw footage I record

Cut filler, tighten pacing, and structure the video so retention holds from hook to close

Add captions, on-screen text for key numbers and phrases, charts and simple graphics to illustrate financial concepts, and relevant B-roll

Build clean intros, chapter transitions, and end screens

Match a consistent brand style: clean, high contrast, professional, documentary feel, no over-edited gimmicks

Turn around a first cut within 48-72 hours, revisions within 24

Use my past videos and reference channels I share as a style guide, and improve on them over time



What I'm looking for:



2+ years editing long-form YouTube content, with a portfolio of 8-20 minute videos you've cut

Strong storytelling and pacing instincts (you know how to hold attention for 15 minutes, not just 15 seconds)

Clean caption, text, and simple motion graphics work

Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

Comfortable creating simple charts and visual explainers from numbers I give you

Reliable, communicative, and able to work independently from a brief

Comfortable with finance/business content (no finance background needed, but you take the material seriously)

Bonus: thumbnail design, short-form clipping from the long-form, or experience with Opus Clip or Vizard



How we'll work:



Paid trial: you'll edit one long-form video from footage I provide so we can see if the fit is right

Clear briefs and script for every video, feedback in writing, workflow in Slack

Payment every two weeks via bank transfer

Original B-roll and graphics only. No generic stock footage.



To apply, include:



Links to 3-5 long-form YouTube videos you edited (8+ minutes)

Your editing software

Your availability per week and your rate



Start your application with the words "CAPITAL VAULT" so I know you read this.



I'm looking for someone to grow with. If the trial goes well, this becomes a steady long-term role, with the option to expand into short-form clipping and thumbnails as the channel grows.



Wage/Salary:

$500-$900/month (part-time, based on experience and output), with growth to full-time



Desired number of hours per week:

20

title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA
description:
Pay: $3.5/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day (40 hours/week)

Position: Full-Time Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Product Sourcing VA



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED.



Do NOT apply if you have never sourced profitable products for Amazon FBA before. I am specifically looking for someone who already understands Amazon product sourcing and can work independently.



You should already know how to analyze Amazon listings, research suppliers, verify websites, check sellers and competition, calculate profit, and determine whether a product is actually worth purchasing.



YOUR MAIN JOB



You must provide 5 VALID ASINs per day.



That equals 25 valid ASINs per week.



Finding 5 random products does NOT count. Products must meet ALL of my requirements and pass my review.



If some of your daily ASINs are rejected, you have until the end of the week/payday to replace them and reach the required 25 valid ASINs.



25 approved ASINs per week is the minimum requirement — not just 25 submissions.



BONUSES 💰



I reward VAs who consistently provide good leads and help me grow the business.



You can earn additional bonuses for:



Consistently finding valid ASINs: If your leads regularly pass my review and meet all requirements, you can receive performance bonuses.



More than 25 approved ASINs: If you finish your required 25 valid ASINs early and continue finding additional approved products, you can receive a bonus for exceeding your weekly target.



High-quality sourcing: VAs who consistently find products that I actually purchase and successfully sell will have opportunities for additional bonuses and higher pay over time.



Quality still matters. Adding random ASINs just to go above 25 will NOT earn a bonus. Extra ASINs must meet the same requirements as your normal submissions and pass my review.



PRODUCT REQUIREMENTS



Every product you submit must:



Be a brand I am already approved/ungated to sell.



Make at least $2 profit per unit



Have at least 100 estimated sales per month



NOT be a generic brand



Have realistic competition where I can actually get sales (will provide you with an example chart for criteria)



Have enough room for me to enter the listing without immediately destroying the price



Come from a REAL, TRUSTWORTHY SOURCE



Be in stock and actually available to purchase



Match the EXACT Amazon product/variation



Include the correct source link



Include the correct Amazon ASIN/listing



Not already have been submitted by another VA on my team



ROI is NOT my main requirement. I care more about actual dollar profit, sales volume, competition, and whether I can realistically sell the inventory.



QUANTITY MATTERS



Do NOT submit deals that only become profitable when purchasing an unrealistic quantity.



Example:



If a product only meets my requirements when buying 25 units, but the Amazon listing only sells around 50 units per month and has 20 competing sellers, I am obviously not going to purchase 25 units.



Use common sense.



Look at:



Monthly sales + number of sellers + competition + minimum purchase quantity.



The deal needs to make sense for MY business, not just look profitable on a spreadsheet.



SOURCE VERIFICATION IS EXTREMELY IMPORTANT



You MUST verify every website before submitting it.



I recently had a VA provide a fake website that looked like a major retailer. A purchase was made from the website and the card information was compromised.



That cannot happen again.



Before submitting ANY unfamiliar website, verify that it is legitimate.



Do NOT submit:



Fake retailer websites



Scam websites



Copycat websites



Suspicious Shopify stores



Random websites with no established reputation



Sources you have not properly researched



A retailer/distributor different from the one you put in the spreadsheet



If you are unsure whether a source is legitimate, DO NOT SUBMIT IT. Ask me first.



QUALITY > RANDOM LEADS



I would rather receive 5 strong ASINs than 20 bad ones.



Do not fill the spreadsheet just to hit your number.



Repeatedly submitting products that clearly violate the requirements will result in termination.



YOU SHOULD ALREADY KNOW



You should have previous experience with:



Amazon Seller Central



Amazon FBA



Online Arbitrage



Product sourcing



Keepa



SellerAmp SAS or similar tools (we will be using stealth seller)



Buy Box analysis



Sales rank / estimated monthly sales



Amazon fees



Profit calculations



Seller/competition analysis



Variation matching



Source verification



Checking whether Amazon is on the listing



Identifying dangerous price drops or listings with too much competition



Amazon seller storefront sourcing / storefront stalking



You should NOT need me to teach you the basics of Amazon sourcing.



HOURS



Monday–Friday

8 hours per day

40 hours per week



This is a long-term position for the right person.



Starting pay is $3.5/hour, but strong performance can earn you bonuses and opportunities for increased pay.



The better the products you find and the more value you bring to the business, the more opportunity you have to earn.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT send me a generic copy-and-paste application.



Start your application with:



“I HAVE AMAZON SOURCING EXPERIENCE”



Then answer these questions:



How long have you been sourcing products for Amazon?



Have you done Online Arbitrage before?



What sourcing tools have you used?



Do you know how to use Keepa? Explain what you normally check on a Keepa chart.



Do you know how to use Stealth seller or SellerAMP?



How do you determine whether there are too many sellers on a listing?



How do you verify that a sourcing website is legitimate?



How do you determine how many units of a product you would recommend buying?



What is the difference between profit and ROI?



Have you used Amazon seller storefronts to find additional profitable products? Explain your process.



Send an example of an Amazon sourcing spreadsheet you have worked with before, with any confidential client information removed.



FINAL TEST: Include one example ASIN + source link that you believe would be worth researching for Online Arbitrage. Briefly explain why you chose it.



If you cannot answer these questions, please do not apply.



I am looking for someone who already knows what they are doing, pays attention to details, follows instructions, verifies their sources, and can consistently find products that I can actually buy and sell.

title: 3D Visualiser – Photorealistic Renders from SketchUp – Australian Residential – PHP 70–90k/month
description:
Builder of custom and architectural homes, knockdown-rebuilds and commercial projects in Melbourne. We need a 3D visualiser whose renders look like photos of the finished home, good enough that a client signs off on finishes from them.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

A client should not be able to tell your render from a photo. Correct scale, real materials (stone, timber, tile, render, cladding), accurate lighting for the time of day, believable furniture and landscaping, and camera angles a real photographer would use. Interiors and exteriors, day and dusk.



SKETCHUP – REQUIRED

Our models come to you in SketchUp (some from ArchiCAD via export). You must work confidently from SketchUp files every day. If you can't render from SketchUp, please don't apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take SketchUp models and produce photorealistic interior and exterior renders

- Apply real product finishes from our selections (colours, tiles, benchtops, cladding, fixtures)

- Produce render sets for client presentations, marketing and our website

- Produce walkthrough or flythrough videos where a job needs it

- Clean up and fix imported models so they render correctly

- Turn revisions around quickly from our designer's markups

- Work with our designer and project team



TOOLS

- Essential: SketchUp plus at least one of V-Ray, Enscape, Lumion, D5 Render or Twinmotion

- Nice to have: ArchiCAD, Photoshop post-production, 3ds Max / Corona, Unreal Engine



ABOUT YOU

- A portfolio of your MOST REALISTIC work on real residential projects, interiors and exteriors

- You understand light, materials and composition, not just software settings

- Fast AND accurate. We will ask how long each render took, and we will check.

- Clear written English; you take review comments well and turn them around quickly

- A machine that handles heavy scenes (32 GB RAM, strong dedicated graphics card, SSD) and stable, fast internet



HOURS AND PAY

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, overlapping Victorian business hours (Victoria is 2–3 hours ahead of Manila)

- PHP 70,000–90,000 per month, set by the realism and speed of your work

- 4-week paid trial, then a long-term role with a growing builder



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs. Applications missing any item below will not be assessed.



Subject line, exactly:  RENDER-SKP – [Your Full Name]



Include:

1. Your CV

2. A portfolio link showing your 5 MOST REALISTIC renders (interior and exterior) from real projects

3. For two of those renders, the SketchUp model screenshot next to the final render, as Google Drive links

4. Which render engine you used for each, and how many hours each took from model to final image

5. What work or clients are you committed to now, and what notice would you need? What are your PC specs (graphics card) and internet speed?



We read every application that follows the brief, and we will invite shortlisted applicants to a short paid test render.

title: VIDEO PODCAST EDITOR (DESCRIPT)
description:
REMOTE VIDEO PODCAST EDITOR (DESCRIPT)

Freelance | Philippines-Based | 2-4 Episodes per Month



We are a Singapore-based medical and wellness brand looking for an experienced video editor for an ongoing interview podcast.



Each episode is roughly 60-90 minutes of conversation with two or three speakers. We record remotely in Descript Rooms with multiple cameras and separate audio tracks, and you will edit inside our own Descript Drive. You must already know how to work in Descript, including footage recorded in Descript Rooms. This is a firm requirement.



DELIVERABLES FOR EACH EPISODE

- One professionally edited 60-90 minute YouTube episode

- 6-7 vertical Shorts/Reels from the strongest moments, each with accurate, readable captions

- YouTube thumbnail graphic

- Episode title graphic

- Quote graphics for social media (for the guest and for our own channels)



The finished content should feel polished, intelligent, modern and premium. We prefer clean, restrained editing, not excessive animations or gimmicky social-media styling. The Shorts must not be random extracts: you need to find compelling moments that stand alone and make people want to watch the full conversation.



MEDICAL CONTENT STANDARDS

The podcast covers medical, aesthetic, health and wellness topics. Accuracy matters. Medical terms in captions and graphics must be spelled correctly, names and treatments must not be guessed, and nothing may be edited in a way that changes the speaker's medical meaning. Flag anything uncertain instead of guessing. AI tools are fine for speeding up transcription and clip finding, but all output must be reviewed and corrected by you.



TURNAROUND

- Confirm receipt of files within 12 hours and report any missing or damaged files immediately

- First full-length edit within 4 working days

- Full package (Shorts and graphics) within 6 working days

- Revisions back within 2 working days, up to 2 reasonable revision rounds per episode



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- Proven experience editing in Descript, including recordings made in Descript Rooms

- At least 2 years of professional video editing

- Long-form interviews, podcasts or multicamera conversations with 2-3 speakers

- Strong audio cleanup (noise reduction, EQ, balancing speakers)

- Good judgement on pacing, camera selection and short-form moments

- Excellent written English and caption accuracy

- Reliable high-speed internet for large video files

- Capacity for 2-4 episodes per month



COMPENSATION

- US$150 per episode, including the full package above and up to 2 revision rounds

- Around 2-4 episodes per month to start

- Payment by bank transfer: one transfer at the end of each month covering all episodes delivered that month

- Long-term opportunity for the right editor; rate reviewed if the workload grows materially



PAID EDITING TEST

Shortlisted applicants get a paid test using supplied footage: edit a short multicamera segment in Descript, clean the audio, and produce one captioned vertical Short plus a simple title graphic. The test fee is US$25, paid by bank transfer once you submit the completed test.



HOW TO APPLY

1. A short introduction covering your relevant experience, specifically your work in Descript

2. Links to at least 3 long-form podcasts or interviews you have edited

3. At least 3 examples of vertical podcast clips or Shorts

4. Which parts of each example you personally completed

5. Examples of thumbnail or quote graphics you have made, if any

6. Your computer specs and approximate internet speed

7. Your normal turnaround for a 60-90 minute multicamera podcast

8. Confirmation you can handle 2-4 episodes per month

9. The word "horizon" at the start of your application to confirm you read the whole ad



Generic applications without relevant podcast examples will not be considered.

title: CREATIVE AI VIDEO EDITOR | E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME
description:
CREATIVE AI VIDEO EDITOR | E-COMMERCE ADS | FULL-TIME



Brand: Women’s Jewelry

Pay: $2,000/month base + performance bonuses, up to $4,000/month total

Commitment: 40 hours per week, exclusive to our brand



THE ROLE



We’re looking for a creative, versatile video editor with advanced AI production skills and a strong understanding of direct-response advertising.



You’ll work to create short-form Meta and TikTok ads using custom footage, AI-generated content, or both. Your work should capture attention, communicate our products’ value, and drive purchases.



Formats include AI podcast ads, realistic AI UGC, street interviews, song ads, Pixar-style animation, product demonstrations, and hybrid edits.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• Relevant experience: At least 2 years editing e-commerce video ads for Meta and TikTok, supported by a strong portfolio.



• Advanced AI skills: Hands-on proficiency with Higgsfield or comparable platforms, including generating and refining video, images, voices, music, and lip sync.



• Creative range: Ability to produce different editing styles and turn briefs into complete ads, including generating assets from scratch.



• Direct-response knowledge: Strong hooks, clear benefits, effective pacing, readable captions, sound design, and compelling CTAs.



• Efficient execution: Ability to apply strategist feedback, meet deadlines, and quickly produce meaningful variations based on performance insights.



• Technical proficiency: Strong skills in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar software. CapCut proficiency is a major plus.



• Attention to detail: Natural-looking AI outputs, accurate jewelry designs and gold tones, error-free text, and correct aspect ratios and safe zones.



• Accountability: Clear English communication, organized project files, proactive problem-solving, and ownership of quality.



OUR CUSTOM FOOTAGE LIBRARY



We have an extensive library of original, custom footage. You must familiarize yourself with it quickly, select the strongest scenes for each concept, and creatively combine clips into engaging ads that convert.



Repeatedly recycling the same handful of clips while relevant footage goes unused makes a lack of preparation apparent. Editors who consistently fail to explore and use our assets effectively will not continue in the role.



WORKING EXPECTATIONS AND TOOLS



• Exclusive commitment: No other jobs, freelance clients, or agency commitments. Individual applicants only; outsourcing is not permitted.



• Hubstaff: All hours worked must be tracked, with work activity monitoring enabled.



• U.S. working-hour overlap: Will be discussed once hired.



• AI subscriptions: All subscriptions needed for the role will be provided.



COMPENSATION AND BONUSES



Base salary: $2,000/month.



Bonuses are available for up to two qualifying winning ads per month. Each qualifying ad must have at least $10,000 in ad spend and at least 14 days active.



Bonus per qualifying ad:



• 2.00–2.49 ROAS: $500

• 2.50–2.99 ROAS: $750

• 3.00+ ROAS: $1,000



Maximum monthly bonus: $2,000.

Maximum total monthly compensation: $4,000.



HOW TO APPLY



You MUST use a minimum of 10 Apply Points. Applications submitted with fewer than 10 Apply Points will not be reviewed or considered.



Include all of the following:



1) Your resume/CV and portfolio: Direct links to your strongest e-commerce ads for Meta or TikTok.



2) Two AI ad examples in different formats: Include one realistic human-led ad, such as UGC, a podcast, or a street interview, and one different format, such as animation or a song ad. For each, explain your contribution, tools used, and approximate production time.



3) Your workflow: Explain how you create a 15–45-second ad from a brief, including projects without usable source footage, and how you handle feedback and rapid iterations.



4) Your toolkit: List your editing and AI software, describe your Higgsfield and CapCut experience, and explain your preferred AI tools and why.



5) Your availability and confirmations: State your earliest start date and confirm your commitment to 40 exclusive hours per week, Hubstaff tracking and monitoring, and an unpaid practical editing exercise using footage provided.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to walk us through one portfolio project. Applications must include the requested materials and confirmations to be considered.
