title: Trailer Management Admin
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Thursday - Monday 11 PM - 9 AM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Hubstaff time tracking during shifts.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

This is not a general admin VA role. Please read the two requirements below before applying.



REQUIRED, both of these:

1) Prior dispositions experience in US real estate. You have personally moved wholesale contracts to cash buyers.

2) You have sourced deals through real estate agents. Specific properties that came to you through an agent relationship and went to contract.

A PLUS, NOT REQUIRED:

Rehab project management. If you have personally run a renovation - the scope, the budget, the contractors, the timeline - tell us and it counts in your favour. If you have not, it will not rule you out. We are hiring on dispositions first.



You will be:

- Chasing the missing photos, reports and contracts from wholesalers

- Building and qualifying the buyer list, then presenting deals to named buyers by phone

- Quoting prices, handling objections and negotiating assignments through to signature

- Building an agent network and sourcing deals through it

- Running rehab projects: scopes of work, contractor bids, budget and timeline tracking, progress reporting



Requirements:

- Excellent, clear English, confident on the phone with US buyers, agents and contractors

- Able to work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time (40 hours per week)

- Comfortable in a real estate CRM. We use Podio. Podio, InvestorFuse, GoHighLevel, REISift, Salesforce or similar all count

Pay: US$6 per hour plus commission.



To apply, please reply with the following FIVE things:

1) A short video or audio introducing yourself in English, covering your dispositions experience and ONE deal you sourced through a real estate agent (Loom, Vocaroo, Google Drive, or unlisted YouTube). APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO OR AUDIO WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

2) How many wholesale contracts you have personally dispositioned, over what period, and in which markets.

3) One deal you got from a real estate agent, from the first conversation through to a signed contract.

4) If you have managed a rehab project, describe one: the scope, the budget, the timeline, and what went wrong. If you have not managed one, just say so - it will not count against you.

5) How many years you have worked in US real estate, and confirmation that you can work Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

We’re a small, mission-driven team that moves fast and takes pride in the experience we deliver to our participants.



The Role



We’re looking for a fast, reliable, detail-oriented Photo Moderator to review user-submitted photos across our competition brands. You’ll use our automated moderation system to make sure every entry meets our photo standards. This is a remote, task-based role focused on execution. You’ll follow an established moderation guide, and accuracy, consistency, and good judgment are what this role is all about. You’ll be one of several moderators working together to keep entries processed on time.



Primary Responsibilities



•       Moderate competition entry photos, including the main entry photo and, in some cases, the user’s profile photo

•       Use our automated moderation system to approve, reject, crop, and/or rotate entries

•       Make sure every approved entry meets our documented standards

•       Work through entry photos assigned in batches of 10. Batches take about 10–30 seconds each, on average.

•       Moderate about 50,000 images per month



Volume



We receive 1,000–6,000 entries per day, up to 200,000 entries per month. Multiple moderators share this volume to keep processing timely.



What We’re Looking For



•       Strong attention to detail. Making the right approve or reject call and cropping and rotating correctly matter.

•       Ability to work quickly and accurately through high-volume, repetitive tasks

•       Good judgment in applying written standards consistently

•       Reliable and self-directed, comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

•       Comfortable navigating web-based tools

•       Previous content or entry moderation experience is a plus



Tools You’ll Use



•       Our automated entry moderation system

•       Slack — for team communication

Training and a moderation guide will be provided.



Details



•       Location: Remote

•       Type: Part-time, ongoing (3+ months)

•       Schedule: Flexible. Work at your own pace, as long as you meet the monthly volume.

•       Compensation: Starting base pay of $500/month, with an expected volume of 50,000 images moderated per month



To Apply



Please include in your application:

•       A brief description of any moderation, data review, or similar high-volume detail work you’ve done

•       Your general availability (hours per day)



We’re a small team that values reliability, thoughtfulness, and people who genuinely care about getting the details right. If that sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

title: US Live Fleet Command Dispatcher (Accent-Free American English + High IQ + Decisive Leader)
description:
🚨 READ THIS FIRST: We are NOT looking for a passive, script-reading customer service agent, and we are NOT looking for a quiet virtual assistant who waits around to be told what to do.



We are hiring 1 to 2 sharp, decisive, high-IQ **Live Fleet Command Dispatchers** for our 100+ vehicle US commercial fleet operation (US Eastern Time Zone). 



We want natural leaders who take charge of a room—professionals who combine:



1) **Clean, Zero-Accent American-Neutral Spoken English** (clear on the very first sentence),



2) **A High IQ (110–120+ / Top 15% Mental Speed)** with fast mental math and map logic,



3) **A Decisive, Thick-Skinned, "Take-Charge" Personality** (warm and magnetic, but firm and unshakeable under pressure), AND



4) **A Polished, Camera-Ready Professional Presence** (dressed for work at a clean, well-lit desk—no pajamas).



⚠️ Applications missing the 90-second ON-CAMERA VIDEO or the required test screenshots at the bottom will be skipped automatically.



---



WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY



We coordinate 600+ time-sensitive daily dispatches and handle 600–700+ live phone calls every weekday. We do NOT take retail consumer calls—100% of your phone work is high-speed B2B and internal command coordination:



• **Negotiating with US Corporate Account Partners:** Answering fast-paced live GPS ETA requests, accepting urgent same-day orders, and protecting strict 60-minute arrival windows.



• **Commanding 100+ US Field Drivers:** Directing drivers via VoIP phone (including live 3-way conference calls and rapid warm transfers) and live chat—holding drivers accountable to their schedules, overcoming pushback, and rerouting around breakdowns or traffic in seconds.



• **Multi-Line Triage & Live Map Control:** Juggling a busy multi-line VoIP queue (zero declined calls and zero blind transfers) while entering exact timestamps and calculating drive-time ripples on a live GPS map.



• **Live On-Camera Team Collaboration:** Our shift pods work together inside live video/audio rooms during shifts. You must be camera-ready, alert, and fully engaged from the first minute of your shift to the last.



*(You do NOT need prior experience with our specific GPS routing software—if you have a high IQ, master VoIP phones, and know how to lead people under pressure, we will teach you our software in days.)*



---



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS (DO NOT APPLY IF YOU MISS ANY OF THESE)



1. **Clean, Neutral Spoken English (Zero Heavy Accent):**

   - Impatient US corporate account reps and blue-collar US drivers must understand every word you say effortlessly on the first sentence without ever asking you to repeat yourself.



2. **High-Velocity Call Center / Live Dispatch Stamina (2+ Years):**

   - You thrive on heavy phone action (handling 80–100+ calls/day with a crisp 2–3 minute handle time and 0% missed/declined calls).



   - **Strongly Preferred Backgrounds:



** US Emergency Roadside Assistance (**Agero**, AAA, towing dispatch), US Auto Insurance Claims (**GEICO, USAA, Progressive**), US Logistics/Trucking/Courier Dispatch (**Senpex, Samsara**, fleet control), Airline Irregular Operations, or 911/Urgent Triage.



3. **Thick Skin & Assertive Backbone (No Conflict-Avoidant Personalities):



**- We run a fast, direct, high-accountability American command floor. If a tired driver tries to talk you out of a 3:00 PM pickup, you don't fold—you charm them, hold your ground firmly, and make sure the job gets done. If you are timid, hate conflict, or get easily offended by stressed callers or direct coaching, this role is NOT for you.



4. **High IQ (110+ Minimum / 115+ Preferred) & 55+ WPM Typing Speed:**

   - You can calculate drive times + wait windows in your head while talking on the phone and typing accurate notes at 55+ WPM without losing your train of thought.



5. **100% Exclusive Full-Time Commitment (Zero Moonlighting):**

  

 - Because we operate in US Eastern Time (EST), you must maintain a dedicated sleep schedule and be 100% sharp during US afternoon/closing hours. No second jobs, no overlapping freelance clients, and no household distractions during shift hours



6. **Hardware & Workspace Standards:**

   

- Core i5/i7 or Ryzen 5/7, **16GB RAM preferred** (8GB strict minimum), **DUAL MONITORS**, wired Fiber Internet (50+ Mbps, low ping) + backup power/internet, USB noise-canceling headset, and a quiet, well-lit room.



---



### HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW THESE 4 STEPS EXACTLY)



Send your application with the subject line:



**"COMMAND PRO – [Your Full Name] – [IQ Score] – [Typing WPM]"**



*(Example: "COMMAND PRO – Juan Dela Cruz – IQ 118 – 68 WPM")*



Include these 4 items in your message:



**1. 90-Second ON-CAMERA VIDEO INTRO (REQUIRED — Paste 
, Google Drive, or Unlisted YouTube Link):**

*Camera Rules:* Sit at your desk in good lighting wearing neat, professional work attire (collared shirt or business casual top—no pajamas, no undershirts, no dark rooms) with your headset on. Look straight into the camera lens (do NOT read a script off your screen!) and cover:

   

• **Part A (30 sec):** Introduce yourself, share your toughest US voice/dispatch experience (roadside, claims, logistics, fleet), and tell us how you handle multi-line call surges without declining calls.

  

• **Part B (30 sec — Live Roleplay on Camera):** Pretend I am "Driver Mike" calling you right now saying: *"Hey, I see you just put an urgent 3:00 PM pickup on my route. I'm tired and heading home early, give it to somebody else."* Respond to me live on camera—show us your charisma, warmth, AND your firm, unshakeable backbone!

   

• **Part C (30 sec — Explain Out Loud):** Tell us how you use a live 3-way VoIP conference call when a corporate client says a customer is waiting outside, but your driver says nobody is there—AND tell us your answer to **Question 3A** below out loud!

title: Full-Time Senior Bookkeeper | AU
description:
PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:



1. You do not have at least 5 years of hands-on Australian bookkeeping or accounting experience. General accounting experience outside Australia does not count towards this requirement.



2. You have never independently managed Australian payroll, including employee setup, weekly payroll processing, PAYG withholding and superannuation.



3. You are not confident with Australian GST, BAS and other relevant taxation requirements.



4. You do not have strong, hands-on experience using Xero, including bank reconciliations, accounts payable and accounts receivable.



5. You have no practical experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.



6. You require constant supervision, regular reminders or step-by-step instructions to manage your daily responsibilities.



7. You are uncomfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment where accuracy, urgency and accountability are essential.



------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We are looking for an experienced, highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented end-to-end Bookkeeper to join a fast-paced Australian business.



This is a hands-on role for someone who stays on top of things in real time. You will be responsible for keeping financial records accurate and current throughout the day, monitoring incoming communications, reconciling accounts, identifying discrepancies and making sure nothing falls through the cracks.



We operate in a high-pressure, fast-moving environment, so we need someone who can keep up, remain accurate under pressure and proactively follow through on outstanding matters without needing constant reminders.



What You'll Do

- Complete daily bank and account reconciliations as a priority.

- Monitor the accounts inbox throughout the working day and action financial matters promptly.

- Monitor incoming customer payments and ensure invoices are marked as paid as soon as payment is received and verified.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare weekly payroll including setting up new staff in Xero.

- Process, check and allocate supplier invoices and customer payments accurately.

- Record foreign currency invoices.

- Monitor overdue invoices and proactively follow up outstanding payments.

- Identify and investigate duplicate payments, incorrect invoices, overpayments, underpayments and other discrepancies.

- Cross-check information rather than assuming transactions or records are correct.

- Review courier/freight invoices and compare actual charges against quoted freight and freight charged to customers.

- Identify unexpected charges, discrepancies and potential underquoting.

- Liaise with our accountant and respond to requests promptly.

- Maintain clear notes and accurate financial records.

- Follow outstanding matters through until they are fully resolved, not simply identified.

- Proactively flag anything unusual to management.



What We're Looking For

You must be someone who is:

- Extremely detail-oriented. Small discrepancies matter in this role.

- Able to work accurately in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment.

- Proactive and able to identify what needs attention without waiting to be told.

- Comfortable monitoring
s, payments and financial activity throughout the day.

- Able to prioritise urgent financial matters while still completing routine responsibilities.

- Confident in investigating discrepancies using the information and systems available to you.

- Comfortable asking questions when something doesn't look right.

- Strong at following up. If something remains unresolved, we expect you to keep it on your radar.

- Highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable and consistently available during agreed working hours.

- A strong communicator with excellent written and spoken English.



Mandatory Requirements

* Proven professional bookkeeping experience.

* You must have a minimum of 5 years of professional Australian bookkeeping/accounting experience.

* Experience with Xero.

* Strong reconciliation, accounts payable and accounts receivable experience.

* Must have hands-on experience with Australian payroll, including setting up new employees and preparing/processing weekly payroll.

* Must have a strong working knowledge of Australian bookkeeping and taxation requirements, including GST, BAS, PAYG and superannuation.

* Must have hands-on experience processing and reconciling foreign currency invoices and payments.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

* Experience investigating financial discrepancies.

* Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional work-from-home setup.

* Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

* Ability to work full-time during Melbourne business hours.

* Must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

* To confirm that you have read the full job description and understand the requirements of the role, please include the word “OFFROAD” in the subject line of your application.



Highly Advantageous

*Experience with any of the following will be highly regarded:

*Australian e-commerce or retail businesses

*Shopify

*Inventory management/accounting systems

*Freight or logistics reconciliation

*High-volume transaction environments

*Working directly with external Australian accountants



This position requires constant attention and ownership.



This Role May Not Be For You If...



If you prefer waiting for tasks to be assigned, checking
s only occasionally, leaving discrepancies for someone else to investigate, or needing regular reminders to follow up outstanding matters, this role will likely not be the right fit.

We need someone who sees something that doesn't look right and thinks:

“I need to check this.” and not: “Someone will tell me if there's a problem.”



Working Hours

Shift Hours – Full-Time Monday to Friday

Melbourne Time: (AEST/AEDT): 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

Philippine Time: (PHT): 7:00 AM - 4:00 PM (6:00 AM - 3:00 PM during AEDT)

Includes a 1-hour lunch break (unpaid)

Applicants must be able to consistently work Melbourne business hours.



TO APPLY

To be considered for this position:

You MUST submit an updated resume/CV.

You must have relevant professional bookkeeping experience.

You must have strong written and spoken English communication skills.

You must be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

You must be available during the stated Melbourne working hours.

You must be a Filipino citizen based in the Philippines.

title: E-Commerce Order Fulfillment Specialist — Full Time, Remote, Night Shift
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

HOURS PER WEEK: 40

MONTHLY PAY: US$1,100

COMPANY: Leading US online retailer of health and wellness products

LOCATION: Philippines — Work From Home



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a leading US online retailer of health and wellness products seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Order Fulfillment Specialist to manage daily order processing, shipping information, and inventory reporting.



You will work extensively in our custom order management system (OMS), ensuring orders are reviewed correctly, approved, and transmitted to the appropriate fulfillment partner. You will also maintain accurate tracking information, create shipping labels, and follow and improve our standard operating procedures (SOPs).



This position suits someone who enjoys structured operational work, learns software thoroughly, and takes ownership of resolving discrepancies.



WORK SCHEDULE



Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. U.S. Central Time, including a one-hour break.



In Philippine time, this means:

- 9:30 p.m.–6:30 a.m. during U.S. daylight saving time.

- 10:30 p.m.–7:30 a.m. during U.S. standard time.

Your shifts begin Monday through Friday evenings and finish Tuesday through Saturday mornings. You must be comfortable working this regular overnight schedule and adjusting when U.S. daylight saving time changes.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Daily order review, approval, and transmission

- Review the daily OMS order queue and verify product SKUs, quantities, delivery details, inventory availability, fulfillment source, and shipping requirements.

- Identify missing information, discrepancies, and exceptions before releasing orders.

- Approve orders within your assigned authority and transmit accurate order details to vendors, warehouses, or fulfillment partners before applicable cutoffs.

- Confirm successful transmission and follow up on unacknowledged orders.

- Monitor held orders and backorders, prevent duplicate submissions, and escalate unresolved issues promptly.

2. OMS mastery and SOP improvement

- Develop complete working knowledge of our OMS workflow, including order statuses, approval rules, routing, holds, and exceptions.

- Follow established SOPs consistently and maintain clear, accurate order notes.

- Investigate workflow errors and identify recurring problems.

- Recommend and document improvements to SOPs as operational needs change, obtaining approval before implementing changes.

3. Tracking information and data accuracy

- Manually upload tracking information when required, matching each shipment to the correct order, carrier, tracking number, and shipped items.

- Handle tracking accurately for partial shipments and orders with multiple packages.

- Verify that automated tracking connections populate the OMS accurately and promptly.

- Compare OMS records with vendor, warehouse, carrier, and shipping software records to identify missing, duplicate, or mismatched information.

- Correct discrepancies within your permissions and report integration failures with clear examples, following through until resolved.

4. Shipping label creation

- Create shipping labels using integrated shipping software and directly through carrier portals when manual processing is required.

- Verify addresses, shipping services, package counts, weights, dimensions, and special instructions before purchasing labels.

- Follow approved shipping methods and cost guidelines.

- Send labels and shipping documents to the correct fulfillment partner and maintain accurate shipment records.

- Void or replace incorrect labels according to established procedures.

5. Inventory monitoring and reporting

- Monitor inventory availability, allocated stock, and backorders according to SOPs.

- Identify discrepancies between OMS inventory and warehouse or vendor records.

- Prepare scheduled inventory reports and flag shortages, stockouts, and discrepancies that could delay fulfillment.

- Escalate replenishment needs and make inventory adjustments only within approved procedures.

6. Fulfillment coordination

- Coordinate with vendors, warehouses, carriers, and internal team members to resolve fulfillment issues.

- Provide accurate order and shipment updates to the customer service team.

- Maintain a clear record of outstanding issues, next actions, and follow-up dates.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- At least two years of relevant experience in e-commerce order processing, order fulfillment, logistics administration, or a similar role.

- Experience using order management, inventory, ERP, or shipping software.

- Strong attention to detail when checking order data, shipping information, and inventory records.

- Ability to learn custom software and understand how information moves between connected systems.

- Practical Excel or Google Sheets skills, including sorting, filtering, lookups, and comparing records.

- Clear written and spoken English for communicating with colleagues and fulfillment partners.

- Ability to follow SOPs, manage daily deadlines, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.

- Reliable follow-through and the ability to work independently in a remote team.

- Availability for the full overnight schedule.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

- Shopify, BigCommerce, and Amazon Seller Central.

- U.S. e-commerce operations.

- Drop shipping and coordination with third-party warehouses.

- Carrier portals, parcel shipping, or freight shipments.

- Investigating tracking or inventory synchronization issues.

- Writing or improving operational SOPs.



HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS

- A reliable computer capable of running multiple browser-based business applications.

- Stable internet suitable for daily system use and video meetings.

- A quiet, dedicated workspace.

- A practical backup plan for internet and power interruptions.



COMPENSATION



Monthly pay is US$1,000 for a full-time schedule of 40 working hours per week. You will also enjoy 15 days of paid time off (PTO) per year and 10 company holidays.



HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED



Success means orders are reviewed and transmitted on time, shipping labels and tracking records are accurate, inventory reports are complete, and exceptions receive consistent follow-up. We also value sound judgment, clear documentation, and improvements that reduce recurring errors.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using the subject line:



Order Fulfillment Specialist — [Your Full Name]



Include:

1. A link to your current CV.

2. A brief summary of your relevant order fulfillment experience.

3. The order management, inventory, and shipping systems you have used.

4. An example of an order, tracking, or inventory discrepancy you identified and how you resolved it.

5. Confirmation that you can work the stated Philippine overnight schedule.

6. Confirmation that the monthly pay of US$1,000 meets your expectations, along with your earliest available start date.

7. A brief description of your internet and power backup arrangements.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager (Admin, Job Management & ServiceM8)

(Part-Time, Remote – Work from Home)



Are you a highly organised, proactive operations all-rounder who loves keeping a busy business running smoothly? Do you thrive on managing jobs from first enquiry through to final payment, keeping calendars and rosters on track, and building the systems and processes that help a business grow?



We're looking for a capable and reliable Operations Manager to join an Australian-based electrical business that specialises in the installation of commercial kitchen dishwashers and commercial kitchen appliances across airports, restaurants, hospitals and other commercial facilities.



This is not a typical task-taker VA role. This is an opportunity to become the operational backbone of a growing Australian trade business, starting part-time (20 hours per week), with the potential to grow into a full-time position (40 hours per week) within the next couple of months as the business grows.



About the Role

This role is centred on running the day-to-day operations of the business. ServiceM8 is our main job management platform, and you'll own it end-to-end – from the initial enquiry, to quoting, creating job cards, scheduling and rostering technicians, marking jobs as complete, pushing through invoices and following up on payments. You'll also be the first point of contact for customers – answering calls, returning calls and managing the inbox – while keeping calendars and rosters organised. As the business grows, you'll play a key role in building its foundations by creating SOPs and processes, helping develop the employee handbook and supporting the onboarding of new team members. When time allows, you'll also assist with marketing and business development. There is no fixed split between tasks – your week's mix will vary depending on the business's workload and priorities.



Key Responsibilities

Job Management (ServiceM8)

● Take full ownership of ServiceM8 across the entire job lifecycle – from enquiry to quote, job card, completion, invoicing and payment.

● Log new enquiries and capture all job details accurately.

● Prepare and send quotes, and follow up on outstanding quotes.

● Create job cards, schedule jobs and keep job statuses up to date.

● Mark jobs as complete, push through invoices and follow up on overdue payments.

● Keep ServiceM8 clean, accurate and up to date at all times.



Calendar Management & Rostering

● Manage the business owner's calendar, appointments and bookings.

● Roster and schedule technicians to jobs, balancing availability, locations and priorities.

● Coordinate changes to schedules and communicate them clearly to the team and customers.



Customer Communication

● Answer incoming calls professionally and handle enquiries.

● Return missed calls promptly and follow up with customers, suppliers and contractors.

● Manage the inbox – responding, actioning, filing and flagging priority
s.

● Provide a high standard of customer service and represent the business professionally.



Systems, SOPs & People

● Create clear SOPs and processes for the business's day-to-day operations.

● Help create and maintain the employee handbook.

● Support the onboarding of new employees, including preparing onboarding documents and checklists.

● Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and streamline how the business runs.



Marketing & Business Development

● Assist with marketing activities, such as social media and content updates.

● Support business development by researching and identifying potential new clients and opportunities.

● Follow up with prospects and keep leads organised.



General Administration

● Complete other general admin tasks as required to keep the business running smoothly.

● Keep records, documents and files organised and easy to find.

● Problem-solve independently and take initiative rather than waiting for instructions at every step.



About You

You're a highly organised, proactive operations professional who takes genuine ownership of your work. You're a good listener who understands instructions the first time, communicates clearly and confidently on the phone and in writing, and follows through without needing to be chased. You think ahead, spot problems before they happen and take initiative to keep things moving. You care about getting things right – accurate quotes, correct invoices and up-to-date job records – rather than simply ticking off tasks.



You're comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced trade environment where jobs, schedules and customer needs can change quickly. You enjoy creating structure and turning the way a business works into clear systems and processes. Experience supporting an Australian trade or field service business is highly valued.



You MUST have your own safe, private and distraction-free home office with a reliable computer, a good-quality headset for calls, stable high-speed internet and stable power.



Experience & Skills

Essential

● Proven experience in an operations, admin or executive assistant role.

● Hands-on experience with ServiceM8 or a similar job management platform (e.g. Simpro, Tradify, Fergus, AroFlo).

● Experience with quoting, invoicing and following up on payments.

● Experience with calendar management, scheduling and rostering.

● Confident answering and making phone calls with Australian customers.

● Strong
 management and organisational skills.

● The ability to write clear SOPs and process documents.

● Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

● Comfortable using communication and task management tools such as WhatsApp, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or similar.

● Excellent written and spoken English.



Highly Favourable

● Experience supporting an Australian trade business (electrical, plumbing, HVAC or similar).

● Experience with Xero or other accounting software.

● Experience creating employee handbooks and onboarding processes.

● Basic marketing experience, including social media and Canva.

● Business development, lead generation or CRM experience.

● Experience using AI tools to support admin and operational workflows.



Personal Attributes

● Good listener who understands instructions the first time

● Highly organised and reliable

● Proactive, resourceful and takes initiative

● Clear, confident and professional communicator

● Excellent attention to detail

● Strong problem-solver who thinks ahead

● Loyal, honest and transparent

● Accountable – takes ownership of their work and follows through without being chased

● Calm under pressure and able to juggle competing priorities

● Open to feedback and continuously improving

● A genuine team player



What's on Offer

● Part-time role: Starting at 20 hours per week.

● $10 AUD Per Hour (Non-negotiable).

● Remote position – work from home, working Australian Eastern Standard Time (Queensland) business hours.

● Potential to grow into a full-time role (40 hours per week) within the next couple of months as the business grows (not guaranteed).

● Become a genuine extension of a growing Australian electrical business working across airports, restaurants, hospitals and other commercial facilities.

● The opportunity to build the systems, processes and foundations of the business from the ground up.



How to Apply

Please submit:

● Your Resume and a short video with your own 1-2 minute elevator pitch based on the role.

● A short summary outlining your experience with ServiceM8 (or similar job management platforms), quoting, invoicing, rostering and customer communication.

● An example of an SOP or process document you have created (with any confidential information removed), if available.

● Briefly explain how you stay organised when managing multiple jobs, calls and deadlines at once, and what sets you apart from other candidates. Please ensure your summary is written by you and tailored to this role. Do NOT provide an AI generated response (I can tell).

Important note:



Please ONLY apply if you are looking for a long-term position and are comfortable with a role that blends job management, customer communication, administration, systems building and business development. A lack of punctuality, integrity, professionalism or follow-through will not be tolerated. Please only apply if you feel this role genuinely aligns with your CV and experience – if this role feels like too much of a “stretch” for you and doesn't align with your skillset or experience, please do not apply. Lastly, only apply if you are open to the role potentially growing to full-time hours as the business's needs require.

title: VA Assistant
description:
Office coordinator for a gutter installation company in Lakeland, Florida.

You keep our customers followed up with and our jobs organized while our

crews are out working.



** THE HOURS - PLEASE READ FIRST **



Our customers call during their day in Florida, so this is a NIGHT SHIFT in

the Philippines.



 Manila: 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM (Mar-Nov)

 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM (Nov-Mar)

 Florida: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM



Monday to Friday. The one hour change is US daylight saving time.

Please do not apply if this schedule does not work for your life.



** WHAT YOU WILL DO **



- CALL PEOPLE BACK. Someone asks about new gutters, or texts a photo of a

 downspout hanging off their wall. You reach them the same day and book

 the estimate.



- GET THE MISSING DETAILS. We often have the address but not the gutter

 size or the color they want. You call and ask. That is the difference

 between a quote we can send and one that sits waiting.



- KEEP OUR SYSTEM STRAIGHT. Every customer, quote and scheduled visit

 lives in Jobber. You keep it accurate so the owner can look once and

 know where everything stands.



- STAY ON THE CREWS. Installers text when a job is finished, usually with

 photos. You make sure those reach the right job and chase anyone who has

 gone quiet.



- ANSWER THE TEXTS. Customers text as much as they call. Nobody should

 wait overnight for an answer.



Tools: Jobber, Quo,
. We will train you on all of them.



** YOU ARE A GOOD FIT IF **



- Your spoken English is clear and easy for Americans to follow. You will

 be on the phone with homeowners every day, some of them older, some of

 them annoyed about water running down a wall.

- You follow up on things without being reminded.

- You have reliable internet and power, with a backup for brownouts.

- You have a quiet room and a decent headset.

- You have used a CRM or ticketing tool before.



Helpful but not required: experience with Jobber, ServiceTitan or Housecall

Pro; any background in construction, roofing or home services; US customer

service or appointment setting.



** THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF **



- You need daytime hours in the Philippines

- You would rather not be on the phone

- You are juggling several other clients



** WORKING WITH US **



We are a small company, so you deal with the owner directly, not a manager

in between. The work settles into a routine once you learn it. We train

properly rather than throw you in, and we want to keep whoever we hire for

years, not months.



** HOW TO APPLY **



1. Start your message with the word GUTTER so we know you read this

 whole post. Applications without it are deleted unread.



2. Tell us about a time you handled a frustrated customer and what you

 did about it. A few sentences is enough.



3. Tell us plainly whether the night shift works for your life, and what

 your internet and power setup is.



If we like your application we will ask you for a short voice recording

before we set up an interview. You will be on the phone with American

homeowners every day, so we need to hear how you sound on a call.

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity).
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We're a dance studio that does more than teach dance. We help students build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that last a lifetime.



We're looking for someone who can turn interested families into enrolled students through genuine conversations, consistent follow up, and proactive outreach.



We need someone who takes ownership, not someone who waits to be told what to do.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales position focused on connecting with prospective families and adult students, understanding their needs, and guiding them toward enrollment.



Your primary responsibility is contacting warm leads through calls, texts, and
s. When lead flow slows down, you'll proactively find new opportunities through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



You'll also support weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content.



This isn't a role where you simply work through a checklist. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, stays organized, and genuinely cares about results.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Respond to new leads immediately. Speed matters, and every missed opportunity counts.



- Convert interest into enrollment. Build trust, understand each family's needs, handle objections naturally, and guide them toward the next step.



- Follow up consistently with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Own your pipeline. Keep the CRM updated, track every lead, and report daily activity and results without reminders.



- Generate new opportunities through social media, community groups, and online platforms during downtime.



- Support marketing by writing weekly
s to leads and assisting with occasional social media content.



- Be a team player. Occasionally assist the studio owner with tasks outside your core responsibilities when they support the studio's growth.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Our priorities, in order:



- Outstanding phone presence. You sound calm, natural, confident, and conversational. You can build trust quickly and move conversations forward without sounding scripted or pushy. This is our highest priority.



- Excellent English communication. C1 level or higher in spoken and written English. This will be assessed.



- Relevant experience. Sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment experience is preferred. Strong transferable skills will also be considered.



- Organization and reliability. You manage leads, follow through on commitments, maintain accurate records, and report results consistently.



- Independence and initiative. You solve problems, identify opportunities, and stay productive without constant supervision.



- Results driven mindset. You enjoy talking with people, take accountability, and care about converting opportunities into actual enrollments.



- CRM familiarity. Experience with CRM tools or lead tracking systems is helpful but not required.



An interest or background in dance is a bonus, not a requirement.





SCHEDULE



20 hours per week across 7 days.



All times are Pacific Time (PT).



Monday–Friday (3.5 hours/day):

- 11:00–11:30 AM

- 12:30–1:30 PM

- 4:00–6:00 PM



Saturday–Sunday (1.25 hours/day):

- 10:00–11:15 AM



Important: This is a split shift schedule, and weekend availability is required.



Hours may change seasonally based on studio needs, with shifts scheduled between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM PT. Any adjustments will be discussed and agreed upon in advance.



You must be able to reliably work the current schedule and have reasonable flexibility for future changes.





LONG-TERM COMMITMENT & GROWTH



We're looking for someone who wants to make this their primary professional opportunity, not someone looking to add another job to an already full schedule.



If you're currently employed, you should be actively looking to transition into a new role. We're not looking for candidates who intend to maintain multiple jobs long term.



This position starts at 20 hours per week, with a clear path to full time based on performance. Consistently generating new leads and converting interested families into enrolled students is what earns additional hours. The stronger your results, the greater your opportunity to grow.



You must be able to fully commit to the current schedule, give this role your undivided attention during working hours, and be genuinely interested in growing with the studio.





PAID TWO-WEEK TRIAL



The position begins with a 1-2 week trial to confirm a strong fit on both sides.



We'll evaluate your reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, lead management, and ability to operate independently.



At the end of the trial, we'll review performance together and d
 whether to continue long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid biweekly through Wise.



This is initially a part time position. Additional hours and the potential to transition into full time work depend on consistent performance, enrollment results, and the studio's business needs.



We want to invest more hours in someone who demonstrates they can make a meaningful impact.





HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



- Your resume and a short introduction.

- A real example of a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a meaningful difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title.



We review applications that follow these instructions carefully. Think of this as your first opportunity to demonstrate the attention to detail and follow through we value in this role.

title: Accounting Clerk / Bookkeeper for US Company
description:
Do You Notice When the Numbers Don’t Make Sense?



Are you the person who spots the missing transaction, questions an unusual charge, and keeps working until every number has an explanation?



H+A Events is looking for a full-time, virtual Accounting Clerk who takes pride in accuracy, organization, and follow-through. You will support H+A's financial operations and multiple association clients. Your work will include account reconciliations, expense management, accounts payable and receivable, client invoicing, and financial reporting.



This position is a strong fit for someone who enjoys detailed work, manages recurring deadlines without constant reminders, communicates problems early, and understands that accurate financial records protect both our clients and our reputation.



We value people who take ownership, think ahead, solve problems, support their teammates, and continually look for ways to improve their work.



How to Apply - Attention to detail is essential in this position, so please follow these instructions carefully.



Send an
 with the subject line:  "I Make the Numbers Make Sense | Accounting Clerk Application"



Please include:

Your current resume.

A video with the following:

 A brief introduction explaining why your experience prepares you for this position.

 The H+A core value that resonates most with you and a brief explanation of why.

 Your location, time zone, and the hours you can consistently work in the U.S. Central Time Zone.



APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



We are looking for more than someone who can enter transactions. We want a dependable accounting professional who asks thoughtful questions, protects confidential information, and helps us trust the story our numbers are telling.



The Accounting Clerk supports our company's and clients' financial operations. They will maintain accurate financial records, reconcile bank, credit card, and payment-processing accounts, prepare client invoices, track reimbursable expenses, and produce timely financial reports. This position requires exceptional accuracy, strong follow-through, confidentiality, and the ability to manage financial information for multiple organizations.



Responsibilities:



BANK AND ACCOUNT RECONCILIATION

Reconcile company and client checking, savings, and investment accounts each month. 

Reconcile company and client credit card statements. 

Reconcile merchant-processing accounts, including registration payments, credit card deposits, processing fees, refunds, chargebacks, and bank deposits. 

Research and resolve discrepancies, duplicate transactions, missing deposits, and uncategorized expenses. 

Confirm account balances match bank statements and supporting documentation. 

Maintain separate and accurate records for each H+A client. 

Prepare monthly reconciliation reports for the Owner/CEO's review. 

Promptly escalate unusual transactions, unreconciled balances, or suspected errors. 



EXPENSE MANAGEMENT

Manage financial activity within Expensify. 

Review submitted expenses for receipts, appropriate coding, business purpose, client assignment, and approval. 

Import approved expenses into the accounting system. 

Identify missing receipts, incomplete descriptions, duplicate expenses, and incorrect client allocations. 

Track reimbursable expenses H+A pays on behalf of clients. 

Maintain documentation that supports every reimbursement request. 

Assist employees and team members with expense-report questions. 



CLIENT INVOICING AND ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE

Prepare accurate and timely client invoices for management fees, project fees, event-related charges, and reimbursable expenses. 

Attach supporting documentation when required. 

Confirm that expenses appear on the correct client invoice. 

Track outstanding invoices and accounts receivable. 

Prepare aging reports and identify overdue balances. 

Send approved payment reminders or provide follow-up information to the Owner/CEO. 

Apply client payments accurately within the accounting system. 

Research short payments, overpayments, duplicate payments, and unapplied credits. 

Maintain records of deposits, credits, refunds, and adjustments. 



ACCOUNTS PAYABLE

Review vendor invoices for accuracy, proper authorization, and correct company or client coding. 

Enter approved bills into the accounting system. 

Match invoices with contracts, purchase approvals, receipts, or other supporting documents. 

Prepare payment schedules for review and approval. 

Track vendor due dates and help prevent late fees. 

Maintain current vendor records and payment documentation. 

Assist with gathering W-9 forms and year-end 1099 information. 

Identify duplicate invoices, unexpected charges, or vendor price changes. 



FINANCIAL REPORTING

Prepare monthly financial reports for H+A and assigned clients. 

Generate profit and loss statements, balance sheets, accounts receivable reports, budget-to-actual reports, and other requested reports. 

Prepare clear summaries that identify discrepancies, outstanding items, and areas requiring management attention. 

Assist with event-specific financial reports, including registration revenue, sponsorship revenue, exhibitor income, vendor expenses, refunds, and final event results. 

Maintain spreadsheets or tracking reports used for client reporting. 

Provide accurate supporting schedules to the Owner/CEO, client leaders, CPA, or tax professionals. 



MONTH-END AND YEAR-END SUPPORT

Follow a documented month-end closing checklist for each organization. 

Confirm that all bank, credit card, merchant, and expense accounts have been reconciled. 

Review uncategorized transactions and outstanding reconciliation items. 

Verify that client reimbursements and management fees have been invoiced. 

Organize reports and supporting documentation for monthly client review. 

Assist the CPA with year-end close, tax preparation, audits, and requested documentation. 

Help prepare records for 1099 reporting and other annual financial requirements. 

Maintain organized electronic files according to the company’s document-retention standards. 



INTERNAL CONTROLS AND CONFIDENTIALITY

Protect confidential company, client, employee, vendor, and banking information. 

Follow established approval procedures for bills, reimbursements, refunds, credits, and account changes. 

Never release payments, change vendor banking information, or process unusual refunds without proper approval. 

Maintain a clear audit trail for financial entries, corrections, and adjustments. 

Report suspected fraud, phishing attempts, irregular transactions, or security concerns immediately. 

Follow company password, multifactor authentication, and data-security requirements. 



GENERAL SUPPORT

Respond promptly and professionally to internal and client accounting questions. 

Clearly communicate missing information and upcoming deadlines. 

Document recurring accounting procedures. 

Recommend ways to improve accuracy, efficiency, and reporting. 

Participate in regular meetings with the Owner/CEO. 

Complete other accounting and administrative duties as assigned. 



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

At least three years of bookkeeping, accounting clerk, or accounting assistant experience. 

Experience supporting a U.S.-based company or clients. 

Practical knowledge of bank, credit card, and merchant-account reconciliation. 

Experience preparing invoices and tracking accounts receivable. 

Experience reviewing vendor invoices and maintaining accounts payable records. 

Proficiency with QuickBooks Desktop and QuickBooks Online. 

Prefer experience migrating files from QuickBooks Desktop to QuickBooks Online. 

Experience with Expensify or a similar expense-management system. 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills, including filters, sorting, formulas, and reconciliation worksheets. 

Ability to understand a profit and loss statement, balance sheet, general ledger, and accounts receivable aging report. 

Strong written and spoken English. 

Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy. 

Ability to manage multiple organizations, accounts, and deadlines without mixing financial information. 

Strong judgment and willingness to ask questions when information appears incomplete or incorrect. 

Proven ability to handle confidential financial information. 

Reliable computer, secure internet connection, and a professional remote workspace. 

Ability to maintain regular working-hour overlap with the H+A team in the Central Time Zone. 



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or a related field. 

QuickBooks Online certification. 

Experience working with association-management, event-management, or professional-services companies. 

Experience handling books for multiple clients or business entities. 

Experience reconciling Stripe, PayPal, 
, event-registration platforms, or other merchant processors. 

Experience with deferred revenue, event deposits, registration refunds, sponsorships, and reimbursable client expenses. 

Familiarity with U.S. GAAP and accrual-based accounting. 

Experience supporting a CPA or assisting with month-end and year-end close. 

Experience with Gusto or another U.S. payroll platform. 

Experience gathering W-9 information and supporting 1099 preparation. 



H+A seeks someone who:

 Notices when numbers do not make sense. 

 Enjoys detailed, repetitive work and completes it consistently. 

 Meets deadlines without repeated reminders. 

 Documents their work so another person can follow it. 

 Communicates problems early. 

 Takes ownership of researching discrepancies. 

 Respects approval boundaries. 

 Can shift between several clients while maintaining accuracy. 

 Remains calm when deadlines overlap. 

 Understands that accuracy and confidentiality directly affect H+A’s reputation. 



H+A's Core Value Competencies:

Fanatical attention to detail and deadlines, and takes ownership of tasks and projects

Continually exceeding expectations and hungry for achievement

Innovative and resourceful problem-solving by staying curious, relentless, and unstoppable

Team player: fun, humble, and authentic

Anticipate needs, understand long-term objectives, and act with the clients’ success in mind

Exhibits professionalism in all things

Honors the value of reputation of individual and company

title: AI YouTube Automation Specialist & Channel Manager (Faceless Channels)
description:
AI YouTube Automation Specialist & Channel Manager (Faceless YouTube Channels)



Job Type: Part-Time (Potential Full-Time Position)  

Location: Remote – Philippines  

Salary: Negotiable Based on Experience  

Employment: Long-Term Opportunity



About the Role



We are looking for a talented, creative, and resourceful **AI YouTube Automation Specialist & Channel Manager** to help build, manage, and grow faceless YouTube channels.



Our content will focus on dark history, mysteries, fascinating stories, documentaries, and other entertaining, educational topics.



We aim to build a network of successful faceless YouTube channels using AI-powered production workflows.



We are looking for someone who can handle the **entire content creation process**, from researching video ideas to producing, editing, and publishing high-quality videos.



This is not just a video editing position. We want someone who understands YouTube automation, AI content creation, storytelling, and channel growth.



Key Responsibilities



1. AI Video Production

- Create high-quality faceless YouTube videos (10–15 minutes).

- Generate cinematic AI visuals, animations, and realistic scenes.

- Produce natural-sounding AI voiceovers.

- Source relevant stock footage, historical images, and video clips.

- Add background music, sound effects, subtitles, transitions, and visual effects.

- Ensure engaging pacing, strong hooks, and high audience retention.

- Produce 2–4 YouTube Shorts from each long-form video.



2. Content Research & Scriptwriting

- Research interesting and potentially viral video topics.

- Identify trending subjects and content opportunities.

- Use AI tools to assist with research and scriptwriting.

- Create engaging scripts with strong hooks, storytelling, and suspense.

- Fact-check information to ensure accuracy and credibility.



3. YouTube Channel Management

- Manage the day-to-day operations of our YouTube channels.

- Create engaging video titles, thumbnails, and descriptions.

- Upload and schedule videos consistently.

- Optimise videos for YouTube search and discovery.

- Monitor channel analytics, including views, CTR, watch time, and audience retention.

- Provide weekly performance reports.

- Recommend improvements to content strategy and channel growth.

- Maintain an organised content calendar and production workflow.



4. AI Automation & Workflow Optimisation

- Use AI tools to automate repetitive production tasks.

- Develop efficient workflows to reduce production time and costs.

- Research and implement new AI tools when beneficial.

- Maintain consistent video quality while improving production efficiency.

- Help scale the production process as additional channels are launched.



Required Skills & Experience



- Experience creating faceless YouTube videos or managing YouTube automation channels.

- Strong understanding of YouTube audience retention, storytelling, and video pacing.

- Experience with AI-powered video generation and editing.

- Proficiency in video editing software.

- Ability to create engaging thumbnails and titles.

- Familiarity with YouTube Studio and analytics.

- Strong English communication and comprehension.

- Excellent time management and ability to work independently.

- Creative problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.



Preferred AI Tools



Experience with some of the following is highly desirable:



- AI Video: Kling AI, Runway, Google Veo, Pika

- AI Images: Midjourney, ChatGPT Image Generation

- AI Voiceovers: ElevenLabs

- Video Editing: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut

- AI Research & Writing: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini

- Automation: Make, n8n, Zapier or similar tools



You do not need to know every platform listed. We value your ability to learn, adapt, and create efficient workflows.



Video Style & Quality Expectations



We want cinematic, immersive, documentary-style videos that keep viewers engaged from beginning to end.



We are NOT looking for generic AI slideshows, repetitive stock footage, robotic narration, or low-effort AI-generated content.



Our videos should feature:



- Powerful hooks within the first 5–15 seconds.

- Compelling storytelling and strong narrative structure.

- Cinematic visuals and atmospheric sound design.

- Natural, engaging narration.

- Smooth editing and appropriate visual effects.

- Professional production quality.

- Original, well-researched content that complies with YouTube's policies.



**Quality and viewer retention are more important than simply producing videos quickly.**



Work Expectations



Our initial target is:



- 1 long-form YouTube video per week (10–15 minutes).

- 2–4 Shorts per long-form video.

- Thumbnails, titles, descriptions, and scheduling.

- Basic channel analytics and performance reporting.



As the channels grow, there will be opportunities to increase production volume and take on greater responsibilities.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian BPO company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our team members can build stable and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will be supporting a third-generation independent financial advisor based in Ontario, Canada. The practice serves a loyal base of a few hundred families across mutual funds, segregated funds, life insurance, and group insurance.



Many clients have been with the family for decades, and many are retirees who prefer a phone call over an
. The advisor is direct, easygoing, and growing quickly — and he needs a dependable right hand to make sure no client is ever left waiting.



Job Overview

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Service & Executive Assistant who will own the administrative side of the practice so the advisor can spend his time in front of clients.



Your mission is simple: nothing slips through the cracks. Every client meeting is booked, every file is prepped, every form is signed, and every follow-up happens on time. Clients should never have to send a "just checking in"
 again.

This role is phone-first and client-facing. You will speak with clients regularly, many of them retirees, so a warm, clear, patient phone presence matters as much as your admin skills.



This is an administrative role, not an advisory one. You will not give financial advice, process trades, or need a financial license. You will make sure the advisor walks into every meeting prepared and walks out with every action item handled.

The role starts with the core admin and follow-up work. Over time, it grows into CRM ownership, process building, AI-powered workflows, and marketing support as the practice expands.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST (Eastern Time)

• Canadian statutory holidays off



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 50,000 – 55,000 per month

Quarterly Bonuses Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Client Outreach & Scheduling (Core Focus)

• Phone-first client outreach — Call clients to book review meetings, check in, and follow up. Many clients don't read
, so the phone is your main tool

• Calendar management — Book meetings directly into the advisor's calendar so he can see who he's meeting each day at a glance

• Client point of contact — Act as the first point of contact for routine client requests (e.g., a withdrawal request), prepare the paperwork for the advisor's approval, and keep the client updated

Meeting Preparation

• Meeting prep files — Before every client meeting, prepare a file with the client's investment summary, notes from the last meeting, and open items, delivered to the advisor's inbox ahead of time

• Note filing — Upload the advisor's handwritten meeting notes into the right client folder in Dropbox

Client Paperwork & Follow-Up

• Client repapering — After the advisor completes the compliance details, send e-signature packages (DocuSign or similar), follow up until they are signed, and send a clear confirmation
 summarizing what was updated

• Action item tracking — Follow up on every action from client meetings until it is done, and follow up on the follow-up when needed

• Proactive check-ins — Track and schedule client check-ins every 3–4 months so no relationship goes quiet

Systems & CRM

• CRM migration — Consolidate client records from three existing databases into a new Microsoft-based CRM, and keep it clean and up to date

• SOP building — Turn the advisor's screen recordings (Loom) and training sessions into written standard operating procedures

• Year-end cleanup — Use quieter periods (mid-December to early January) to organize files, clean data, and catch up on back-office work



Growth Responsibilities (Over Time)

• Recommend and set up AI tools to streamline the inbox and admin workflows

• Draft LinkedIn posts and support a simple marketing presence

• Help refresh the practice's website and online presence

• Support a growing team as the practice takes on more clients and assets



Qualifications

Non-Negotiables:

• Clear, easy-to-understand spoken English — you will speak with clients aged 60–85+, some with hearing aids, who need to understand you on the first try

• Experience making phone calls to North American (US or Canadian) clients in a professional, client-facing setting

• Strong follow-through — you track every open item and close it without being reminded



Required:

• At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Client Service Representative, or Virtual Assistant supporting a North American business

• Strong written English — you will draft client
s and confirmations on the advisor's behalf

• Experience managing someone else's calendar and inbox

• Comfortable with Microsoft 365 and cloud tools (Dropbox, e-signature platforms)

• High degree of discretion when handling confidential client and financial information

• Availability to work Eastern Time business hours



Nice to Have:

• Administrative experience in financial services, wealth management, insurance, or banking

• Experience with client onboarding paperwork, KYC updates, or e-signature workflows (DocuSign or similar)

• CRM experience, especially data migration or cleanup across multiple databases

• Experience writing SOPs and documenting processes

• Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) and interest in using them to automate admin work

• Experience drafting LinkedIn content or supporting basic marketing



Who Thrives in This Role:

• You are warm and patient on the phone — you can explain the same thing twice, kindly, to a 79-year-old client

• You get real satisfaction from an organized calendar, a complete file, and a closed loop

• You follow up without being asked, and you follow up on the follow-up

• You are steady and reliable — the advisor can count on you every day

• You take ownership and figure things out, using training materials and SOPs before escalating

• You want a long-term role with a growing practice, not a short stop on the way to something else



Work-From-Home Requirements

• Laptop or PC with Intel i5 or equivalent

• Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download) — stable enough for clear VoIP calls

• Noise-cancelling headset

• Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

• Quiet, dedicated home workspace with no background noise during calls



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

• 13th Month Pay

• SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG

• HMO Health Insurance

• Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

• Canadian statutory holidays off

• Quarterly performance bonuses

• Annual salary increases based on performance

• Netflix subscription reimbursement

Career Growth:

• Long-term, stable placement with a growing, multi-generation practice

• Regular coaching and performance feedback from Scaledforce

• Supportive Canadian work culture



How to Apply (Important)

Please
 the following to 

• Updated resume

• Short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and your experience in client service and admin support. Speak naturally, with no script — we want to hear how you would sound on the phone with a client

• Subject line: SF Client Service Executive Assistant – [Your Name]



*Only candidates that followed the instructions above will be considered



Shortlisted candidates will undergo:

• Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

• Skills and communication assessment, including a mock client phone call (30 min)

• Final client interview (30 min)

title: Land Pricing Analyst
description:
Summary

We're a high-volume land flipping business looking for a sharp Land Pricing Analyst to join our team.



You'll be analyzing and pricing vacant land properties (mostly rural/desert parcels) using comparable sales and our established criteria.



The work is process-driven and steady — ideal for someone who enjoys focused analytical work.



You don't need a real estate background — if you're analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable doing focused solo work, we'll teach you the rest.

What you'll do:



Analyze and price a high volume of vacant land properties

Select and evaluate comparable sales, adjusting for differences in size, access, utilities, terrain, and location

Cross-reference data from county records, GIS/parcel maps, and assessor sites

Follow a structured process for pricing and basic due diligence

Flag unusual or higher-risk properties for review rather than forcing a number

Keep clean, organized records of your work



Skills we're looking for:



Strong comp selection judgment — knowing which sales are truly comparable and which to discard

Sound adjustment reasoning — understanding that price per acre isn't linear and adjusting accordingly

Data fluency — fast and accurate with spreadsheets and pulling data from multiple sources

Consistency — applying the same logic the same way across high volume

Attention to detail — catching access issues, easements, flood zones, and landlocked parcels

Good judgment — knowing the limits of the analysis and when to escalate



Who you are:



Analytical and detail-oriented

Some technical or analytical background is a plus (data, finance, engineering, CS, or similar), but not required

Comfortable with focused, heads-down work for long stretches

Self-directed and reliable

Able to communicate clearly

Solid internet connection



This is high-volume work, so consistency and accuracy both matter. If you take pride in clean, careful analysis, you'll fit in well here.



Please submit a short voice sample why you would be a good fit for this job.

Hiring: Full-Stack Software Developer (Python / React / AI Integration)
