Employment Type: Initial paid project with potential for long-term employment

Experience: Mid-Level to Senior (3–5+ years preferred)

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and demonstrated ability



About the Company



Titan Roofing USA is an established roofing and contracting company based in Montana, United States.



We are developing a new software platform called RoofReady AI, designed to streamline roofing estimates, automate material calculations, and improve production management.



Our goal is to build this system for our own company first, then potentially expand it into a commercial software product for other roofing contractors.



We are looking for an experienced, independent software developer who can help design, build, test, and improve this platform.



This is not a basic website or chatbot project. We need someone capable of developing a reliable business application.



What You Will Build



The first version of our software will:



1. Automatically Read Roofing Measurement Reports



Users will upload PDF roof measurement reports from different satellite measurement providers.



The system should extract roof measurements such as total roof area, pitch, ridge length, hip length, valley length, eaves, and rakes.



Users must be able to review and correct the extracted measurements.



2. Calculate Roofing Material Quantities



Using the verified measurements, the system will automatically calculate quantities for roofing materials such as shingles, underlayment, ice barrier, ridge cap, starter, flashing, and accessories.



Calculations must use configurable formulas and manufacturer specifications.



3. Generate Detailed Roofing Estimates



The application will maintain a database of material prices, labor rates, and roofing assemblies.



It will calculate material costs, labor costs, other direct job costs, gross profit margins, and recommended selling prices.



Users must be able to edit quantities, pricing, and estimate details.



4. Integrate With Our Existing CRM



We currently use JobNimbus for customer records, photos, contracts, and proposals.



The new application should integrate with JobNimbus where supported by its API.



5. Build AI Production Handoff Automation



After a job is sold, the system should review the approved estimate and job information, identify missing or conflicting production details, and create correction tasks before the job is scheduled.



A production manager must approve the completed handoff.



Required Technical Skills



* Strong Python development experience.

* React or Next.js frontend development.

* PostgreSQL or Supabase.

* REST API development and integrations.

* OpenAI API or similar AI document-processing experience.

* PDF text extraction and document processing.

* Business calculation and data validation.

* Git and GitHub.

* Experience building complete web applications.



Experience with 
, n8n, Airtable, or JobNimbus is a plus.



Experience with construction estimating, inventory management, CRM software, or SaaS products is also valuable.



What We Expect



We need someone who can take a detailed business requirement and turn it into working software.



You should be comfortable designing database structures, building user interfaces, integrating APIs, troubleshooting technical problems, and documenting your work.



We value clear communication, reliability, practical problem-solving, and attention to detail.



You do not need previous roofing industry experience. We will explain our estimating and production processes.



However, you must be willing to learn how our business operates.



Development Approach



We will begin with a clearly defined, paid first project:



Build a prototype that uploads a roofing measurement PDF, extracts the measurements, allows users to verify them, and generates a basic material and labor estimate.



If the prototype is successful, we plan to continue development into a complete estimating and production management platform.



We prefer milestone-based development with working demonstrations and clear deliverables.



Communication



Our company operates in Montana, USA, using Mountain Time.



We are comfortable working with a developer based in the Philippines and do not require someone to work overnight to match US business hours.



We expect regular written updates, clear questions when requirements are unclear, and scheduled demonstrations of completed work.



We prefer proactive communication rather than assumptions.



How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. A brief introduction describing your development experience.

2. Links to two or three business applications you have built.

3. Your experience with Python, React, and PostgreSQL/Supabase.

4. Examples of AI integrations or PDF document-processing projects.

5. Your experience integrating third-party APIs.

6. Your preferred hourly rate or project pricing structure.

7. Your weekly availability.

8. Whether you are interested in a long-term working relationship.



Important: Please begin your application with the words “RoofReady Developer” so we know you have read the complete posting.



Also answer this technical question:



“How would you design a system that reads roofing measurements from PDFs created by multiple providers, verifies the extracted measurements, and calculates material quantities without relying on AI for mathematical accuracy?”



We are looking for a developer who can explain their technical approach clearly, not simply list programming languages.



We are interested in building a long-term working relationship with the right person.

title: Customer Support Specialist (Shopify + Gorgias) - Aussie Dog Brand
description:
Love dogs? Love solving problems and making someone's day? Keep reading.



We're an Aussie based ecommerce business specialising in dog products: toys, treats, supplements, beds and dog gear, all designed in-house.



We're family-run, and in just four years we've grown into a global brand. We ship worldwide, we're stocked in 170+ independent stores across Australia, and we have 140,000+ customers and a community of 900,000+ dog lovers on socials.



What we need:

- Available for our 40-hour weekly roster below, including weekend shifts

- At least 2 years of experience with Shopify. You know the Shopify admin: orders, refunds, order edits, fulfilment, subscriptions

- At least 1 year working in Gorgias or a similar helpdesk day to day (macros, rules, tags, views)

- Phone confident. You can pick up a call from an angry customer, stay calm, and resolve it. Fluent spoken and written English



The role:

You'll look after our customers, from the first question someone asks before they buy to every conversation after their order arrives.



That means every customer who needs a reply gets a good one, fast. It also means spotting the cause of a problem so we're not answering the same question a hundred times. And it means sharing what customers tell us so we can turn it into better products and processes.



The role is hands-on. You'll work in the inbox and on the phone day to day as part of our CX team, reporting to our Customer Experience Lead. You'll also work alongside the AI support agent we're building in-house, so it takes the simple questions and you take the ones that matter.



Approx hours (40 hours a week, Melbourne time AEDT):

- Monday to Thursday: 10am to 6pm (8 hours a day)

- Friday: off

- Saturday and Sunday: 9am to 11am and 4pm to 6pm (two 2-hour sweeps, 4 hours a day)



Weekend shifts are part of this role. We have other team members across the week, so together we give our customers consistent coverage every day.



What you'll do:

- Reply to customers in Gorgias across
, chat, Instagram and

- Take and make customer phone calls, including the hard ones: missing parcels, refund disputes, upset owners

- Help customers before they buy: product advice and picking the right gear for their dog

- Work to our Customer Experience standards: response times, quality and tone

- Sort out orders that need fixing in Shopify (changes, cancellations, address issues, missing items, refunds and replacements)

- Work with our 3PL warehouses in Melbourne and Ohio to make sure parcels ship on time: chase stuck orders, lodge freight and carrier enquiries, and follow up lost or damaged parcels until they're resolved

- Check our AI support agent's answers and flag anything it gets wrong

- Use and improve our macros and help content so they stay accurate and keep the personal touch



You'll be great here if you:

- Are obsessed with customer satisfaction and with dogs

- Have high standards and are always looking for ways to improve

- Have 2+ years in ecommerce support on Shopify, ideally for a fast-growing DTC brand

- Fix the cause, not just the ticket

- Stay calm and kind with an unhappy customer on the phone or in writing, and can turn them into a fan

- Pick up new tools quickly and are curious about AI

- Write clearly and warmly, like a human



Pay: Approx. US$1,000 per month, depending on experience. Long-term role.



How to apply:

Start your application with your favourite dog breed, then submit a short video (Google Drive, Loom or YouTube unlisted) covering:

1. Why you'd be a great fit for this role

2. Your experience: the brands you've supported, and what you've done in Shopify and Gorgias

3. What you'd focus on in your first 90 days with us



No script, no slides, no AI voice. Just you, talking to us like you'd talk to a customer.

**



To join our remote delivery team. This is a great opportunity for someone starting their career and wanting real-world experience with construction drawings, 3D models, AI-assisted workflows, quality assurance, and digital project delivery.

Performance and compensation are reviewed after the initial period and then periodically based on quality, reliability, communication, ownership, and business needs.

title: HIGH-VOLUME OUTBOUND SALES CLOSER
description:
READ BEFORE APPLYING



Digital Marketing Masters is looking for a proven phone salesperson who can turn cold calls into paying customers.



This is a direct-closing role, not an appointment-setting job. You will contact business owners already running Google Ads and sell them a straightforward $55.99 Google Ads audit.



You must be comfortable handling objections, asking for payment during the call, and moving quickly to the next prospect when a sale does not happen.



ABOUT DIGITAL MARKETING MASTERS



Digital Marketing Masters (DMM) is a US digital marketing agency specializing in Google Ads management.



We have more than 1,000 businesses currently running Google Ads in our lead database. Your job is to contact these business owners and sell them our $55.99 Google Ads audit.



You handle the sales. DMM provides the product knowledge, scripts, tools, and audit fulfillment.



THE ROLE



This is a fast-paced, high-volume outbound phone sales position.



Your responsibilities include:



Contact business owners currently running Google Ads.



Deliver a short, direct sales pitch.



Follow our sales script and qualification process.



Handle objections and confidently ask for the sale.



Help customers complete payment during the call.



Record completed sales in our CRM.



Move to the next prospect when a sale does not happen.



Call during appropriate local business hours across US time zones.



No appointment setting. No routine follow-up lists. The focus is on having real sales conversations and closing paid audits.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Minimum activity: 100+ outbound conversations per working day.



Minimum sales: 5 paid audits per working day.



Target sales: 10 or more paid audits per working day.



A conversation means an actual interaction with a prospect, not simply placing a call or reaching voi
.



You are expected to maintain a high volume of real conversations, handle objections effectively, and consistently ask for the sale.



We measure both activity and results. Strong performance requires consistent conversations and paid sales.



COMPENSATION AND CAREER GROWTH



Starting salary: $500 USD per month.



Schedule: Part-time, approximately 25 hours per week.



Position: Level 1 Sales Representative.



Sell well, level up faster, and earn more. Consistent high performers may advance to higher sales levels with increased compensation based on demonstrated results.



FAST ONBOARDING



Our goal is to get you ready to sell within 2 days.



We help you set up your accounts, explain the audit, and walk you through the sales process.



You receive access to targeted leads, a power dialer, CRM, payment system, sales scripts, and practical training.



You must learn quickly, follow the process, and be ready to start selling without weeks of training.



WHO SHOULD APPLY?



Proven experience closing sales over the phone.



Strong spoken English and confidence speaking with business owners.



Ability to handle objections and ask directly for payment.



Comfortable with cold calling, rejection, and high-volume sales conversations.



Self-motivated, competitive, and results-driven.



Reliable computer, internet connection, backup internet, and quiet workspace.



Availability during appropriate US business hours.



Experience in telesales, B2B sales, insurance, software, telecommunications, or other high-volume phone sales environments is welcome.



Experience with Kixie, HubSpot, Stripe, or Google Ads is helpful but not required.



Google Ads experience is not required. We need a closer, not a marketing expert.



MANDATORY APPLICATION SCREENING



All five sections must be completed. Incomplete applications may be rejected.



1. VOICE SAMPLE



Submit a 30-second Vocaroo recording introducing yourself and explaining your phone sales experience.



2. SALES EXPERIENCE



Tell us what you have sold, who you sold to, and what you personally closed. Include results where possible.



3. SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



List the dialers, CRMs, spreadsheets, and payment systems you have used.



4. PREVIOUS SALES CALL



Provide a recording of a previous sales call that you are authorized to share. Remove confidential customer information.



5. ROLE AND PERFORMANCE CONFIRMATION



Confirm that you accept the $500 USD monthly starting salary, part-time schedule of approximately 25 hours per week, minimum of 100 real outbound conversations per working day, minimum of 5 paid audits per working day, and target of 10 or more daily sales.



HIRING PROCESS

title: Video Editor for UK & Ireland History Documentary Youtube Channel (Archive Footage Supplied, Ongoing)
description:
I'm launching a faceless YouTube documentary channel about lost and forgotten infrastructure in the UK and Ireland: closed railways, abandoned tunnels, drowned valleys, colliery lines and how things were built.



I'm looking for an editor to cut a first batch of 10–15 videos, with ongoing work if the channel takes off.



The style I'm going for:



Please watch at least one of these before applying:



[America's Forgotten Titan: George Westinghouse](
) by Business Casual. Old photos and engravings get layered 3D motion, so a story told mostly in stills never feels static, and the pacing holds for 24 minutes. This is the closest to the look I want.

[Why The UK Lost Its Oil Wealth (And Why Norway Didn't)](
) by Business Casual. It applies the same treatment to black-and-white British archive stills on a UK industrial subject.

[This plane could cross the Atlantic in 3.5 hours. Why did it fail?](
) by Vox. Period footage of Concorde is cut with clean, minimal typography, title cards and data callouts.

[The Blimp Extinction](
) by Ordinary Things. It's a long history of a lost technology built on rare archive film, with music chosen for each era and small animations in an early-cinema style.

[Why England Erased This Welsh Village](
) by Faultline. It covers Capel Celyn, the village drowned for a reservoir, so the topic is very close to mine. Watch the archive sections for the transitions, like the turning year counters. Ignore the on-camera presenter parts.



What I'm after is polish on top of real archive. Stills should move smoothly, maps should be clean, the sound design should be tasteful, and what's on screen should match what the narrator is talking about.



What I provide for every video:



The finished script and voice-over

Archive footage, photos and maps



What you'll do:



Edit each video to roughly 15–20 minutes

Place the archive I supply so it matches the narration as closely as possible, for specific places, machines and years

Source suitable b-roll for scene-setting, atmosphere and transitions. Good examples are today's landscapes, overgrown trackbeds, reservoirs, tunnel mouths, period-appropriate trains or machinery, and close-ups of rails, brick and water. Use UK or Ireland footage where possible, and pick clips that fit the era or mood.

Add some motion to stills (parallax or a gentle 3D-style move works well), and tidy up or grade old film where it helps

Grade the b-roll so it sits comfortably next to the archive

Use route and location maps when the story moves somewhere new

Add captions for names and dates, and then-and-now pairings where they fit

Use music and sound design that suits the era and keeps a calm documentary tone

title: 3D Animator — Architectural / Construction Training Videos
description:
Hiring: 3D Technical Animator / AI Video Creator — Long-Term Opportunity



Company: RoofReady Academy / Titan Roofing USA

Location: Remote — Philippines

Job Type: Freelance / Part-Time, with opportunity for long-term work

Compensation: Negotiable based on experience and quality



About Us



We are a roofing and construction company based in Montana, USA, developing a new online training platform called RoofReady Academy.



Our goal is to create a large library of professional, animated training videos that teach roofing installation techniques, construction details, safety principles, quality control, and roofing business processes.



These videos will be sold to roofing companies throughout the United States to help train their employees.



We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented 3D animator who can help us build this training library.



This is not a one-time video project. We want to establish a long-term working relationship with the right person and eventually produce hundreds of short training videos.



What You Will Create



You will produce professional 3D animated instructional videos, typically 3–7 minutes long.



Examples include:



* Proper kickout flashing installation.

* Step flashing installation.

* Ice and water shield installation.

* Asphalt shingle installation.

* Roof ventilation.

* Metal roofing installation.

* Commercial TPO and EPDM roofing systems.

* Common roofing installation mistakes.

* Roofing inspections and quality control.



Our videos should look like professional construction training animations, not cartoons.



We want realistic 3D roof models that can be rotated, zoomed in on, and separated into layers to demonstrate how roofing components work together.



We will provide technical guidance, scripts, and reference materials.



You do not need roofing experience, but you must be able to accurately follow construction drawings and technical instructions.



Required Skills



* Experience with Blender or similar 3D animation software.

* Ability to create realistic architectural and construction models.

* Ability to animate installation sequences and demonstrate how components fit together.

* Strong understanding of camera angles, lighting, and rendering.

* Video editing and post-production.

* Ability to add labels, arrows, captions, and visual explanations.

* Good written English communication.

* Ability to deliver editable project files.



Experience with AI video tools, AI narration, ElevenLabs, or architectural visualization is a plus.



Important: Reusable 3D Models



We want to develop a library of reusable roofing components.



For example, once you create a 3D asphalt shingle roof model, we should be able to reuse that model for multiple training videos.



Our goal is to create a consistent visual style and an efficient production process.



We are looking for someone who can help develop this system rather than creating every video from scratch.



First Paid Test Project



Our first video will be:



“Proper Kickout Flashing Installation”



The full video will be approximately five minutes long.



Before commissioning the complete video, we will hire a candidate to create a paid 15–20 second sample animation.



The sample should demonstrate:



1. A realistic asphalt shingle roof meeting an exterior wall.

2. Water flowing down the roof-wall intersection.

3. A close-up of the kickout flashing.

4. Water being redirected away from the wall.

5. Professional lighting, camera movement, and technical detail.



We will provide the technical references.



Accuracy is very important. The animation must follow the approved installation details.



What We Provide



* Video scripts.

* Scene-by-scene instructions.

* Roofing technical knowledge.

* Manufacturer installation references.

* Feedback and technical review.

* Consistent project assignments if the work meets our standards.



What We Expect



We value reliability, honesty, attention to detail, and communication.



You should be comfortable asking questions when instructions are unclear.



We prefer regular progress updates and the ability to review animation drafts before final rendering.



We are located in Montana, USA. You do not need to work US overnight hours, but some overlap for occasional meetings is helpful.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your experience with 3D modeling and animation.

2. Links to your best three animation projects.

3. Which software you use.

4. Whether you have experience with architectural, engineering, or construction animations.

5. Your experience using AI tools to speed up production.

6. Your hourly rate in USD.

7. Your estimated price to produce a five-minute technical 3D animation using reusable models.

8. Your estimated turnaround time.

9. Your weekly availability.



IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words “RoofReady Animator” so we know you read the complete posting.



Also answer this question:



“How would you create reusable 3D roof models so we can efficiently produce 50–100 different roofing training videos without rebuilding everything from scratch?”



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with a new online education business.



Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

title: Experienced Social Media & Live Event Marketer — Sydney Hotshots
description:
Experienced Social Media & Live Event Marketer — Sydney Hotshots



Location: Remote, Philippines  

Hours: Agreed before starting, with availability during Sydney business hours



Pay and bonuses



- First two weeks: AUD $2.50 per hour during the paid trial.

- After successfully completing the trial: AUD $10 per hour.

- Increase to AUD $15 per hour once your marketing delivers a verified increase of at least 50% in paid ticket sales against the agreed baseline.

- Additional performance bonuses for achieving agreed ticket-sales targets. Bonus amounts, targets and payment terms will be confirmed in writing before work begins.



About the position



Sydney Hotshots is looking for an experienced marketer who can take responsibility for promoting our live shows and generating ticket sales across Australia.



Our show is 20 years in the making with a cheeky but classy, fully choreographed male revue with no nudity, aimed at women planning girls’ nights out, birthdays and hens’ parties. You must understand the nature of our entertainment and be comfortable working with our promotional images and content.



You must bring established marketing skills and be able to work independently. We provide an introduction to our show, assets and systems. You must already know how to plan, deliver and measure effective marketing campaigns.



Experience required



- At least two years of professional social media or digital marketing experience, including promoting live shows or ticketed events.

- Evidence of campaigns you personally managed that generated ticket sales or paid bookings.

- Practical experience with
, Instagram, local community promotion and working with venues or event partners.

- Strong written English and the ability to write natural, engaging captions for an Australian audience.

- Experience developing promotions such as group bookings, early-bird offers, VIP giveaways and venue partnerships.

- The ability to track results, identify what is working and make improvements without constant direction.



General administration experience, basic Canva skills or marketing courses alone will not meet the requirements.



What you will do



- Develop and carry out promotional plans for assigned shows, particularly in regional Australian towns.

- Use our approved photos, videos and branding to create effective promotional content.

- Coordinate with venues to get promotions published and encourage local ticket purchases.

- Recommend practical offers and promotional ideas for approval.

- Track enquiries, ticket-link activity and ticket sales.

- Provide a brief daily report showing completed work, results and next steps.



Two-week paid trial



The trial is an opportunity to demonstrate your existing skills through practical work on selected upcoming shows.



Before starting, we will agree on your hours, assigned shows, available resources, budget and performance targets.



During the trial, you will be expected to:



1. Review the assigned shows and provide a practical action plan within the first two working days.

2. Carry out approved promotions promptly and accurately.

3. Use tracking links, promotion codes or other agreed methods to demonstrate your contribution to enquiries and ticket sales.

4. Communicate reliably, meet deadlines and provide clear daily updates.

5. Review progress at the end of each week and explain what you would improve.



The goal is to improve ticket sales. We will assess your contribution alongside the available budget, time remaining before each show, quality of work and ability to operate independently. Likes, follower counts and the number of posts alone will not demonstrate success.



All hours worked during the trial will be paid, whether or not an ongoing position is offered.



How the $15 hourly rate is earned



Before the sales assessment begins, we will agree in writing on the selected shows, a comparable sales baseline, the measurement period, tracking methods and approved marketing budget.



The target is an increase of at least 50% in paid ticket sales, excluding complimentary tickets and refunds. The comparison will account for the number of shows and how far away their dates are, with evidence showing your marketing contribution.



Once the agreed target is achieved and verified, your ongoing hourly rate will increase to AUD $15. This is a defined performance reward, with the measurement agreed in advance.



Working standards



- Keep accurate time records and work within the agreed hours.

- Be available and responsive during your agreed schedule, and report interruptions promptly.

- Complete the work yourself; no undisclosed outsourcing.

- Obtain approval before changing prices, launching offers or spending advertising money.

- Follow our approved branding and community-group rules.

- Provide honest results. Misrepresented experience, copied portfolios or fabricated reports will end your candidacy or trial.



How to apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph using a minimum of 10 Apply Points.



Use the subject line: HOTSHOTS — EXPERIENCED EVENT MARKETER



Include:



1. A brief summary of your relevant live-event marketing experience.

2. Two campaigns you personally worked on, explaining the event, your role, campaign dates, advertising spend if applicable, and ticket-sales results. Include links or screenshots; confidential information may be removed.

3. Examples of promotional posts or captions you personally created.

4. A short explanation of your understanding of Sydney Hotshots and its audience.

5. Your availability and confirmation that you understand the trial rate, ongoing rate and performance requirements.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to explain one previous campaign during a video interview and provide a relevant client or employer reference.



Applications that do not follow these instructions or include the requested evidence will not progress.



We are looking for someone who can bring proven skills, practical ideas and reliable delivery to an ongoing working relationship, with higher earnings linked to demonstrated results. You will need the minimum of the 3 skills listed below :)

title: YouTube Scriptwriter — Mysteries & Unexplained Events
description:
I’m looking for a strong, independent writer to create engaging YouTube scripts about strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters.



For examples of the writing quality I’m looking for—simple language, conversational delivery, and storytelling that’s extremely easy to follow—see:



• Carolina Case Files: 

• Lighthouse Mysteries: 

• MrBallen: 



PAY & DETAILS



• $100 USD per script, including research.

• 3,000–3,600 words per script.

• Freelance position with potential for ongoing work.

• Topics and writing guidelines will be provided.



INDEPENDENT WORK



You must be able to handle the entire script yourself: research, fact-checking, structure, writing, and proofreading.



Scripts must be complete and ready to narrate when submitted. I should not need to rewrite sentences, simplify the language, correct factual errors, or restructure the story.



The purpose of this position is to take scriptwriting off my plate. If I have to revise your work, this arrangement does not make sense for me. You need to understand the guidelines and consistently deliver finished scripts independently.



TOPICS



Strange sightings, unexplained events, and unusual encounters. No true crime. Choose stories with safe outcomes for everyone involved.



THE WRITING



Scripts must be extremely easy to follow, engaging, and natural when read aloud. Think of someone telling you a fascinating story in everyday language.



Absolutely no flowery language. None. No poetic descriptions, elaborate metaphors, or sentences dressed up to sound impressive.



For example:



• Don’t write: “An eerie silence draped itself over the sleepy town.”

  Write: “The town was quiet.”



• Don’t write: “The moon cast its silver veil across the lonely stretch of asphalt.”

  Write: “The moon lit the road.”



• Don’t write: “An icy wave of terror gripped him as he gazed upon the mysterious figure.”

  Write: “He was frightened when he saw the figure.”



The writing must not sound AI-generated at all. No robotic phrasing, generic suspense lines, awkward transitions, or repeated points.



I’m looking for a strong opening, a clear sequence of events, and interesting details that keep people listening. Let the events make the story interesting.



Research each topic carefully, provide source links, and distinguish documented facts from witness accounts or speculation. Do not invent details or dialogue. Include pronunciation guides in parentheses for unfamiliar names and places.



TO APPLY



Use Ghost as the subject line of your application and include:



1. Why you would be a good fit, including any relevant writing experience.

2. At least one existing writing sample. Multiple samples are preferred.

3. Links to published videos using your writing, if available, and your role in creating them.

4. Your usual turnaround time for a 3,000–3,600-word script.



I’m hoping to find a reliable writer for a long-term working relationship.

title: Logistics Operations Analyst (On Time Performance Admin)
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on disciplined execution, accurate shipment tracking, and clear communication. As our operation continues to grow, we are looking for On Time Performance (OTP) Admins who can help strengthen our dispute management process, ensure transportation delays are properly documented, and support accurate, timely client dispute filings.



Role Overview

You will support our On Time Performance team by reviewing client transportation disputes, investigating shipment delays, gathering supporting evidence, and ensuring disputes are processed accurately and within their deadlines.



This role combines dispute investigation, documentation review, and shipment tracking verification. Depending on your assigned shift, you will also support either morning handoffs for overnight shipment exceptions or evening tracking checks for upcoming loads. You will work closely with our OTP team during training before gradually taking ownership of assigned dispute reviews and documentation responsibilities.



If you enjoy investigating shipment discrepancies, reviewing GPS tracking records, organizing evidence, and making sure transportation disputes are supported by accurate information, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

•  Review and process transportation performance disputes involving late arrivals, departures, missed appointments, and other shipment irregularities.

•  Investigate shipment delays by comparing USPS records against internal transportation systems, GPS tracking data, and supporting documentation.

•  Review shipment timelines, GPS records, appointment details, and operational updates to identify discrepancies.

•  Prepare dispute responses, supporting documentation, and case summaries using established procedures.

•  Prioritize time sensitive cases and ensure assigned reviews are completed within established deadlines.

•  Verify shipment tracking availability, supporting documentation, and recorded reasons for delays.

•  Identify missing tracking information, delay explanations, or shipment documentation and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.

•  Request and organize additional supporting records when necessary for investigations.

•  Maintain accurate dispute records, documentation checks, and case updates in internal tracking systems.

•  Escalate conflicting information, recurring operational issues, missing documentation, and unresolved cases to the OTP Team Lead.



Shift-Specific Responsibilities



Early Shift – Thursday to Monday, 6 AM - 3 PM Central Time

•  Coordinate with the night shift operations team during morning handoffs to collect updates on overnight shipment delays and exceptions.

•  Verify that priority loads have complete tracking records, delay explanations, and supporting documentation.

•  Identify and communicate missing evidence before continuing with assigned dispute processing.



Late Shift – Wednesday to Sunday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Central Time

•  Process assigned disputes and review daytime shipment documentation.

•  Conduct evening tracking checks to verify FourKites tracking availability for priority loads scheduled to depart.

•  Communicate missing tracking information and documentation gaps to the night shift operations team leads before the end of the shift.



What Success Looks Like

•  Transportation performance disputes are accurately investigated, supported by reliable documentation, and processed within established deadlines.

•  Dispute decisions are consistent, well-documented, and based on verified transportation records.

•  Missing tracking information, delay reasons, and supporting documentation are identified and communicated promptly.

•  Morning handoffs or evening tracking checks are completed accurately based on the assigned shift.

•  Shared dispute and tracking records remain complete, organized, and updated.

•  Issues requiring further investigation are escalated promptly rather than resolved through unsupported assumptions.

•  Assigned responsibilities are handled independently and consistently after training.



Who We’re Looking For

•  Previous experience in U.S. freight brokerage, logistics operations, Track & Trace, transportation monitoring, or dispute investigation is highly preferred.

•  Familiarity with shipment tracking, GPS monitoring, appointment schedules, transportation delays, and delivery documentation.

•  Experience reviewing shipment discrepancies, investigating operational issues, or validating information across multiple records.

•  Comfortable working with transportation management systems, shipment tracking platforms, and operational databases.

•  Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to interpret timestamps, shipment records, and supporting documentation.

•  Proficient in Excel, Google Sheets, and maintaining accurate operational trackers.

•  Clear written and verbal English communication skills.

•  Organized, proactive, and able to manage time-sensitive tasks independently after training.

•  Reliable computer, primary and backup internet connection required; minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Why Join GH Logistics?

•  Independent Contractor Setup

•  $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

•  Structured systems and clear expectations

•  Hands on training and direct feedback

•  Defined responsibilities and measurable performance expectations

•  Opportunity to gain specialized experience in U.S. transportation dispute management and performance analysis

•  Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage and asset-based logistics operation

•  Performance-based advancement



Schedule & Work Setup

•  Full-Time Remote Role | Direct Hire to US Company

•  Available schedules: Wednesday - Sunday 9 AM - 6 PM Central Time

•  Initial Training Schedule (for 2 weeks): Monday - Friday 7 AM - 4 PM Central Time

•  Final shift assignment will be discussed and confirmed during the hiring or training process.

•  Training includes supervised dispute reviews, transportation documentation verification, and familiarization with internal systems.

•  Zoom presence required

•  Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

•  Reliable computer, primary internet connection, backup internet connection, and home office setup required



This role is built for someone who enjoys investigating transportation issues, analyzing shipment records, and ensuring disputes are supported by accurate documentation. If you are detail driven, organized, proactive, and comfortable handling time-sensitive operational responsibilities, you’ll fit right in.

title: Customer Centered Project Coordinator
description:
RESTORATION BILLING SERVICES



Remote Project Coordinator



Full-Time Position | Restoration and Property-Services Operations



Location



Remote — Philippines



Schedule



Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



Reports To



Operations Manager and Company Ownership



Employment Type



Full-time | Long-term position



Position Summary



The Project Coordinator is responsible for keeping restoration projects organized, documented, scheduled, and moving forward from initial assignment through final billing and closeout. This is not a passive administrative position. The coordinator is expected to communicate confidently, follow up persistently, anticipate delays, and make sure that every customer, crew member, subcontractor, and internal team member knows what happens next.



The successful candidate will be calm under pressure, exceptionally organized, comfortable making and receiving telephone calls, and willing to take ownership of problems until they are resolved. The goal is simple: no missed appointments, no incomplete job files, no unanswered customer questions, and no project left sitting because someone failed to follow up.



Primary Responsibilities



Project Coordination and Scheduling



Coordinate active water, mold, environmental, and restoration projects from initial intake through completion and administrative closeout.



Schedule inspections, mitigation crews, equipment placement and removal, subcontractors, follow-up visits, and customer appointments.



Confirm appointments with customers, property managers, technicians, and subcontractors and immediately address access or scheduling problems.



Maintain an accurate daily and weekly project schedule and communicate changes promptly to everyone affected.



Track project milestones, deadlines, outstanding decisions, and next actions so that work does not stall.



Coordinate closely with the Operations Manager to assign priorities and resolve scheduling conflicts.



Customer and Stakeholder Communication



Serve as a primary point of contact for customers during active projects and provide clear, professional status updates.



Answer incoming calls and make outgoing follow-up calls to customers, property managers, adjusters, attorneys, vendors, and subcontractors.



Respond promptly to questions, complaints, and requests while avoiding promises outside the coordinator's authority.



Communicate difficult information calmly and professionally and escalate serious concerns before they become larger problems.



Document all meaningful conversations, commitments, approvals, and next steps in the CRM immediately after the interaction.



Identify additional customer needs or potential work and promptly refer the opportunity to management or estimating.



CRM, Documentation, and Job-File Control



Create and maintain complete, accurate job records in Luxor CRM and the company's related systems.



Collect and organize signed work authorizations, contracts, photographs, moisture records, inspection reports, estimates, invoices, completion certificates, and other required documentation.



Review job files routinely for missing documents, unclear notes, incomplete tasks, or unresolved follow-ups.



Ensure all emails, telephone notes, reports, and project documents are saved to the correct job file using company naming and filing standards.



Prepare project-status summaries and exception reports for management, highlighting delays, risks, missing information, and decisions required.



Coordinate with bookkeeping so that completed job files contain everything necessary for accurate and timely billing.



Billing, Collections, and Administrative Support



Confirm that project completion documents and billing information are collected and submitted promptly.



Follow up on missing signatures, customer documents, purchase orders, insurance information, and other items delaying billing or payment.



Assist with professional collection calls and emails when assigned; this position requires comfort discussing outstanding invoices.



Help organize attorney correspondence, notices, lien-related information, and supporting documents under management direction.



Maintain accurate follow-up dates and records of collection activity without making unauthorized legal, payment, or settlement commitments.



Operational Follow-Through



Review open projects daily and actively chase missing answers rather than waiting for others to respond.



Identify recurring coordination problems and recommend practical improvements to workflows, templates, checklists, and procedures.



Follow established company procedures while exercising sound judgment when an unusual situation arises.



Participate in project-review meetings and arrive prepared with accurate job status, open issues, and recommended next actions.



Perform other reasonable coordination and administrative duties required to keep company operations running smoothly.



Required Qualifications



At least three years of experience in project coordination, customer service, restoration, construction, property management, logistics, or a similar deadline-driven environment.



Excellent spoken and written English, including the ability to communicate confidently by telephone and write professional emails.



Strong computer skills and the ability to learn CRM, scheduling, telephone, document-management, and Microsoft 365 systems quickly.



Reliable high-speed internet, a professional remote workspace, and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.



Ability to work the full 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time schedule consistently.



Stable employment history and a genuine interest in long-term employment with one company.



Preferred Experience



Restoration, construction, insurance, property management, legal support, or service-business coordination experience.



Experience working with U.S. customers and service providers.



Experience using a CRM, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, cloud-based telephone systems, and shared document storage.



Experience coordinating field employees, subcontractors, or multiple active customer projects.



Experience with invoicing follow-up, collections, legal documentation, or lien-support administration.



Personal Characteristics



Ownership: You take responsibility for getting the answer and closing the loop.



Persistence: You follow up professionally and repeatedly without becoming discouraged or abrasive.



Organization: You can manage many moving projects without losing details, deadlines, or documents.



Judgment: You know what you can handle independently and what must be escalated.



Composure: You remain calm, respectful, and productive when customers or situations become difficult.



Accuracy: Your notes, schedules, files, and communications can be relied upon.



Initiative: You look ahead, identify what is missing, and act before someone has to remind you.



Teamwork: You support the field and office teams and do not treat necessary work as beneath you.



Performance Standards



Performance will be evaluated primarily on:



Accuracy and completeness of project files and CRM records.



Timeliness of scheduling, customer responses, documentation, and follow-up.



Number of preventable missed appointments, communication failures, or stalled projects.



Ability to maintain control of multiple open projects and clearly report their status.



Professionalism and effectiveness in customer, vendor, crew, attorney, and collections communications.



Dependability, attendance, adherence to schedule, and long-term commitment.



Authority and Escalation



The Project Coordinator is expected to make routine scheduling and administrative decisions within company procedures. Pricing changes, settlement decisions, legal positions, customer concessions, contractual commitments, and unusual operational risks must be escalated to management before any commitment is made.



Employment Expectations



This is a full-time, long-term position and not a temporary assignment or secondary job.



The employee must be available, responsive, and focused during the entire assigned schedule, except for approved breaks.



Professional appearance and camera participation may be required for video meetings.



Confidential customer, financial, insurance, legal, and company information must be protected at all times.



Continued employment is subject to satisfactory performance during the company's initial probationary period.



Equal Opportunity



Restoration Billing Services considers qualified applicants based on their skills, experience, reliability, and ability to perform the position. The company does not discriminate on the basis of legally protected characteristics.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
PLEASE READ THE QUALIFICATIONS CAREFULLY.

A RESUME IS REQUIRED TO BE CONSIDERED. MESSAGES WITHOUT A RESUME WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.

THE CONTRACT WILL BE MANAGED THROUGH DEEL, AND WORK WILL BE TRACKED USING HUBSTAFF.

INTERNATIONAL TEAM MEMBERS ARE ELIGIBLE FOR 17 DAYS OF PAID TIME OFF (PTO).



ABOUT BOOSTED COMMERCE



Boosted Commerce (founded in 2019) is a digitally-native, CPG platform focused on acquiring and building new, fast-growing beauty, health, and wellness brands. We are a seasoned team of traditional retail and ecommerce operators already scaling several consumer brands with proven product-market fit.



As we expand our operations, we are looking for a highly motivated Senior Accountant to join our accounting team and help us build robust, scalable accounting practices that support our continued growth.



Position Summary



The Senior Accountant will play a key role in managing weekly and month-end accounting operations related to sales audit, payment reconciliation, cash applications, multi-currency transactions, inventory management, and sales tax. This position requires strong experience working with eCommerce platforms and high transaction volumes, along with excellent problem-solving, process improvement, analytical, and organizational skills.



You will work closely with the Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to ensure financial accuracy, timely reporting, and operational efficiency.



Key Responsibilities

Perform and support the monthly close process for Revenue, Cash, AR, Inventory & COGS, and Prepaid accounts.

Prepare and maintain supporting documentation, reconciliations, and internal controls to ensure accuracy and support audit and compliance requirements.

Audit and reconcile sales transactions across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, and other eCommerce platforms. Investigate and resolve variances, missing transactions, and sales invoices.

Reconcile cash receipts and AR balances across multiple payment platforms, including Amazon, Shopify, Payoneer, PayPal, Stripe, and other payment providers, as well as the accounting ERP system.

Investigate and resolve GL discrepancies and reconciling items in a timely manner.

Support inventory accounting and reconciliations, including inventory adjustments, inventory in transit, and prepaid inventory.

Partner with the Supply Chain team to investigate and resolve inventory and COGS variances.

Prepare and support monthly reporting and analysis related to Amazon operating expenses, Shopify sales tax, and other financial activities.

Support various ad hoc accounting and financial analysis projects as needed.

Identify opportunities to improve and streamline billing, reconciliation, reporting, and accounting processes.

Recommend and implement process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.



Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

5+ years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in an eCommerce, DTC, consumer goods, or high-volume transaction environment.

Strong understanding of GAAP and the month-end close process.

Demonstrated experience preparing balance sheet reconciliations, supporting schedules, and financial analyses, including resolving complex reconciling items.

CPA or CPA candidate preferred.

Strong hands-on experience reconciling multi-channel sales and payment gateways and analyzing detailed transaction reports from platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Shopify, and TikTok Shop.

Strong experience with ERP systems, with NetSuite highly preferred.

Experience supporting or participating in accounting system implementations, process improvements, or other operational projects.

Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced remote environment.

Excellent communication skills and strong attention to detail.

title: Medical Sales Conversion Specialist / Sales Expert
description:
We are looking for a confident, results-driven Medical Clinic Sales Expert who can turn patient inquiries into scheduled appointments and help prospective patients take the next step toward their health, wellness, and aesthetic goals.



The ideal candidate has excellent communication skills, a persuasive yet patient-centered approach, and a proven ability to convert leads into paying patients. You should be comfortable handling inquiries, following up with prospective patients, overcoming objections, and closing sales without being overly pushy.



If you enjoy talking to people, building trust, and achieving sales targets, we want to hear from you!



Key Responsibilities



Convert Leads into Appointments: Respond to inquiries from phone calls, text messages,
s, social media, and website forms, guiding prospects toward booking an appointment.



Master Follow-Ups: Proactively follow up with leads who have not responded, missed calls, postponed scheduling, or expressed interest but have not booked.



Handle Objections: Confidently address concerns about pricing, insurance coverage, treatment benefits, time commitments, and scheduling.



Close Sales: Help qualified prospects move forward with appropriate clinic services and programs.



Promote Clinic Services: Communicate the value of medical weight-loss programs, medical aesthetics treatments, laser hair removal, skin rejuvenation, skin tightening, and other wellness services.



Improve Appointment Show Rates: Confirm appointments, remind patients of their scheduled visits, and follow up with those who cancel or fail to show up.



Build Patient Relationships: Create a welcoming, professional experience that makes prospective patients feel heard, supported, and confident in their decision.



Track Sales Performance: Maintain accurate lead records, document follow-ups, and monitor conversion rates, bookings, and sales results in the clinic's CRM or scheduling system.



Meet Sales Targets: Consistently work toward daily, weekly, and monthly goals for lead conversion, appointments booked, and revenue generation.



Follow Healthcare Standards: Maintain patient confidentiality and communicate responsibly. Never promise guaranteed medical results or provide medical advice outside your scope.



Qualifications



At least 2 years of experience in sales, appointment setting, lead conversion, or business development.



Experience in medical aesthetics, healthcare, weight loss, wellness, med spas, or other service-based businesses is highly preferred.



Excellent spoken and written English.



Strong phone communication, active listening, persuasion, negotiation, and closing skills.



Comfortable making outbound calls and conducting consistent follow-ups.



Able to handle rejection and objections professionally.



Self-motivated, target-driven, organized, and accountable for results.



Experience using CRM systems, appointment scheduling software, and messaging platforms.



A reliable internet connection, a quiet workspace, and a dependable computer for remote work.



What We’re Looking For



We need someone who understands that sales is not just about answering questions—it is about building trust, identifying needs, communicating value, and helping interested prospects take action.



You should be able to:



Turn “I’m just asking for information” into a meaningful conversation that leads to a booking.



Handle “It’s too expensive” by explaining value and discussing appropriate available options.



Re-engage leads who stop responding.



Encourage hesitant prospects without pressuring them.



Take ownership of leads and follow through until they book, decline, or are appropriately placed into a follow-up process.



Use every conversation as an opportunity to improve the patient experience and clinic growth.



Performance Expectations



Success in this role will be measured by:



Lead-to-appointment conversion rate.



Number of qualified appointments booked.



Follow-up completion and lead response time.



Appointment attendance and cancellation recovery.



Sales or treatment-program conversion rate, where applicable.



Accuracy of CRM documentation and overall patient communication quality.



Why Join Us?



Opportunity to grow with a healthcare and wellness organization.



A performance-focused environment where initiative and results matter.



Training on clinic services, sales conversations, objection handling, and patient engagement.



The opportunity to make a meaningful difference by helping people explore services aligned with their goals.



How to Apply



Submit your resume along with a brief introduction highlighting your sales experience, industries served, and measurable results.



Please include your answers to these questions:



How many years of sales or appointment-setting experience do you have?



Have you worked with a medical clinic, med spa, weight-loss center, or wellness business?



What is your average lead-to-appointment conversion rate, if known?



How do you handle a prospect who says, “I’m interested, but I need to think about it”?



Are you comfortable making outbound calls and working toward daily sales targets?



We are looking for a sales professional who can build trust, take ownership, and turn opportunities into measurable results.

*
 content for
 and other relevant platforms.

*Preparing and scheduling approved social media content when required.

*Supporting occasional promotional campaigns, website graphics, flyers, event materials and other branded marketing assets.

*Maintaining an organised library of photographs, videos, templates and completed content.

*Understanding our brand values, target audience and business goals.

*Communicating regularly with the salon owner, providing progress updates and meeting agreed deadlines.

*Suggesting creative ideas and improvements to help grow our online presence.

*Supporting lead generation through engaging content and effective calls to action.

*Additional skills that would be an advantage:

*Experience with ManyChat, Instagram automation,
 marketing, Meta Ads and simple website graphics would be beneficial, but are not essential.

Job Qualifications



The VA should:



Have previous experience creating social media content for businesses, ideally in beauty, hair, wellness or luxury lifestyle.

Be highly proficient in Canva.

Have strong video editing skills using CapCut or similar software.

Have excellent written English, spelling and grammar, with the ability to write naturally for a UK audience.

Understand Instagram Reels, Stories, carousels and social media best practices.

Have a strong understanding of storytelling, engaging captions and customer psychology.

Have a good eye for sophisticated, premium branding and design.

Be organised, reliable and able to work independently.

Have excellent attention to detail.



Be proactive, resourceful and confident suggesting new ideas.

Be comfortable receiving feedback and making revisions.

Be willing to learn about our specialist hair services and brand identity.

Have experience working remotely and communicating effectively with clients.

Be able to provide examples of previous social media content, video editing and graphic design work.



This Is For You IF...



You love creating beautiful, engaging social media content.

You enjoy transforming rough ideas into polished creative work.



You understand that great content tells a story and encourages people to take action.

You have a strong eye for detail, design and brand consistency.



You enjoy working with premium beauty and lifestyle brands.

You are confident taking initiative rather than waiting for instructions.



You are organised, reliable and take pride in meeting deadlines.

You enjoy learning new skills and improving your creative work.



You are looking for a long term opportunity with a growing UK business.

You are enthusiastic, professional and enjoy being part of a creative team.





Our Working Arrangement:

This position will initially be 5 hours per week, with the potential to increase as the role develops.



We are looking for someone who can work efficiently, communicate regularly and deliver high quality creative work within agreed deadlines.



You will receive photographs, videos, voice notes and content ideas from the salon owner.



You will be responsible for transforming these materials into polished content ready for review and approval.



We value quality, creativity, communication and initiative.





Your Next Steps:



If this sounds like your kind of position, we'd love to hear from you!

House of Hair Hostess Team



Solihull | Birmingham | United Kingdom

title: GoHighLevel, AI & Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
Full-Time | Remote | GHL, AI Agents, Sales Funnels & Business Automation



About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled, full-time **GoHighLevel, AI & Marketing Automation Specialist** to take ownership of our marketing technology, sales funnels, CRM integrations, AI automation, and digital marketing systems.

You should be able to build websites, create high-converting sales funnels, develop complex automations, integrate AI agents, and identify opportunities to use AI to make our company more efficient.

### 1. GoHighLevel Management & Development

- Develop
 and SMS marketing campaigns and automated follow-up sequences.

 campaigns, landing page content, advertising creatives, and campaign optimization.

- Design AI workflows with appropriate human approvals, error handling, logging, and quality controls.



### 3. Sales Funnels & Website Development



- Design and build high-converting websites and landing pages using GoHighLevel.

- Develop webinar funnels, application funnels, sales funnels, and checkout experiences.

- Configure order bumps, one-click upsells, downsells, and recurring subscription payments.

- Optimize websites and funnels for conversion rates, mobile responsiveness, and performance.

- Set up A/B testing, conversion tracking, analytics, and marketing attribution.

- Integrate AI tools to accelerate funnel development, copywriting, testing, and optimization.



### 4. Platform Migration & Software Consolidation



- Migrate existing websites and funnels from ClickFunnels into GoHighLevel.

- Audit existing Zapier, Make, and n8n automations.

- Replace redundant third-party automations with native GHL workflows whenever practical.

- Consolidate marketing platforms to reduce monthly software expenses.

- Build and maintain integrations between GoHighLevel and Close CRM.

- Automate lead capture, lead qualification, appointment booking, and sales follow-ups.

- Configure APIs, webhooks, custom fields, and advanced workflow logic.

- Ensure accurate lead synchronization between platforms.

- Prevent duplicate records, incorrect field mappings, and lost customer information.

- Develop automated lead routing, appointment reminders, and pipeline management systems.

- Implement AI-powered processes that help our sales team operate more efficiently.



### 6. Advanced Automation & AI Agent Development



- Build complex workflows using n8n, Zapier, Make, APIs, and webhooks.

- Develop AI agents that can connect to multiple applications and execute defined business processes.

- Integrate AI models such as ChatGPT/OpenAI and Claude into marketing and business workflows.

- Develop AI-powered assistants for customer support, lead management, reporting, and internal operations.

- Create automated reporting systems that track funnel performance, lead generation, and sales activity.

- Identify manual workflows that can be replaced or improved with AI and automation.

- Test, monitor, maintain, and continuously improve automated systems.



### 7. Digital Marketing Systems & Optimization



- Set up and manage the technical infrastructure for
 marketing, SMS marketing, and lead nurturing campaigns.

- Build AI-assisted marketing workflows for content creation, campaign development, and optimization.

- Implement marketing analytics, tracking pixels, Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.

- Improve lead conversion through automation, personalization, and behavioral triggers.

- Help develop scalable marketing systems that support paid advertising, webinars, and organic lead generation.

- Identify opportunities to increase marketing efficiency and reduce customer acquisition costs.



### 8. System Maintenance & Documentation



- Monitor all marketing systems, integrations, and automations.

- Troubleshoot errors and resolve technical issues proactively.

- Document workflow logic, integrations, and system architecture.

- Maintain backup procedures and test changes before implementation.

- Provide weekly progress reports outlining completed projects, performance improvements, and upcoming priorities.



## Required Qualifications



- Advanced experience with **GoHighLevel**, including funnels, websites, CRM, and workflow automations.

- Proven experience building sales funnels and professional websites.

- Strong experience with **n8n, Zapier, Make, APIs, and webhooks**.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools such as OpenAI, Claude, and AI automation platforms.

- Ability to build practical AI agents or AI-powered business workflows.

- Strong understanding of digital marketing, lead generation, and customer acquisition funnels.

- Experience integrating CRMs and marketing platforms.

- Knowledge of
 marketing, SMS marketing, and marketing automation.

- Experience with AI-assisted ad creation, campaign optimization, and marketing analytics.

- Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and JSON.

- Experience with Stripe, subscriptions, and payment integrations.

- Experience with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Meta Pixel.

- Familiarity with SaaS businesses, online education, or digital marketing agencies.



## What Success Looks Like



Within your first 90 days, we want to accomplish the following:



1. Consolidate our websites, funnels, and forms into GoHighLevel.

2. Establish a reliable integration between GoHighLevel and Close CRM.

3. Reduce unnecessary Zapier, n8n, and other third-party automation dependencies.

4. Improve our lead generation, qualification, appointment booking, and follow-up workflows.

5. Implement practical AI-powered automations that eliminate repetitive manual work.

6. Launch AI agents or assistants that support our marketing, sales, or internal operations.

7. Establish reliable tracking, reporting, and monitoring across our marketing systems.

8. Document our technology infrastructure so it can be maintained and scaled efficiently.



## Who We're Looking For



We want someone who is technical, creative, resourceful, and proactive.



You should be comfortable working with both traditional marketing automation platforms and modern AI technologies.



We're particularly interested in candidates who can look at an existing business process and figure out how to make it **faster, smarter, more automated, and more profitable**.



You should be able to take an idea from concept to implementation without needing constant supervision.



This is a long-term, full-time role with opportunities to grow as our company expands.



## How to Apply



Please submit:



1. A brief introduction describing your experience with GoHighLevel, marketing automation, and AI.

2. Examples of websites, landing pages, or sales funnels you have personally built.

3. Examples of AI agents or AI-powered workflows you have developed.

4. A short Loom video demonstrating a complex automation, AI agent, or GHL system you created.

5. Your experience with APIs, CRM integrations, and automation troubleshooting.

6. Your expected monthly compensation and full-time availability.



**Required Application Question:**



Our company currently uses GoHighLevel, Close CRM, ClickFunnels, Jotform, Zapier, and n8n. We want to consolidate our marketing infrastructure into primarily GoHighLevel and Close CRM while implementing AI agents and automations to improve marketing, sales, and business operations.



**How would you approach this project, what would you migrate first, and what practical AI automations would you recommend implementing?**



Please be specific. We are looking for someone who can design and implement solutions, not just recommend software.

title: After Hours Dispatch Lead (Asset Operations)
description:
AJG Transport is expanding its asset operations division and seeking an experienced, dependable, and results-driven After Hours Dispatch Lead (Asset Operations) to oversee our overnight trucking operations.



We are looking for a hands-on operations leader who can manage fleet movements, coordinate driver dispatches, resolve operational issues, and lead a remote fleet management team (FMT). This role requires strong US trucking experience, sound operational judgment, and the ability to take full ownership of night operations in a fast-paced environment.



Role Overview

You will serve as the primary operational lead during the night shift, overseeing active trucks, drivers, trailers, and a team of approximately 5–8 remote associates. Your responsibility is to ensure every load is properly assigned, dispatched, tracked, and completed while proactively resolving breakdowns, delays, equipment issues, and service risks.



This is a hands-on leadership role, not solely a coordination or administrative position. You will be expected to make timely operational decisions, hold your team accountable, and ensure a smooth transition to the day shift.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Oversee night asset operations, monitoring truck movements, driver availability, trailer assignments, and scheduled pickups and deliveries.

• Lead and support a remote team of 5–8 associates, managing workload distribution, shift coverage, performance, and accountability.

• Coordinate driver dispatches, verify equipment assignments, conduct structured check calls, and ensure drivers receive clear instructions before scheduled movements.

• Monitor real-time fleet activity using GPS tracking systems and other operational platforms while maintaining accurate dispatch records.

• Investigate and resolve overnight operational issues, including breakdowns, roadside emergencies, route delays, equipment shortages, and missed appointments.

• Coordinate with maintenance, brokerage, and load planning teams to recover loads, arrange equipment solutions, and minimize service disruptions.

• Conduct scheduled tracking audits, maintain accurate operational reports, escalate critical risks, and prepare detailed shift handoffs.

• Identify recurring operational issues, recommend process improvements, and reinforce established SOPs across the team.



What Success Looks Like

• Maintain full visibility and operational control over active trucks, drivers, and trailers throughout the night shift.

• Ensure loads are dispatched on time, with minimal delays, missed appointments, or preventable service failures.

• Resolve operational problems proactively instead of allowing unresolved issues to carry over to the next shift.

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date information across tracking systems, dispatch records, and performance reports.

• Build a reliable and accountable night team that consistently meets operational expectations.

• Deliver clear, organized shift handoffs with documented issues, actions taken, and outstanding priorities.



Who We’re Looking For

• At least 3 years of direct US trucking operations experience in dispatch, fleet management, load coordination, carrier operations, or similar roles.

• At least 1 year of team leadership or supervisory experience, including workload management, performance coaching, and accountability.

• Hands-on experience using GPS and fleet visibility platforms or comparable systems.

• Strong understanding of US trucking operations, driver dispatch, Hours of Service (HOS), equipment coordination, and time-sensitive freight movements.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to provide structured, concise, and actionable operational updates.

• Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to make independent decisions under pressure.

• Highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Team-oriented, coachable, and dependable, with a strong ownership mindset and willingness to hold themselves and others accountable.

• Must have a reliable backup internet connection and backup power source to maintain operational continuity.

• Experience with government freight operations, fleet repair system, TMS, fuel card system, or freight recovery is an advantage. Spanish proficiency is a plus for Mexico-based applicants.



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Permanent remote opportunity with a stable, long-term setup.

• $75 monthly stipend (eligible after working for 30 days)

• Competitive hourly compensation based on location and experience.

• Hands-on leadership role with direct responsibility for operational performance.

• Structured systems, clear expectations, and defined performance KPIs.

• Direct collaboration with US-based operations leadership.

• Opportunities to improve processes, strengthen team performance, and take on greater operational responsibilities.

• Performance recognition with growth potential for strong contributors.



Schedule & Work Setup

• Direct hire and full-time position with a US-based trucking company and permanent work-from-home setup.

• Shift: Approximately 3:00 PM – 1:00 AM US Central Time, with flexibility to extend as operationally required. 

• Workdays: Includes weekends; this is not a standard Monday–Friday schedule. To be finalized during hiring

• Active participation in Zoom for remote operational communication and collaboration is required throughout the shift.

• Time-tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable primary internet, backup internet, and backup power are mandatory.



If you have strong US trucking experience, know how to lead a team under pressure, and can take ownership of overnight fleet operations without waiting for instructions, we want to hear from you.

title: Medical Receptionist and Scheduler
description:
We are a busy Neuropsychological practice located in Houston, Texas, USA. We are seeking a highly organized, tech-savvy, and independent Remote Medical Receptionist and Scheduler to manage our virtual front-office operations in this fully-remote position. In this role, you will be the virtual face of our practice, serving as the primary point of contact for patients via phone,
, and secure messaging. You will be responsible for scheduling patients within our electronic health record system, SimplePractice, while upholding the highest standards of confidentiality. Because this role deals directly with protected health information (PHI) in a work-from-home setting, strict adherence to HIPAA compliance and maintaining a secure, private home office environment are absolute prerequisites.



Office Hours (Houston-time): 9 am - 5 pm, Monday - Thursday, and 9 am - 2 pm Fridays. Closed Saturday and Sunday CDT

Work Hours (Philippines-time): 10 pm - 6 am, Monday - Thursday, and 10 pm - 3 am on Fridays. Closed Saturday and Sunday

10% Night Shift Differential + HMO stipend included.



Duties and Responsibilities



• Virtual Reception: Act as the primary, professional point of contact for incoming calls. Manage incoming referrals received via
 and digital fax by entering the new referrals into SimplePractice and our Google Drive database. Call and schedule patients when new referrals are received.

• SimplePractice Scheduling: Manage, coordinate, and streamline provider calendars directly within SimplePractice. Schedule, reschedule, and cancel appointments efficiently to minimize gaps, prevent double-bookings, and optimize daily workflows.

• Digital Communication Management: Operate a cloud-based phone system (Grasshopper) and handle virtual communication channels. Routinely monitor, screen, and route messages from the secure patient portal and practice
 to appropriate clinical team members.

• Rigorous HIPAA Enforcement: Maintain strict HIPAA compliance across all daily operations. Ensure all patient communication, electronic documentation, and file handoffs strictly follow security protocols for handling Protected Health Information (PHI).

• Patient Retention: Perform appointment confirmations via phone, manage waitlists, and proactively re-engage clients to fill sudden schedule openings and reduce overall clinic no-show rates.



Qualifications and Skills



• Language Proficiency: Strong English is critical for this position, additional languages are a definitely plus because we are in a very diverse city (Houston, Texas).

• Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; an Associate’s degree or relevant administrative certification is a plus.

• EHR Experience: 1 year of direct, hands-on experience utilizing SimplePractice is highly preferred or extensive experience with highly similar behavioral health/medical EHR platforms.

• Remote Work Capabilities: Proven ability to work autonomously, stay self-motivated, and maintain high productivity in a 100% remote setting.

• HIPAA & Privacy Training: Strong, demonstrated understanding of HIPAA privacy rules, data security practices, and patient confidentiality standards within a remote/work-from-home context.

• Technical Proficiency: Comfortable utilizing modern, cloud-based applications including our current phone system app, Grasshopper, secure
 systems, and remote team messaging tools (e.g., Slack, Microsoft Teams).

• Communication Skills: Superb verbal and written communication skills, with an empathetic phone presence and exceptional digital etiquette.



Home Office & Security Requirements



• A dedicated, quiet, and secure home office space free from distractions or unauthorized individuals who could see or hear private client data.

• A reliable, high-speed internet connection (minimum download/upload speeds specified upon hire) with a wired ethernet connection preferred.

• A password-protected personal computer or laptop capable of running modern web browsers smoothly, equipped with updated antivirus software and a secure virtual private network (VPN) if required.
