title: Ad Prompt Executor
description:
We’re looking for someone from the e-commerce / dropshipping world to execute ad and funnel prompts and organize the outputs in a spreadsheet.



This is NOT a data entry job. You won’t be doing data analysis, reports, or anything like that. But you DO need to understand what you’re working with. You’ll be executing prompts that generate ad creatives, ad copy, and funnel pages. If you don’t know what a sales funnel is, what Shopify is, or how
 Ads work, this role isn’t for you.



You’re not building strategy. You’re not media buying. You’re not writing copy from scratch. But you need to look at the output and know if something is obviously off before you paste the link and move on.



What you’ll be doing:

→ Receive prompts from the team that generate ad creatives, copy, and funnel content

→ Execute each prompt exactly as instructed

→ Review the output with enough e-commerce knowledge to spot obvious issues

→ Paste the output links into the correct columns in a shared spreadsheet

→ Repeat



You MUST already know what these are (not “willing to learn”):

→ Shopify

→ Sales funnels (advertorials, landing pages, checkout flows)

→
/Meta Ads (ad creatives, ad copy, campaign structure)

→ Hubstaff

→ Basic understanding of dropshipping operations



Do NOT apply if:

→ You’ve never worked in e-commerce or dropshipping

→ You don’t know what a funnel is

→ You’ve never seen the inside of Shopify or Meta Ads Manager

→ You’re about to send an application listing your SQL, Oracle, QuickBooks, and data analysis skills (we don’t need any of that)

→ You’re copy pasting the same application you sent to 50 other posts today



How to apply (read carefully):

→ Start your application with the word: velvet

→ In ONE sentence, tell us your experience with e-commerce (dropshipping, Shopify, funnels, ads, whatever you’ve actually done)

→ Your weekly availability (hours per day / days per week)

→ Confirm you’re ok with $5/funnel and Hubstaff screenshots

→ Write your application yourself. If it looks like it was written by AI, it will be ignored. We’re not hiring people who can’t even apply without ChatGPT. Keep it short, keep it real, write it by hand.



AP Requirement:

→ This role has a minimum AP requirement. We will only review applications that meet our internal AP threshold. All applications below it will be automatically eliminated without being read. If you’re not serious about this role, don’t waste your points.



Pay:

→ $5/funnel tracked via Hubstaff with screenshots for quality control

→ Paid test period

→ Room to grow into more responsibility if you prove yourself



Verification:

→ We’ll ask you to send a photo holding a piece of paper with a specific word we give you

→ We’ll also ask for a second photo holding a specific object of our choice to verify you’re not using AI generated images

→ Both are mandatory. If that’s a problem, don’t apply.



NDA required before starting.

title: Graphic Designer (Paid Social Ad Creative)
description:
About Penang Media



Penang Media is a London-based performance marketing agency for DTC brands. We run paid social for a focused mix of clients across footwear, supplements, and wellness, selling into the UK, EU, US, and Australia. We test a lot of ads every week, and we build tooling, AI included, so the team spends its time making work that wins rather than hunting for inputs.



The role



You’ll turn creative briefs into finished ads for our clients’ Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns: mostly statics, plus GIFs and simple motion. You’ll work from briefs set by our Lead Creative Strategist and Brand Success Manager, produce multiple variations of each concept across formats, and turn revisions around fast. Speed and volume matter as much as polish. Your output is what gets tested.



What you’ll do



• Design static ads for Meta from written briefs across feed, story, and carousel formats.

• Turn one concept into many: variations in layout, colour, headline, format, and style, so the team can test what works.

• Build simple GIFs and motion graphics where a brief calls for it.

• Resize, adapt, and refresh winning ads quickly.

• Use AI tools (image generation, editing, ideation) as part of your everyday workflow, and bring new ones to the team when you find them.

• Keep files organised in Figma and shared drives so anyone can pick them up.

• Communicate clearly in Slack: flag blockers early, confirm deadlines, ask when a brief is unclear.



What we’re looking for



• 2+ years designing for ecommerce or DTC brands, with paid social ads in your portfolio (not just branding or logo work).

• Expert in Figma and Photoshop.

• Already using AI tools in your design work, or eager to start. We’ll give you access and we expect you to use it.

• Strong eye for layout, typography, and hierarchy, and the judgement to know when an ad is something people would stop scrolling for.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• Fast. You can take a brief in the morning and have several finished variations by the afternoon.

• Reliable with deadlines and fixed working hours.

• A plus, not required: Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere, or CapCut.



Hours, pay, setup



• Full-time, 40 hours a week, remote.

• Fixed schedule with at least four hours of overlap with UK business hours, which falls in the Philippine afternoon and evening. No graveyard shift.

• ₱41,000 to ₱58,000 per month depending on experience, paid monthly, plus 13th-month pay.

• Written review at 90 days with a step up within the range tied to your output.

• Stable internet and a machine that runs Figma and Adobe without complaint.



How to apply



Send your portfolio with paid social ads clearly marked, and tell us in a few lines which AI tools you’ve used in your design work and how. Shortlisted candidates complete a 90-minute design test from a real brief.

title: Senior SEO Specialist – Australian Education Company (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About us:



We are  an established Australian education company with over 15 years of experience helping students achieve academic success.



We have a strong online presence, an established brand, and an ambitious growth strategy. We are currently investing in a new, faster, modern website and want an experienced SEO professional to take full ownership of our organic search performance.



This is an opportunity to join a growing international company, work directly with our management team, and have a meaningful impact on the business.



About the Role:



We are looking for a highly experienced SEO specialist who can independently manage and execute our entire SEO strategy.



This is NOT an entry-level position. We are not looking for someone who has completed a short SEO course or has a basic understanding of search engine optimisation.



We want someone with at least 5 years of hands-on SEO experience, a proven track record of improving organic rankings and traffic, and an excellent understanding of how SEO is evolving with AI-powered search.



You will be responsible for both developing the strategy and executing it.



Key Responsibilities:



SEO Strategy & Technical Optimisation



- Take ownership of our overall SEO strategy and organic growth.



- Conduct regular technical SEO audits and identify opportunities for improvement.



- Analyse website architecture, internal linking, crawlability, indexing, redirects, and structured data.



- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and content gap analysis.



- Optimise existing pages and identify opportunities for new high-performing landing pages.



- Work closely with our web developer and designer to implement technical and on-page improvements.



- Monitor algorithm updates and adapt our strategy accordingly.



Link Building & Outreach



- Develop and execute a high-quality backlink acquisition strategy.



- Identify and secure relevant backlinks from genuine, authoritative Australian websites.



- Conduct outreach to Australian education websites, parenting blogs, publications, schools, and other relevant organisations.



- Build relationships that create ongoing link-building opportunities.



- Audit existing backlinks and identify opportunities and risks.



- Focus on sustainable, white-hat link building — no spam, link farms, or PBNs.



Analytics & Performance



- Expertly use Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and Ahrefs (or similar).



- Monitor rankings, impressions, CTR, organic traffic, and conversions.



- Investigate ranking declines and identify actionable solutions.



- Produce clear, actionable performance reports.



- Identify opportunities based on data rather than assumptions.



- Track the impact of SEO activities and demonstrate measurable results.



AI Search Optimisation (AEO / GEO)



- Develop strategies to improve our visibility in AI-powered search platforms, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.



- Understand Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO).



- Implement content and technical improvements to increase our visibility in AI-generated answers.



- Stay informed about developments in AI search and emerging best practices.





Requirements



Essential:



Minimum 5 years of professional, hands-on SEO experience.



Proven track record of achieving meaningful improvements in organic rankings, traffic, and conversions.



Advanced knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Ahrefs.



Strong technical SEO knowledge, including indexing, crawling, redirects, structured data, and site architecture.



Demonstrated experience acquiring high-quality, relevant backlinks through genuine outreach.



Experience with Australian, UK, or US websites and competitive English-language search markets.



Up-to-date knowledge of AI search and modern SEO strategies.



Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks, and take ownership of results.



Strong written English and communication skills.



Comfortable collaborating with developers and designers.



Highly Desirable:



Experience working on large websites with thousands of pages.



Experience with local SEO and location-based landing pages.



Familiarity with modern website frameworks, including Astro or other JavaScript-based websites.



Experience recovering websites from ranking declines or managing major website migrations.



Previous experience in the education industry.





What We Offer



Long-term, stable, full-time remote employment.



Opportunity to work with an established Australian company.



Direct access to management and the ability to influence business strategy.



Access to professional SEO tools and support from our development and design teams.



Freedom to recommend and implement strategies rather than simply following instructions.



Salary negotiable based on your experience, capabilities, and results.



Opportunities for salary growth as you demonstrate value.





How to Apply



We are only interested in applicants who can demonstrate real SEO expertise.



Please include the following in your application:



Your SEO experience: How many years have you worked professionally in SEO, and what types of websites have you managed?



Proof of results: Provide at least two case studies demonstrating improvements you personally achieved in organic traffic, rankings, or conversions. Screenshots from Google Search Console or Ahrefs are strongly preferred.



Link-building experience: Explain how you acquire high-quality backlinks, particularly from Australian websites. Include examples of links you have successfully secured.



AI search knowledge: Explain what you are currently doing to optimise websites for AI-powered search engines.



Your expected monthly salary in Philippine pesos.



Please be specific about the work you personally performed and the measurable results you achieved.



Applications without relevant examples of previous SEO work will not be considered.



We are looking for someone exceptional who wants to grow with our company over the long term.

title: Purchasing Agent (NetSuite) - Own Every PO & Push Back on Vendors
description:
We're a US flooring and tile distributor based in Dallas, TX. We need a purchasing agent who OWNS this job - not someone who just processes it.



READ THIS FIRST

This role is not for someone who waits for instructions. We want someone who:

- Questions a vendor price increase instead of accepting it

- Catches errors before they reach a PO, and asks when something doesn't add up

- Chases late shipments without being reminded

- Tells us about a problem early, along with a proposed fix

- Is comfortable telling a vendor no, and comfortable telling us when something's wrong



If you'd rather keep your head down and stay quiet, this isn't the job for you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own purchasing end to end in NetSuite: PO creation, tracking, receipt and data accuracy

- Negotiate. Treat every vendor price as negotiable and fight increases on timing, volume or substitutions

- Track lead times and escalate delays immediately

- Verify and upload vendor price lists, including bulk CSV uploads

- Manage customer orders that require procurement: send status updates and coordinate delivery with our warehouse and logistics teams

- Cover quoting and order intake when needed



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 3 years of purchasing or procurement experience in distribution or manufacturing

- Hands-on NetSuite experience (required): POs, vendor records, inventory and CSV imports

- Strong Excel skills

- Fluent, confident spoken and written English

- Must work US Central business hours (8am-5pm CT), Monday to Friday

- Import experience (tile, stone, LVT) is a plus



ENGAGEMENT

Full-time (40 hrs/week), long-term. Paid trial period first.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the word "Vantage" and answer these:

1. A vendor
s a 6% price increase effective in two weeks. Write the actual reply you would send them.

2. Tell us about a time you pushed back on a vendor, a customer, or your boss. What happened?

3. You're entering a PO and the item cost doesn't match the last PO. What do you do?

4. Describe your NetSuite experience: which transactions did you create day to day, and have you done CSV imports?

5. Can you reliably work 8am-5pm US Central, Monday to Friday?



Applications that don't start with "Vantage" will be skipped, because following instructions is part of this job.

title: Shopify E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
About Making Scents Co.



Making Scents Co. (MSC) is a fragrance and lifestyle e-commerce business seeking a proactive, tech-savvy virtual assistant to help improve its Shopify store, streamline business operations, and support brand growth through digital marketing and social media.



We are looking for someone who can both build systems and manage them—not simply follow instructions. The ideal candidate has hands-on Shopify experience, understands workflow automation and third-party integrations, and can also create engaging social media content.



Primary Responsibilities



Phase 1: Shopify Setup, Systems & Optimization



* Audit the existing Shopify store, applications, settings, and customer experience.

* Identify opportunities to improve store functionality and operational efficiency.

* Build, configure, test, and document workflows and automations.

* Configure Shopify Flow where available and appropriate.

* Connect and troubleshoot Shopify apps and third-party integrations.

* Understand automation logic, APIs, and webhooks sufficiently to investigate common integration issues.

* Research cost-effective apps and tools to support business operations.

* Develop standard operating procedures for recurring tasks and workflows.

* Recommend improvements before implementing significant changes.



Phase 2: Ongoing E-Commerce Management



* Maintain product listings, descriptions, collections, and promotional updates.

* Monitor workflows, integrations, and store functionality.

* Assist with inventory and order management processes.

* Improve the customer shopping experience and identify opportunities to increase conversions.

* Maintain documentation and recommend ongoing operational improvements.



Social Media & Digital Marketing



* Develop and maintain a social media content calendar.

* Create branded graphics, captions, promotional materials, and short-form videos.

* Schedule and publish content across approved social media platforms.

* Support product launches, seasonal promotions, and marketing campaigns.

* Assist with
 marketing, customer retention, and abandoned-cart recovery.

* Monitor engagement, website traffic, and relevant sales metrics.

* Provide regular reports on completed work and campaign performance.



Required Qualifications



* Demonstrated hands-on experience with Shopify.

* Experience building workflows and business process automations.

* Experience configuring third-party app integrations.

* Understanding of automation logic and basic API/webhook concepts.

* Experience managing social media accounts and creating marketing content.

* Ability to create content calendars and execute marketing campaigns.

* Strong written English, organization, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and document processes.

* A portfolio or examples of previous work.



Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with Shopify Flow,
 marketing automation, and e-commerce analytics.

* Familiarity with Shopify Liquid, HTML, or CSS.

* Experience with fragrance, beauty, lifestyle, or other product-based brands.

* Familiarity with AI-assisted content creation and productivity tools.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction and summary of your relevant experience.

2. Links to Shopify stores you have managed or configured, where permitted.

3. An example of a workflow or automation you built and the problem it solved.

4. Examples of Shopify integrations you have configured or troubleshot.

5. Links to your social media, graphic design, video, or content calendar portfolio.

6. The tools and applications you regularly use.

7. Your expected hourly rate, available weekly hours, and preferred working schedule.



To demonstrate your attention to detail, begin your application with the exact phrase:



“MSC Shopify & Marketing Specialist”



Applications that do not include this phrase at the beginning will not be prioritized.



Please also include your relevant Shopify experience, examples of workflows and integrations you’ve built, and your social media marketing portfolio.



Working Arrangement

title: Dental Virtual Assistant
description:
WE ARE HIRING!



Remote Dental Insurance Verification & Billing Specialist (Part-Time)



Company: Platonics LLC

Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Work From Home

Employment Type: Part-Time

Work Schedule: 20 Hours Per Week

Time Zone: US Central Time (CST)



About the Opportunity



Platonics LLC is currently looking for a highly experienced Dental Insurance Verification & Billing Specialist to support one of our US-based dental healthcare clients.



We are seeking a detail-oriented, reliable, and experienced professional who has extensive hands-on knowledge of US dental insurance verification, benefits breakdown, claims follow-up, and insurance payment posting.



This position is strictly for applicants with relevant US dental insurance and billing experience.



The ideal candidate must be capable of working independently, following established procedures, and delivering accurate results with minimal supervision.



Key Responsibilities



1. Dental Insurance Verification & Benefits Breakdown



Verify patients' dental insurance eligibility, coverage, and benefits at least two days before scheduled appointments.



Review deductibles, annual maximums, coverage percentages, frequency limitations, waiting periods, exclusions, and other plan restrictions.



Prepare complete and accurate insurance benefit breakdowns using established templates.



Document verified insurance benefits in the dental practice management system.



Ensure insurance information is accurate and updated when changes occur.



Identify and escalate missing, incomplete, or conflicting insurance information.



2. Dental Insurance Claims Follow-Up



Monitor and track dental insurance claims and their payment status.



Follow up on outstanding, unpaid, denied, and aged insurance claims.



Document all follow-up activities accurately.



Identify claims requiring additional documentation, corrections, or escalation.



Coordinate with appropriate team members to help resolve outstanding insurance receivables.



3. Insurance Payment Posting & Patient Statements



Post electronic insurance payments (EFT) accurately to patient accounts.



Review electronic Explanations of Benefits (EOBs).



Verify insurance payments, adjustments, contractual write-offs, and remaining patient balances.



Review and validate contracted dental fee schedules.



Identify discrepancies in reimbursement amounts, payment calculations, and contractual adjustments.



Report unusual reimbursement patterns or suspected fee schedule changes.



Assist with patient balance reviews and statement preparation.



Escalate account discrepancies requiring further investigation.



4. Administrative Accuracy & HIPAA Compliance



Maintain complete and accurate records within the dental practice management system.



Follow established procedures for insurance verification, claims follow-up, and payment posting.



Ensure all patient information is handled securely and in accordance with HIPAA regulations.



Communicate unresolved issues and discrepancies promptly.



Support additional dental insurance and revenue cycle administrative responsibilities as assigned.



Minimum Qualifications — Strictly Required



Applicants MUST meet the following qualifications:



At least 2 years of relevant hands-on experience in US dental insurance verification, dental billing, insurance payment posting, or dental revenue cycle management.



Strong knowledge of US dental insurance plans, eligibility verification, benefits breakdowns, deductibles, annual maximums, and coverage limitations.



Proven experience reviewing EOBs and posting dental insurance payments.



Experience handling aged dental claims, insurance follow-ups, and outstanding balances.



Strong understanding of dental insurance fee schedules, contractual adjustments, and reimbursement discrepancies.



Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.



Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



Ability to follow established workflows, templates, and procedures.



Must possess a valid HIPAA certification.



Must be available to work 20 hours per week aligned with US Central Time.



Required Software Knowledge



Candidates must have familiarity with or relevant working experience using the following platforms:



Eaglesoft — Dental Practice Management System



Practice by Numbers (PBN) — Patient Communication and Practice Analytics



Vyne Trellis — Dental Revenue Cycle and Insurance Management Platform



Hands-on experience with these systems will be a strong advantage.



Work Schedule



Employment Type: Part-Time



Total Working Hours: 20 hours per week



Work Location: Remote / Work From Home



Time Zone: US Central Time



Schedule: To be finalized based on operational requirements



IMPORTANT NOTICE TO ALL APPLICANTS



WE WILL STRICTLY ENTERTAIN QUALIFIED APPLICANTS ONLY.



This position requires actual, relevant experience in US dental insurance verification, dental billing, and revenue cycle operations.



Please carefully review the qualifications before submitting your application.



We will NOT entertain or process applications from candidates who do not meet the minimum qualifications.



Applicants without the required dental insurance or billing experience are strongly discouraged from applying.



Experience in general customer service, virtual assistance, medical billing unrelated to dental operations, or other administrative roles does not automatically qualify an applicant for this position.



Only shortlisted candidates whose experience closely matches the requirements will be contacted for the next stage of recruitment.



How to Apply



Interested and qualified applicants are encouraged to submit their updated resume highlighting their relevant experience in:



US Dental Insurance Verification and Benefits Breakdown



Dental Insurance Claims Follow-Up



Insurance Payment Posting and EOB Review



Dental Practice Management Software



US Dental Revenue Cycle Management



Please indicate your years of relevant experience and the dental software platforms you have used.



Join Platonics LLC and become part of a growing team of healthcare professionals supporting US-based dental practices!



Platonics LLC

Connecting Exceptional Talent With Meaningful Opportunities.

title: US TRUCK DRIVER RECRUITER (REMOTE)
description:
About the Role



Schedule: Full-Time | US Eastern Time Hours (Monday – Friday, PH Night Shift)

Location: Remote (Work from Home)



We are a US-focused logistics consulting firm helping trucking companies streamline their operations, build reliable fleets, and hire top-tier commercial drivers.



We’re looking for a proactive, results-driven Truck Driver Recruiter to join our growing team. In this role, you will play a key part in sourcing, engaging, and screening Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) holders for our roster of US carrier clients.



If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love connecting with people over the phone, and want a role with a clear path toward closing placements and earning performance commissions, we’d love to connect with you!



What You’ll Do



>> Driver Sourcing & Pipeline Management: Proactively source active and passive CDL drivers through job boards (Indeed, Social Media, etc.) and build a steady candidate pipeline.

>> Screening & Outreach: Conduct high-volume outbound calls and initial telephone screens to evaluate driver qualifications, driving records (MVR), and job fit.

>> Client & Candidate Coordination: Schedule driver interviews, maintain timely candidate follow-ups, and keep client recruitment pipelines up to date.

>> Lead Hand-off & Onboarding Support: Initially qualify leads for senior team hand-offs, with full training provided to transition into end-to-end recruitment and placement closing.

>> Data Integrity & Reporting: Keep accurate candidate records in our tracking tools and provide weekly updates on recruitment metrics and lead activity.



Compensation & Career Growth



>> Competitive base salary + performance commission (per driver hired)

>> Comprehensive onboarding and continuous industry training provided.



Required Experience & Skills:



>> 3+ years of BPO / Contact Center experience serving US accounts, with demonstrated strength in Customer Service (inbound) phone interactions.

>> Excellent spoken and written English communication skills with strong active listening.

>> High attention to detail and strong data management skills (keeping candidate files clean and accurate).

>> Self-motivated, resilient mindset with the ability to handle high-volume outreach and prioritize tasks independently.



Nice-to-Have Skills:



>> Prior experience with driver recruitment or logistics staffing.

>> Familiarity with recruitment platforms (especially Indeed) and background screening tools (e.g., First Advantage, MVR/PSP checks).

>> Proficiency in Google Workspace, ClickUp/Notion, and Zoom.



Technical & Home Office Requirements



>> Primary Internet: Minimum 50 Mbps download/upload (wired connection preferred).

>> Backup Internet: Minimum 25 Mbps backup connection (wired or secondary line).

>> Hardware: Desktop or Laptop with at least Intel Core i3 (or better), minimum 8GB RAM (16GB preferred).

>> Audio Gear: Noise-canceling headset with microphone (e.g., Jabra Biz 1500 or equivalent) to ensure clear interview calls.

>> Environment: Quiet, dedicated home office space free from background noise.



How to Apply:



In your application cover letter, tell us about a time you had to make a tough decision under pressure. Walk us through how you arrived at your decision and how it ultimately turned out for you.



Thank you for your time, and we look forward to your applications!

title: Technical Recruiter (Remote)
description:
Role Overview



Barrister is seeking a motivated and proactive Technical Recruiter to join our

Technician Management & Deployment (TMD) division.

This is a high-volume, outbound recruiting role focused on identifying, screening, and

onboarding qualified field service technicians to support Barrister's nationwide service

requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Success requires someone who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls,

engaging prospective technicians, evaluating technical qualifications, and consistently

moving candidates through the recruiting and onboarding pipeline.



Key Responsibilities



High-Volume Talent Acquisition:

Actively source and recruit qualified field service technicians using job boards, resume

databases, professional networks, referrals, internal resources, and cold outreach.



Candidate Screening:

Conduct telephone interviews to evaluate technical experience, field service

background, communication skills, tools, transportation, availability, geographic

coverage, and overall suitability for available opportunities.



Technical Assessment:

Identify technicians with experience in areas such as desktop and laptop support,

printers, point-of-sale equipment, networking, servers, hardware installation, equipment

replacement, break-fix service, and other IT field services.



Full-Cycle Recruitment:

Move qualified candidates through Barrister's recruiting and onboarding process,

including candidate qualification, testing or skills evaluation, required documentation,

background screening coordination, training, and orientation.



Deployment Support:

Work closely with internal Operations and Technician Assignment teams to understand

technician coverage gaps, open staffing requirements, client needs, and SLA priorities.



Pipeline Management:

Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within Barrister's recruitment

and tracking systems. Follow up consistently with candidates until they complete

onboarding or are removed from consideration.



Performance Accountability:

Meet established recruiting and productivity expectations, which may include outbound

call volume, talk time, candidate activity, technician identification, completed

onboarding, and assigned staffing objectives.



Qualifications



- Experience in high-volume recruiting, staffing, tele-sales, call center operations,

or outbound customer engagement.

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Comfortable working in a high-volume Outbound calling environment.

- Strong telephone interviewing and candidate-engagement skills.

- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

- Ability to manage multiple candidates, staffing requests, and priorities

simultaneously.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven and SLA-focused

environment.

- Strong computer skills and ability to work with web-based recruiting and tracking

systems.

- Previous IT staffing, technical recruiting, or field service recruiting experience is

strongly preferred.



Terms of Employment



Schedule: Full-Time, 40 hours per week. Work schedule will support Barrister's U.S.-

based operations.



Remote Work: This is a 100% remote position. Candidates must have a reliable

computer, stable high-speed internet connection, headset/telephone capability, and a

professional remote work environment.

title: Appointment Setter (SDR) | Warm Calls to US Business Owners | Mon to Fri, Weekends Off
description:
Every owner you call has already heard from us, and you're never asking them to buy anything. You're offering a free conversation with a team that helps businesses like theirs win more customers. It's one of the easiest yeses you'll ever ask for on the phone.



ABOUT AXION



Axion is a performance-based pipeline partner for US marketing agencies. We fund and run the outreach and SDR teams that put qualified business owners on our partners' sales calendars, using the same playbooks behind our own agencies.



Our partners pay only when a qualified owner shows up to a meeting with their sales team. No retainers, no setup fees, no long-term contracts. We invest our own capital first and only get paid when our partners do.



Feel free to learn more about Axion at 



THE ROLE



You'll keep our partners' sales calendars full of qualified meetings.



You'll look after 2 to 3 partner accounts and spend most of your day on the phone: first with owners who just replied to us, then with owners we haven't heard back from yet. You'll have a real conversation about their business, check that they're a good fit, and book the meeting while you're on the call. You'll also confirm upcoming meetings and rebook anyone who missed theirs.



Why this role stands out:



- No cold lists, no research. Everyone you call has already heard from us, and we hand you every lead.

- An easy yes. You're not selling anything. You're offering a free conversation about getting more customers.

- One clear job. Talk to owners, qualify them, book the meeting. You get very good at it, fast.

- A steady schedule. Monday to Friday, US business hours, weekends off.

- Direct coaching. You work directly with Adam, our VP of Partner Success, with a short huddle and recap every day while you ramp up.

- Real growth. Hit your targets for 90 days and you move to Senior with a higher base and bigger bonuses. As Axion grows, so do our sales & leadership roles, and every new seat goes to the people already here first.



WHAT A DAY LOOKS LIKE



- Huddle (15 minutes): role-play, objections and the plan for the day.

- Calling: owners who just replied to us come first, within minutes. Then follow-up calls to owners who haven't replied yet.

- Confirmations: quick calls to confirm upcoming meetings and rebook anyone who missed theirs.

- Notes: every call logged in our CRM, and a clear note on every meeting you book.

- Recap (15 minutes): your numbers, your best calls, and what to sharpen tomorrow.



PAY



- $900/month base, in USD

- $5 for every qualified meeting you book that shows up

- Extra bonuses for standout performance

- Senior after 90 days at target: $1,050/month base, plus bigger bonuses and commissions

- Paid twice a month, straight to your Wise or Payoneer account

- At target, new SDRs earn about $1,100 to $1,300 a month



WHO YOU ARE



- You're competitive, and a "no" doesn't slow you down. You'd rather make the next dial than think about the last one.

- You're coachable. When you get feedback, we hear it on your very next call.

- You sound like a peer to a business owner, not a call center. Confident, relaxed and direct.

- You're detail-oriented. Every call gets logged and every booking gets a clear note, because our partners' sales teams read them.

- You take ownership. When the team needs you, you step up without being asked twice.

- You want a long-term role at a company you can grow inside.



REQUIREMENTS



- Excellent spoken and written English that sounds natural to US business owners

- Outbound calling or appointment setting experience with US businesses (strongly preferred)

- An active LinkedIn account

- Wired headset and a quiet place to work

- Reliable internet, plus a backup plan if your power or internet drops

- A computer that runs Chrome with several tabs open

- Comfortable using a CRM, a calling app on your computer, and Slack

- Available Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm US Eastern (9pm to 5am Philippine time until Nov 1, then 10pm to 6am when US clocks change)



HOW TO APPLY



We listen to every recording before we read anything else. Send all of the following:



1. Subject line: Axion Appointment Setter | [Your Name]

2. A voice recording of you reading the script below. Upload it to Google Drive or Vocaroo and paste the link. Say it the way you would on a live call.

3. Your LinkedIn profile link

4. Short answers to these questions:

   a. Tell us about your cold calling experience: who you called, what you booked, and your best month.

   b. A business owner tells you, "We already have someone doing our marketing." What do you say next?

   c. What's your backup if your internet or power goes out during your shift?

   d. What's a goal you're working toward right now, and how would this role help you get there?



Applications without a recording won't be reviewed.



SCRIPT FOR YOUR RECORDING



"Hi Dave, this is [your name]. We reached out earlier this week about a few ideas for getting more jobs for your business, and I said I'd give you a quick call. Do you have a minute? Great. I'm not calling to sell you anything. I'd like to set you up with a short video call with a team that works with businesses like yours every day. They'll walk you through what's working in your area right now. Would Tuesday at 2 or Wednesday at 10 work better for you?"



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. Shortlisted applicants hear from us within 2 business days.

2. A 15-minute live call with a quick role-play.

3. If it's a fit, you start with 2 to 3 days of paid training.

4. Then you're on the phones.



We're hiring this week.

title: HIGH-VOLUME SALES CLOSER | SELL MORE, LEVEL UP FASTER, EARN MORE
description:
HIGH-VOLUME SALES CLOSER | SELL MORE, LEVEL UP FASTER, EARN MORE



READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are looking for a salesperson who can sell confidently, handle rejection, and close deals at volume.



You do not need Google Ads experience. You do need proven phone sales experience, strong spoken English, and the ability to turn conversations into paying customers.



This is not an appointment-setting role. You will be selling a straightforward $55.99 Google Ads audit.



ABOUT DIGITAL MARKETING MASTERS



Digital Marketing Masters (DMM) is a US digital marketing agency specializing in Google Ads management.



We have more than 1,000 businesses currently running Google Ads in our lead database. Your job is to contact these business owners and sell them our $55.99 Google Ads audit.



You handle the sales. DMM provides the product knowledge, script, tools, and audit fulfillment.



THE ROLE



This is a fast-paced, high-volume outbound sales position.



Your responsibilities include:



- Contact business owners already running Google Ads.

- Deliver a short sales pitch and answer basic questions.

- Follow our qualification script.

- Handle objections and ask for the sale.

- Create Stripe payment links and help customers complete payment.

- Record sales in HubSpot.

- Move quickly to the next prospect when a sale does not happen.

- Call during appropriate local business hours across US time zones.



No routine follow-ups or callback lists. Focus on closing the sale and moving forward.



There is no minimum call requirement. Your performance is measured by paid sales, not the number of calls you make.



SALES TARGETS



Minimum: 5 paid audits per working day.



Target: 10 or more paid audits per working day.



Five sales is the minimum performance floor. Ten or more is the goal.



COMPENSATION AND CAREER GROWTH



Starting salary: $500 USD per month.



Part-time, approximately 25 hours per week. This is a Level 1 Sales Representative position.



Sell well, level up faster, and earn more. Consistent high performers may advance to higher sales levels with increased compensation based on demonstrated results.



FAST ONBOARDING



Our goal is to get you selling within 2 days.



We help you set up your accounts, explain the audit, and walk you through Kixie, HubSpot, Stripe, and the sales script.



You receive the tools and essential training needed to get started. You must learn quickly and be ready to sell without weeks of training.



WHO SHOULD APPLY?



- Proven experience closing sales over the phone.

- Strong spoken English and confidence speaking with business owners.

- Ability to handle objections and ask for payment.

- Comfortable with rejection and moving quickly between prospects.

- Self-motivated, competitive, and results-driven.

- Reliable computer, internet, backup connection, and quiet workspace.

- Availability during appropriate US business hours.



Experience in telesales, B2B sales, insurance, software, telecommunications, or other high-volume sales environments is welcome.



Google Ads experience is not required. We need a closer, not a marketing expert.



MANDATORY APPLICATION SCREENING



All five sections must be completed. Incomplete applications may be rejected.



1. VOICE SAMPLE



Submit a 30-second Vocaroo recording introducing yourself and explaining your sales experience.



2. SALES EXPERIENCE



Tell us what you have sold, who you sold to, and what you personally closed. Include results where possible.



3. SOFTWARE EXPERIENCE



List your experience with dialers, CRMs, Google Sheets, and payment systems.



4. PREVIOUS SALES CALL



Provide an authorized recording of a previous cold call demonstrating your sales ability.



5. COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE CONFIRMATION



Confirm that you accept the $500 monthly starting salary, part-time schedule of approximately 25 hours per week, minimum of 5 paid audits per working day, and target of 10 or more daily sales.



FINAL INSTRUCTIONS



Answer all five screening questions and include both recording links.



If you know how to sell, close, and maintain momentum at volume, we want to hear from you.

title: Creative Brand & Growth Manager – E-Commerce (Full-Time)
description:
Who We Are

We are an established, profitable e-commerce business specialising in funny, novelty and unique gifts.

We sell internationally through Amazon, Shopify, Etsy and TikTok Shop, and have ambitious plans to become one of the leading brands in our niche.



We operate with a small remote team and focus on ownership, structure, accountability and long-term collaboration.

We do not want to micromanage.

We expect people to think independently, solve problems and take responsibility for outcomes, not just complete assigned tasks.



Why This Role Exists

Our business is growing, but much of our brand development, creative direction and marketing strategy is still managed by the founders.

We want to change that.



We are looking for a Creative Brand & Growth Manager who will take ownership of our creative and marketing activities, identify opportunities for improvement, develop plans and ensure projects are completed successfully.



Our immediate priority is improving our Amazon brand presence, particularly product images and A+ Content across our product portfolio.



Long term, we want someone who can help strengthen our brand positioning, build our creative and marketing operations, and contribute to our wider growth strategy.



This role exists to move from founder-led creative execution to independent ownership of our brand and marketing activities.



What You Will Be Responsible For



You will take ownership of:

1. Amazon Brand Presence

Improving product listing images and A+ Content.

Researching competitors and identifying creative improvements.

Managing designers and ensuring high-quality creative assets.

Maintaining consistent branding across our product portfolio.



2. Brand Positioning & Creative Strategy

Identifying opportunities to strengthen our brand identity and market positioning.

Developing creative concepts and marketing ideas.

Ensuring consistent messaging and visual presentation across platforms.



3. Product Development & Launches

Coordinating product branding, packaging, product inserts, and creative development.

Overseeing the creative aspects of new product launches.

Researching market trends, competitors and product opportunities.



4. E-Commerce & Customer Experience

Overseeing Shopify improvements and customer experience.

Coordinating product launches and listings across Amazon, Etsy, Shopify and TikTok Shop.

Developing product insert,
 marketing and customer retention strategies.



5. Social Media &
 Marketing

Developing social media and influencer marketing initiatives.

Coordinating content creation and marketing campaigns.

Identifying opportunities to increase brand awareness and engagement.



You are not expected to personally execute every task or be an expert in every area.



Your responsibility is to take ownership, establish priorities, manage the right people and ensure work gets done.



We will provide training, guidance and resources where necessary.



Who This Role Is NOT For



This role is not for:

• Agencies or freelancers looking for additional clients.

• People managing multiple businesses or side jobs.

• Someone looking for part-time or short-term work.

• Someone who waits for instructions rather than taking initiative.

• Someone who needs constant supervision or reminders.

• Someone unwilling to learn, adapt or take responsibility.

• We are looking for one dedicated, full-time team member who wants to grow with one business long term.



What We Expect From You

We value mindset, intelligence, commitment and ownership.

We expect:

• Ownership: Take responsibility for projects and results from start to finish.

• Initiative: Identify problems and opportunities without waiting to be told.

• Problem-solving: Research solutions independently and bring recommendations.

• Intelligence & adaptability: Learn new skills, understand new concepts and apply them quickly.

• Organisation: Manage multiple projects, priorities and deadlines effectively.

• Communication: Provide clear, proactive updates without needing to be chased.

• Leadership: Coordinate designers, freelancers and other team members.

• Strategic thinking: Understand the bigger picture and suggest ways to improve the business.

• Commitment: Be reliable, dedicated and interested in growing with us long term.

• Experience in e-commerce, Amazon, branding, marketing or project management is desirable.



How to Apply



Please provide:

1. Your CV

2. Three examples of Creative Projects you’ve done for a brand

3. Your commitment

Include the exact phrase "I am applying for a full-time, exclusive role with your brand, not as an agency, freelancer, or someone managing other clients." at the beginning of your application.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team, take real responsibility and grow alongside our business.



Salary will be $700 - $1,000 per month.

About Isaac Health

Isaac Health is a fast-growing Series A-stage startup specializing in dementia and brain health care through our multidisciplinary virtual memory clinic. Operating across all 50 states, we partner with payers nationwide to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care.



As we expand, we are seeking a dedicated, empathetic, and detail-oriented Front Desk - Inbound to join our team. You will be the first voice our patients and caregivers hear, shaping their entire experience with Isaac Health.



Role Overview

This role acts as the virtual front desk of our clinic. You will answer phones, assist with scheduling appointments, process referrals and orders, and respond to basic patient questions. You’ll primarily support patients not enrolled in ongoing care navigation services, while also identifying those who may benefit from more comprehensive support. This role is non-clinical and focused on patient services, reception, and administrative excellence.



The position blends administrative precision with patient-facing empathy. The ideal candidate can communicate clearly and warmly with older adults, resolve issues efficiently, and uphold the highest service standards to ensure a positive patient experience.



Key Responsibilities



Patient Intake & Front Desk Support

- Answer calls promptly and professionally, serving as the first point of contact for patients and families

- Assist with scheduling appointments and routing patients to the right team (outreach/intake, technical support, care navigation, healthcare providers, billing and eligibility)



Patient Experience & Service Recovery

- Deliver a “white glove” experience by resolving concerns quickly and empathetically

- Communicate with warmth, patience, and clarity — especially with older adults and caregivers who may have cognitive or behavioral challenges



Administrative & Financial Support

- Initiate pre-visit outreach calls to confirm patient attendance and readiness for upcoming virtual consultations.

- Provide frontline technical assistance to patients, guiding them through platform login, audio/video configuration, and basic troubleshooting.



Requirements

- 2–3+ years of experience in healthcare, medical reception, patient services, or call center support 

- Excellent phone presence and communication skills, with the ability to speak clearly and empathetically with older adults

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage multiple priorities

- Familiarity with virtual care platforms, scheduling systems, and collaboration tools (e.g., EMRs, Zoom, Google Chat, call center software)

- Reliable high-speed internet connection

- Must be available to work U.S. business hours (Eastern Time or Pacific Time coverage)



What We Offer

- Full-time, fully remote role (40+ hours/week)

- Competitive compensation with opportunities for advancement

- A stable, long-term position with a mission-driven U.S. healthcare company

- Training and mentorship in dementia care and patient experience excellence

- Career progression opportunities in care navigation, clinical operations, patient experience, or quality assurance

- A chance to shape the future of dementia and brain health care delivery

• Plan and personally manage Meta advertising; test Google Ads where commercially appropriate. Own targeting, messaging, budgets, experiments and optimisation.

• Initially perform the content leadership function: editorial calendar, persuasive copy, scripts, creative briefs, quality control, brand consistency and coordination of production resources.

• Manage the website/funnel and automation specialists: set weekly priorities, allocate tasks, review quality, unblock handoffs and ensure delivery.

• Own the end-to-end marketing journey: approved content → landing page → enquiry capture → attribution → Pipedrive assignment → booking → follow-up. Coordinate with Stuart (sales) and Raven (lead follow-up).

• Establish clear lead qualification criteria and closed-loop reporting on source, qualified enquiries, bookings, attendance, signed JVs and acquisition cost.

• Run weekly performance and delivery reviews; recommend resource and budget changes supported by evidence.

• Ensure financial and property marketing claims, testimonials and campaign materials receive appropriate internal approval before publication.



Essential experience:

• Demonstrated hands-on acquisition campaigns for high-value, consultation-led services, including budgets, lead quality, booked appointments and downstream outcomes.

• Proven ability to lead specialists or remote contractors, review deliverables and hold people accountable.

• Strong content and creative judgement, with samples of copy, campaign concepts or briefs you personally produced or directed.

• Practical Meta Ads expertise and working understanding of landing pages, conversion testing, CRM, attribution and automated follow-up.

• Strong written and spoken English, sound commercial judgement, analytical skills and reliable communication.

• Ability to work independently with meaningful overlap with Australian Eastern time.



Highly regarded:

Experience in Australian property, mortgage broking, accounting, wealth or other regulated professional services; Pipedrive, Make, ManyChat, WordPress/Elementor, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, SEO and AI-assisted production.

What success looks like

• First 30 days: audit channels, content, CRM handoffs and existing assets; agree qualification definitions, baselines, reporting and a 90-day priority plan; establish weekly team management.

• By 60 days: launch and measure at least one complete Property Profits acquisition journey with approved content, working landing page, tracking, CRM routing, booking and follow-up; document issues and improvements.

• By 90 days: demonstrate repeatable campaign testing, reliable team delivery, accurate funnel reporting and a commercially justified scale-up plan. Progress toward 12 new JVs per month will be assessed jointly with sales.



How to apply:

Please provide-

• CV and a short explanation of why you suit a hands-on management role.

• Two relevant campaign case studies showing your personal contribution, dates, budget, audience, qualified leads, booked and attended consultations, acquisition outcomes and what you would improve. Clearly identify any results you cannot disclose.

• One or two examples of copy, content plans, ads or creative briefs you personally developed.

• A specific example of managing a specialist team: team size, responsibilities, review process and measurable delivery improvements.

• Platforms you have used directly versus those you only supervised.

• Expected monthly salary and currency, weekly hours, Australian-time overlap and earliest start date.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a structured interview and may be invited to a paid, time-boxed practical assessment using dummy business information. AI tools are welcome, provided you can explain and verify your work. We value demonstrated capability over job titles.

title: Customer Service Experience Lead
description:
We’re a fast-moving DTC brand selling across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Walmart. We’re looking for a senior, highly analytical Customer Experience Lead to own our CX operation across all channels. You’ll lead 15+ CX agents and multiple Team Leads, while owning the systems, data, automation, and processes that allow CX to scale efficiently.



This is not a “manage the support team” job. It’s a “build, optimize, and scale the entire customer experience engine” job.



What you’ll actually own:



1. Team Leadership

Lead and develop 15+ CX agents through multiple Team Leads.

Own:

Team Lead and agent performance

Training, QA, coaching, and accountability

Staffing, coverage, and workforce planning

SOPs, escalation processes, and team structure

You should be experienced managing managers, not just individual contributors.



2. Gorgias, Automation & AI

Own and continuously optimize our CX technology.



Deep expertise in:

Gorgias macros, rules, automations, tags, routing, and reporting

AI-powered support and agent assistance

Self-service, FAQ and knowledge base

Workflow automation

QA and ticket categorization

Constantly ask: What can be automated, eliminated, or made better?



3. Ecommerce Customer Experience

Own the customer journey from pre-purchase through retention.



Improve:

Pre-purchase sales and conversion

Product recommendations and customer education

Post-purchase communication

Shipping and fulfillment experience

Returns, refunds, and cancellations

Retention and save-the-sale opportunities

Customer self-service

Understand how CX impacts conversion, AOV, retention, and LTV, not just CSAT.



4. Data, Refunds & Revenue Protection



Own CX analytics and identify the root cause behind:

Refunds

Cancellations

Returns

Chargebacks

Ticket volume

Customer retention

Agent productivity

Build strategies to prevent refunds and chargebacks—not just process them.



5. Multi-Channel & Operations

Own CX across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and Social Channel comments, including their different customer-service requirements and policies.



Partner closely with Operations on:

Shipping delays

Lost/damaged packages

Fulfillment issues

Inventory problems

International shipping

Proactive customer communication



6. Voice of Customer

Turn customer interactions into actionable business intelligence.

Identify recurring:

Customer objections

Product questions

Complaints

Sentiment trends

Reasons for refunds/cancellations

Bring those insights to Ecommerce, Marketing, Product, Creative, and Operations.



What success looks like:



First 30 days:

Audit Gorgias, macros, workflows, automation, and AI.

Evaluate Team Lead/agent performance.

Identify major ticket, refund, cancellation, and chargeback drivers.

Build a 90 day CX roadmap.



First 90 days:

Implement 90 day CX roadmap

Major Gorgias and automation improvements shipped.

Meaningful AI implementation and optimization.

Clear team performance standards.

Identify pre-purchase/post-purchase flow opportunities.

Reduced unnecessary tickets and operational friction.

Improvements in CSAT, refunds, cancellations, and chargebacks.



Ongoing



Success is measured by:

CSAT | Refunds | Cancellations | Chargebacks | AI Automation |Ticket Volume | Revenue Influenced by CX



Requirements:



5+ years CX/customer service experience with DTC ecommerce

Experience managing 15+ agents and multiple Team Leads.

Proven experience managing managers.

Extensive, hands-on Gorgias experience.

Strong Shopify/ecommerce experience.

Experience optimizing pre- and post-purchase customer flows.

Deep experience with Gorgias macros, automations, rules, and workflows.

Strong CX data and analytics experience.

Experience with refunds, cancellations, returns, and chargebacks.

Heavy, practical use of AI and automation.

Experience in a high-volume, fast-growth environment.



Strongly preferred:



Experience across Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Walmart.

7–8+ figure DTC experience.

Experience with retention, LTV, and save-the-sale strategies.

Experience building CX KPI/reporting systems.

Strong understanding of fulfillment and ecommerce operations.

Experience using AI to materially reduce support workload.





This is probably not for you if:



You’ve only managed a small support team.

You’ve never managed Team Leads/managers.

Your Gorgias experience is primarily as an agent.

You think CX is simply about answering tickets faster.

You’re not highly analytical.

You don’t actively use AI to improve workflows.

You prefer maintaining systems rather than constantly optimizing them.





How to apply:



Send us:

Big wins — The largest CX team you’ve managed and results you drove.

Gorgias — One workflow, macro, or automation you built and its impact.

CX optimization — One example of reducing refunds, cancellations, chargebacks, or ticket volume.

AI — How you’re currently using AI in CX.

Your resume or LinkedIn.

title: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



About Agency Hero



Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. We work behind the scenes as an extension of our agency partners' teams, helping businesses improve organic and local search visibility through SEO strategy, content, technical optimization, Local SEO, and emerging AI search strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist to join our SEO team. This role requires strong experience developing content strategies for local and service-area businesses, as well as broader organic SEO campaigns.



This is not primarily a content writing position. We need someone who can analyze websites, local and organic search opportunities, competitors, geographic markets, search intent, and SEO data to determine what content to create or improve, why it should exist, how it should be structured, and how it fits into the overall SEO strategy.



What You'll Do

-As a Content Strategist, you will develop and improve SEO content strategies across client websites, with a significant focus on Local SEO and service-area businesses.

-Develop SEO-driven content strategies for local, service-area, regional, and broader organic campaigns.

Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis, including local and geographic search intent.

-Analyze local SERPs, organic competitors, geographic competitors, and content gaps.

Identify new content opportunities based on services, locations, search demand, competitors, and business priorities.

-Determine when service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, supporting informational content, and other page types should be created.

-Develop service-to-location content strategies without creating unnecessary, thin, duplicative, or doorway-style pages.

-Audit existing website content and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded, redirected, or removed.

-Develop topic clusters and supporting content designed to strengthen topical and local authority.

-Map keywords, services, topics, locations, and search intent to appropriate pages.

-Plan website content architecture, including service, location, service-area, and supporting content relationships.

-Develop internal linking strategies that strengthen priority service and location pages.

-Identify and prevent keyword, topic, service, and location cannibalization.

-Create detailed content briefs for writers.

-Analyze competitor websites and SERPs to understand what is required to compete in specific markets.

-Review content for SEO effectiveness, quality, relevance, search intent, local relevance, and publication readiness.

-Consider how website content supports broader local visibility, including Google Business Profile and Map Pack performance.

-Work with other members of our SEO, Local SEO, technical, and content teams.

-Use AI tools to improve research, analysis, strategy development, and workflow efficiency.

-Help develop strategies for traditional Google Search, local search, Google AI experiences, and emerging AI-driven search platforms.



Required Experience

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in:



-SEO content strategy.

-Local SEO content strategy for local and service-area businesses.

-Developing service-page and location-page strategies.

-Keyword research and local keyword research.

-Search-intent and geographic-intent analysis.

-Competitor and local competitor research.

-Content-gap analysis.

-Content auditing and optimization.

-Developing content plans and detailed briefs.

-On-page SEO.

-Internal linking.

-Using SEO data to make content decisions.

-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Working with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms in professional SEO or content workflows.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



Local SEO Knowledge

Candidates should have strong working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page strategy.

-City and location-page strategy.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local content architecture and service-to-location relationships.

-Local competitor and SERP analysis.

-Determining when location-specific pages are justified by search intent and business needs.

-Avoiding thin, duplicate, templated, or doorway-style local pages.

-Local keyword and content cannibalization.

-Internal linking for service and location pages.

-Building topical relevance around priority services and markets.

-The relationship between website content, Google Business Profile, organic local results, and Map Pack visibility.

-Multi-location and multi-market content considerations.



Advanced SEO Skills

Strong candidates should also understand:



-Topical authority and topic clustering.

-Content architecture.

-Keyword, entity, and topic mapping.

-E-E-A-T principles.

-YMYL considerations.

-Search intent.

-Content cannibalization.

-Internal linking strategy.

-Competitor analysis.

-SEO content auditing.

-Content prioritization.

-Google Search Console data.

-Modern search behavior and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO, Local SEO, and AI search.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable.



AI & Claude Experience

AI is an important part of how our team works. We are particularly interested in candidates who know how to use AI for more than simply generating content.

You should be comfortable using AI to assist with:



-Research and analysis.

-Local and organic content-gap identification.

-Competitor and SERP analysis.

-Content strategy and prioritization.

-Service and location content planning.

-Content briefs.

-SEO analysis.

-Reviewing and improving existing content.

-Identifying entity, topic, and question-coverage opportunities.

-Developing repeatable workflows.



Experience using Claude Projects, Claude Skills, custom GPTs, or other structured/reusable AI workflows is a strong advantage but is not required.



We can teach our specific systems to someone with excellent SEO/content strategy skills who can learn sophisticated AI workflows.



AI Search Visibility

We also want this person to understand how search is evolving beyond traditional organic rankings.



The strategist should be able to consider how content can improve visibility across Google AI experiences and AI-driven platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.



This includes thinking about entity clarity, topical coverage, question coverage, authoritative supporting content, and how local businesses and their services, locations, and expertise are represented across the web.



AI search knowledge is important, but it does not replace strong traditional and Local SEO fundamentals.



What We're Looking For

We want someone who:



-Thinks strategically rather than simply completing tasks.

-Has strong Local SEO instincts as well as broader organic SEO knowledge.

-Can determine whether a local content opportunity actually deserves a dedicated page.

description:

About the Role

This is a senior leadership position—not just a video editing role. We need someone who combines advanced video editing skills, expertise in AI video generation, strong creative instincts, and proven team management experience.

Your primary goal is to build and lead a high-performance creative production department that delivers exceptional video ads consistently, efficiently, and at scale.



Key Responsibilities

Set production targets, monitor workloads, and ensure deadlines are met.



Review editor productivity, output quality, and overall performance.

Establish quality assurance processes before final delivery.



3. AI Video Production & Innovation



Lead the use of AI video generation tools, particularly Higgsfield and similar platforms.



Oversee the creation of AI UGC, AI animations, AI drama ads, cinematic ads, AI voiceovers, and AI product videos.



Train editors on advanced AI workflows, character consistency, camera movements, lip-sync, and realistic storytelling.



Research and implement new AI tools to improve production quality and efficiency.



4. Training & Development



Develop onboarding programs, training materials, SOPs, and editing guidelines.



Conduct regular creative reviews and coaching sessions.



Build a library of winning ads, AI prompts, production templates, and best practices.



Help editors continuously improve their technical and creative skills.



5. Production Systems & Workflow Optimization



Build and improve the end-to-end video production workflow.



Track weekly output, turnaround times, revision rates, and deadlines.



Collaborate with creative strategists, media buyers, and operations managers.



Identify opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks.



Scale production volume without sacrificing quality.



6. Creative Performance & Optimization



Analyze successful advertisements to identify winning hooks, formats, and storytelling techniques.



Work with media buyers and creative strategists to translate performance insights into creative improvements.



Develop new production techniques and creative formats that support advertising performance.



Requirements



At least 5 years of professional video editing experience, preferably in e-commerce or direct-response advertising.



Proven experience leading, managing, or coaching a team of video editors.



Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable editing software.



Hands-on expertise in Higgsfield and modern AI video generation tools.



Demonstrated experience creating AI UGC, AI animations, AI drama ads, and cinematic AI content.



Strong understanding of Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and conversion-focused creative.



Experience managing high-volume video production with multiple editors.



Excellent understanding of hooks, audience retention, pacing, storytelling, and calls to action.



Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.



Experience building production workflows, SOPs, and quality control systems.



Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with demanding production targets.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with eight-figure or nine-figure e-commerce brands.



Experience in supplements, health, wellness, or other competitive direct-response markets.



Experience scaling AI-powered creative production workflows.



Experience collaborating with creative strategists and performance media buyers.



A portfolio showcasing high-performing ads and advanced AI-generated videos.



Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Weekly video production output and team productivity.



On-time delivery and production efficiency.



Creative quality and execution of briefs.



Revision rates and quality assurance.



Quality and innovation of AI-generated content.



Team development and editor performance.



Contribution to winning advertising concepts and creative iteration.



First 90 Days



First 30 Days: Audit the editing department, assess team performance, review existing workflows, and establish quality assurance and performance tracking systems.



First 60 Days: Implement structured training, improve production efficiency, standardize AI workflows, and establish consistent production standards.



First 90 Days: Take full ownership of the department, reduce reliance on founder involvement, and build a high-performing team capable of consistently producing quality ads at scale.



Compensation & Growth



Base Salary: $8,000 USD per month



Performance-Based Bonuses: Additional compensation tied to production quality, efficiency, team performance, and measurable creative outcomes. Bonus targets and payout terms will be agreed upon separately.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of a growing creative production department and help shape the future of AI-powered advertising across multiple e-commerce brands.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



Portfolio: Links to your strongest direct-response video advertisements, preferably for e-commerce brands.



AI Creative Samples: Examples of AI UGC, AI animations, AI drama ads, cinematic AI videos, or similar projects you personally created.



Leadership Experience: Details about the editing teams you have managed, including team size and responsibilities.



Production Capacity: The number of high-quality video advertisements your team typically produced per week.



AI Workflow: A brief explanation of your AI video production process, including the tools you use and how you maintain quality at scale.



Important: We are not looking for someone who simply edits videos well. We want a proven leader who can build, manage, train, and continuously improve an elite video production team.



Please apply only if you have the hands-on AI production expertise and leadership experience required for this position.

title: Full-Time Video Editor, AI Video Studio | Permanent Role, U.S. Company ($800–$2,000/mo)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We're a U.S.-based AI video production studio in Providence, Rhode Island. We make commercials, listing videos, social content and explainers for real estate agents, title and insurance companies, home service businesses and local brands. Our team's work has run with NASCAR, NFL players, sporting event spots and billboard real estate brands.



Our AI tools generate the footage. You make it look like it cost ten times more. We're hiring a full-time video editor who takes raw clips and turns them into finished, client-ready videos, every day.



This is a permanent, salaried seat with daily work. Not a gig, not a trial. We're building a team, not cycling through freelancers.



ABOUT THE PAY



$800 to $2,000 USD per month, based on experience.

- $800 is the starting rate for a solid editor with clean fundamentals who is newer to AI footage.

- Up to $2,000 for an editor who already finishes AI video at a commercial level and works fast.

- Raises are tied to your output and quality, not how long you've been here.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



- Cut AI-generated clips into finished 15, 30 and 60 second commercials, plus longer explainers and walkthroughs

- Join multi-clip sequences so they play like one continuous take

- Add captions (checked word for word against the script), lower thirds, simple motion graphics and branded end cards

- Mix voiceover, music and sound effects with clean levels

- Match color between clips from different AI tools so the whole video feels like one shoot

- Spot and fix AI flaws before anything ships (warped hands, flicker, face drift, lips out of sync) using cuts, punch-ins, reframes and cutaways

- Deliver a 16:9 master plus 9:16 vertical versions for social, exported to spec and filed in Google Drive with clear names

- Check your own work before it reaches us, and turn revision notes around quickly



We give you the scripts, briefs, character references and brand standards. You don't have to come up with the ideas. You have to make them look great.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- 2+ years of real editing work you can show us

- Strong in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve

- An eye for pacing, cuts that land on the beat, and captions that are easy to read

- Someone who can't stand a sloppy frame and fixes it before anyone asks

- Fast without being careless. We put out a lot of videos.

- Experience with AI video tools (Seedance, Kling, VEO, Sora, Higgsfield, HeyGen, Runway or similar) is a big plus, not required. We'll train the right person.

- Clear written English, comfortable with Loom videos and quick calls

- At least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern time each workday

- A reliable internet connection and a computer that can handle 2K/4K timelines

- Someone looking for a long-term home, not a side job



WHAT YOU GET



- A permanent, salaried, full-time role with year-round work

- All AI tools and subscriptions paid by us, plus editing software licenses if you need them. You never pay for tools out of pocket.

- Training on our workflow and client standards

- Raises based on output and quality

- A path to lead. As we grow, our strongest editor runs the editing team.

- Paid through Wise, PayPal or your preferred method



HOW TO APPLY, PLEASE READ CAREFULLY



Apply right here on OnlineJobs.ph. We review every application personally.



1. Start your application with the code EDIT-OCT26. Applications without the code won't be reviewed.

2. Send 2 to 4 links to videos YOU edited (Google Drive, YouTube or Vimeo, set so anyone with the link can view). Include at least one vertical short-form video and one with captions or motion graphics. AI footage is a plus but not required.

3. Answer these in a few sentences each:

   - Which editing software do you use every day?

   - Tell us about one shot or video that wasn't working and how you fixed it.

   - What hours can you work in U.S. Eastern time?

   - What monthly rate are you expecting within $800 to $2,000?
